paras.en: Not done gaming before the holidays? This is a good gaming mouse to consider, according to our reviewer, with Stream Deck integration and longer battery life than its predecessor. It's not the lowest price we've seen, but it's still pretty solid if you're planning on buying one to relieve stress pre-holiday.
paras.zh: 假期前没玩游戏？根据我们的评测者的说法，这是一款值得考虑的优秀游戏鼠标，它集成了 Stream Deck，并且电池寿命比其前身更长。这不是我们见过的最低价格，但如果您打算在假期前购买一件来缓解压力，那么它仍然相当不错。

paras.en: This is WIRED reviewer Luke Larsen's top Chromebook pick, offering solid everyday performance and a responsive touchpad. Its Intel Core i3 processor and 8 GB of RAM make it a practical choice for browsing and working in Google Docs, though you'll have to compromise on color accuracy.
paras.zh: 这是《连线》评论家卢克·拉森 (Luke Larsen) 推荐的 Chromebook 首选，它提供稳定的日常性能和响应灵敏的触摸板。其 Intel Core i3 处理器和 8 GB RAM 使其成为浏览和使用 Google Docs 的实用选择，但您必须在颜色准确性方面做出妥协。

articles.title: Watch: Vince Vaughn takes on John Malkovich in 'Bad Monkey' Season 2

paras.en: Nov. 5 (UPI) -- Apple TV is gearing up for the release of Bad Monkey Season 2.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日 (UPI)——Apple TV 正在为《坏猴子》第二季的发布做准备。

paras.en: The streaming service shared a trailer for the season Thursday featuring Vince Vaughn (Wedding Crashers, True Detective).
paras.zh: 该流媒体服务于周四分享了由文斯·沃恩（《婚礼闯入者》、《真探》）主演的本季预告片。

paras.en: Bad Monkey is a dark comedy based on the Carl Hiaasen novel of the same name. The series follows demoted Miami police detective Andrew Yancy (Vaughn) as he investigates a murder in the hope of winning back his badge.
paras.zh: 《坏猴子》是一部根据卡尔·希亚森同名小说改编的黑色喜剧。该剧讲述了被降职的迈阿密警探安德鲁·扬西（沃恩饰）调查一起谋杀案，希望夺回警徽的故事。

paras.en: In Season 2, Yancy "finds himself embroiled in a turf war between rival criminal organizations as he navigates a variety of Florida oddballs, including an erudite mob boss, his unhinged son and a hard-edged young woman who needs Yancy's protection," an official synopsis reads.
paras.zh: 在第二季中，官方剧情简介写道，扬西“发现自己卷入了敌对犯罪组织之间的地盘争夺战，他与佛罗里达州的各种怪人打交道，其中包括博学的黑帮老大、他精神错乱的儿子和需要扬西保护的锋芒毕露的年轻女子”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Yancy must also contend with his aging father and "unresolved romantic tension" with Dr. Rosa (Natalie Martinez).
paras.zh: 与此同时，扬西还必须应对年迈的父亲以及与罗莎医生（娜塔莉·马丁内斯饰）之间“未解决的浪漫紧张关系”。

paras.en: Bad Monkey hails from Scrubs creator and Ted Lasso co-creator Bill Lawrence. Season 2 premieres Dec. 2 on Apple TV.
paras.zh: 《坏猴子》出自《实习医生风云》创始人兼泰德·拉索联合创始人比尔·劳伦斯之手。第 2 季将于 12 月 2 日在 Apple TV 上首播。

articles.title: Justice Department Civil Rights Division lead Harmeet Dhillon resigns

paras.en: Nov. 5 (UPI) -- Harmeet Dhillon, assistant attorney general for the Justice Department's Civil Rights division announced her resignation on Thursday.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日（UPI）——司法部民权部门助理总检察长 Harmeet Dhillon 周四宣布辞职。

paras.en: Dhillon's resignation comes two days after Democrats won majorities in the U.S. House and Senate, and days after she announced she was dispatching more than 1,000 election monitors across the country. Dhillon is the first major Trump administration official to resign since Tuesday's midterms.
paras.zh: 迪隆辞职是在民主党赢得美国参众两院多数席位两天后，也是在她宣布将向全国派遣 1000 多名选举监督员几天后。迪隆是自周二中期选举以来首位辞职的特朗普政府主要官员。

paras.en: "Today, I accepted the resignation of Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon, who led the Civil Rights Division with conviction the past 18 months," Attorney General Todd Blanche posted on social media. "She has defended the civil liberties of every American and enforced the law without fear or favor."
paras.zh: 司法部长托德·布兰奇在社交媒体上发帖称：“今天，我接受助理司法部长哈米特·迪隆的辞职，他在过去 18 个月里以有罪的态度领导民权部门。” “她捍卫了每个美国人的公民自由，并毫无恐惧或偏袒地执行法律。”

paras.en: Civil Rights organizations around the country have alleged that the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division has been largely inactive in its traditional roles under Dhillon's watch, particularly in investigating complaints of discrimination.
paras.zh: 全国各地的民权组织声称，司法部民权部门在迪隆的领导下基本上没有履行其传统职责，特别是在调查歧视投诉方面。

paras.en: The Civil Rights Division is typically active in taking up complaints in educational institutions, voting rights and workplace discrimination.
paras.zh: 民权部门通常积极受理有关教育机构、投票权和工作场所歧视的投诉。

paras.en: Under Dhillon, and President Donald Trump, the Civil Rights Division has shifted its focus toward investigating and prosecuting alleged noncitizens for voting, bias against white people and Christians and ending diversity, equity and inclusion policies across the country.
paras.zh: 在迪隆和唐纳德·特朗普总统的领导下，民权部门已将重点转向调查和起诉涉嫌投票的非公民、对白人和基督徒的偏见以及终止全国范围内的多样性、公平和包容政策。

paras.en: Hundreds of longtime employees in the division left their positions, as well as more than half of its attorneys.
paras.zh: 该部门数百名长期员工以及一半以上的律师离职。

paras.en: "Harmeet Dhillon has been the most destructive, lawless, and hateful head of the Civil Rights Division in DOJ history," Stacey Young, head of the Justice Department alumni group Justice Connection, said in a statement. "For almost 70 years, the Civil Rights Division brought to fruition the civil rights laws that Americans demanded. Dhillon decimated it."
paras.zh: 司法部校友组织“正义连线”负责人史黛西·杨在一份声明中表示，“哈米特·迪隆是司法部历史上最具破坏性、无法无天、最可恨的民权部门负责人。” “近 70 年来，民权部门实现了美国人所要求的民权法。迪隆摧毁了它。”

articles.title: Nolan's 'The Odyssey' with Matt Damon returns to theaters in December

paras.en: Nov. 5 (UPI) -- The Odyssey will be back in theaters Dec. 11. The Wrap and Deadline reported the news.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日（UPI）——《奥德赛》将于 12 月 11 日重返影院。The Wrap 和 Deadline 报道了这一消息。

paras.en: Since opening July 17, The Odyssey has grossed $1.8 million worldwide. The re-release includes IMAX screenings as the entire film was shot with IMAX cameras.
paras.zh: 自 7 月 17 日上映以来，《奥德赛》全球票房已达 180 万美元。重新上映包括 IMAX 放映，因为整部影片都是使用 IMAX 摄影机拍摄的。

paras.en: Dec. 11 is one week before the Dec. 18 releases of Dune Part ThreeAvengers: Doomsday. Dune has IMAX screens while Doomsday will use the Infinity Vision premium format.
paras.zh: 12 月 11 日是《沙丘第三部》《复仇者联盟：世界末日》12 月 18 日上映前一周。 《沙丘》拥有 IMAX 银幕，而《末日》将使用 Infinity Vision 高级格式。

paras.en: UPI praised The Odyssey in its review for grounding the mythological aspects of Homer's epic and filming in actual locations.
paras.zh: UPI 在评论中称赞《奥德赛》将荷马史诗的神话方面扎根，并在实际地点进行拍摄。

paras.en: Matt Damon stars as Odysseus, making his 20 year journey home to Ithaca from the Trojan War. The film also stars Anne Hathaway, Tom Holland, Robert Pattinson, Corey Hawkins, Elliot Page, Zendaya, Charlize Theron, Lupita Nyong'o, John Leguizamo and more.
paras.zh: 马特·达蒙 (Matt Damon) 饰演奥德修斯 (Odysseus)，踏上从特洛伊战争回到伊萨卡的 20 年旅程。这部电影的主演还包括安妮·海瑟薇、汤姆·赫兰德、罗伯特·帕丁森、科里·霍金斯、艾略特·佩奇、赞达亚、查理兹·塞隆、露皮塔·尼永奥、约翰·雷吉扎莫等。

paras.en: The Odyssey will be available at home for digital video-on-demand Nov. 17.
paras.zh: 《奥德赛》将于 11 月 17 日在家里提供数字视频点播服务。

articles.title: Grimes to Star in the First-Ever AI-Generated Film Coming to Theaters: Watch a Clip
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: Grimes has been on the cutting edge of the overlap between artificial intelligence and music, and now, she’s doing the same with the technology and film.
paras.zh: 格莱姆斯一直处于人工智能和音乐重叠领域的前沿，现在，她也在技术和电影领域做着同样的事情。

paras.en: As revealed Thursday (Nov. 5), the alternative singer-songwriter is part of the cast of Gods Don’t Give Gifts, the first AI-generated movie coming to theaters. She lends her voice and physical likeness to her character, Zayinth Alda, described in a release as “a disaffected NiiroCore aristocrat and niece to Caen Halvorith, inventor of the Substrate Migration Protocol.”
paras.zh: 据周四（11 月 5 日）透露，这位另类歌手兼作曲家是《众神不赐予礼物》的演员阵容之一，这是第一部上映的人工智能生成电影。她为自己的角色 Zayinth Alda 赋予了自己的声音和外貌，Zayinth Alda 在一份新闻稿中被描述为“一位心怀不满的 NiiroCore 贵族，也是 Caen Halvorith 的侄女，她是基板迁移协议的发明者。”

paras.en: The film, which will premiere this winter, explores a dystopian future reality in which “consciousness can be transferred between bodies, memory can be bought and sold, and death is no longer final,” a synopsis reads. In a clip released alongside Grimes’ casting announcement, her AI-animated form chastises another character before storming away with a massive, muscular, faceless creature acting as her guard.
paras.zh: 这部电影将于今年冬天首映，探讨了一个反乌托邦的未来现实，其中“意识可以在身体之间转移，记忆可以买卖，死亡不再是最终的”，剧情简介写道。在格莱姆斯宣布选角的同时发布的一段视频中，她的人工智能动画形态惩罚了另一个角色，然后带着一个巨大、肌肉发达、不露面的生物作为她的守卫，怒气冲冲地离开了。

paras.en: “You dragged me to the slag heaps for this? A slideshow of derivative drivel?” she yells before boarding her futuristic spacecraft.
paras.zh: “你就为了这个把我拖到渣堆？衍生胡言乱语的幻灯片？”她在登上她的未来飞船之前大喊。

paras.en: Though the visuals on screen are produced by AI, Grimes’ voice and dialogue were not. Gossip Goblin, the studio behind the Zack London-directed project, asserts in the release, “Casting the likeness of an actor with their spoken vocal performance will become more common with animated films using AI — audiences will see actors, athletes, musicians giving vocal performances with their likeness in films.”
paras.zh: 尽管屏幕上的视觉效果是由人工智能制作的，但格莱姆斯的声音和对话却不是。扎克·伦敦 (Zack London) 执导的项目背后的工作室 Gossip Goblin 在新闻稿中断言，“在使用人工智能的动画电影中，用演员的口语表演来模仿演员的声音将变得更加常见——观众将看到演员、运动员、音乐家在电影中以他们的肖像进行声乐表演。”

paras.en: The announcement is fitting, considering Grimes has long been interested in the ways the controversial technology is developing. She’s now gearing up to release her new album, Psy Opera, which explores the complexities of AI and uses artificially generated music on one of the tracks.
paras.zh: 考虑到格莱姆斯长期以来一直对这项有争议的技术的发展方式感兴趣，这一声明是合适的。她现在正准备发行她的新专辑《Psy Opera》，该专辑探索了人工智能的复杂性，并在其中一首曲目中使用了人工生成的音乐。

paras.en: Watch the clip of Grimes’ AI-assisted performance in Gods Don’t Give Gifts below.
paras.zh: 请观看下面的《上帝不送礼物》中格莱姆斯的人工智能辅助表演片段。

articles.title: After KCRW, Travis Holcombe Is Still Championing Music Discovery Beyond the Algorithm
articles.author: Katie Bain

paras.en: For five years in Los Angeles, Travis Holcombe soundtracked solo living room dance parties, time spent getting ready for a night out and drives across town. His curation was so exceptional that one often hoped the light would turn red so they could Shazam whatever he was playing.
paras.zh: 在洛杉矶的五年里，特拉维斯·霍尔科姆 (Travis Holcombe) 为客厅独奏舞会配乐，花时间为夜晚外出做准备，并开车穿过城镇。他的策展非常出色，以至于人们常常希望灯会变红，这样他们就可以播放 Shazam 他正在演奏的任何内容。

paras.en: As the host of Freaks Only, his 8-10 p.m. weeknight radio show on KCRW, Holcombe provided the city’s unofficial nighttime listening — until he was among those who left the station amid October 2025 layoffs. The Santa Monica-based, globally known public radio station cited federal budget cuts as the reason for letting go of 10% of its staff, including several longtime DJs. Holcombe was offered the opportunity to stay on to do Freaks Only for one night a week, a demotion he passed on. After an extended back and forth with KCRW about using the “Freaks Only” name, it was eventually determined that Holcombe could have it.
paras.zh: 作为 Freaks Only 的主持人，他晚上 8 点到 10 点。在 KCRW 的周末广播节目中，霍尔科姆为该市提供了非正式的夜间收听服务，直到他成为 2025 年 10 月裁员期间离开电台的人之一。这家总部位于圣莫尼卡的全球知名公共广播电台以联邦预算削减为由，解雇了 10% 的员工，其中包括几名长期工作的 DJ。霍尔科姆获得了每周一个晚上留下来参加 Freaks Only 的机会，但他放弃了这一降职。在与 KCRW 就使用“Freaks Only”这个名字进行了长时间的反复讨论后，最终决定霍尔科姆可以拥有这个名字。

paras.en: “I felt like the only way for me to be able to continue doing what I was doing was to kind of carve my own lane,” he says.
paras.zh: “我觉得我能够继续做我正在做的事情的唯一方法就是开辟自己的道路，”他说。

paras.en: And so while his 14-year tenure KCRW ended — from 2014 to 2020 he hosted a 10 p.m. to midnight weeknight show under his own name, sharing the 8:00 p.m. to 10:00 slot during the pandemic and then taking it over this slot full time with Freaks Only in 2021— Freaks Only has not.
paras.zh: 因此，尽管他 14 年的 KCRW 任期结束了，但从 2014 年到 2020 年，他主持了晚上 10 点的活动。以他自己的名义参加午夜周末秀，分享晚上 8:00 的节目。在大流行期间将其安排到 10:00 时段，然后在 2021 年由 Freaks Only 全职接管该时段——Freaks Only 却没有。

paras.en: “I know there are enough people who appreciated what I was doing that it would hopefully be enough to keep this afloat independently,” says Holcombe. He continues with a laugh that “if I don’t do this, I probably have to get some job I’m less excited about — I’m trying to avoid that.”
paras.zh: “我知道有足够多的人欣赏我所做的事情，希望这足以让这个项目独立运作，”霍尔科姆说。他继续笑着说，“如果我不这样做，我可能就得去找一些我不那么兴奋的工作——我正在努力避免这种情况。”

paras.en: One can understand why he’s working to maintain the position, as digging through new music and playing the best stuff for listeners is, seemingly, a dream job. It’s also a lot of work. Holcombe spends at least two hours a day listening to new music on music sites and via radio promos that are sent to him. With 24 hours a day of time to program, he typically makes four new hours of programming daily (eight hours will happen occasionally when the show just needs a polish from work done the day before.) Shows are pre-recorded, but, he says, “I approach it the way I did my live show at KCRW, and it’s often finished minutes before it airs.”
paras.zh: 人们可以理解他为什么要努力维持这一职位，因为挖掘新音乐并为听众演奏最好的作品似乎是一项梦想的工作。这也有很多工作要做。霍尔科姆每天至少花两个小时在音乐网站上以及通过发送给他的广播宣传片听新音乐。每天 24 小时都有时间进行节目制作，他通常会每天制作 4 小时的新节目（当节目只需要对前一天完成的工作进行润色时，偶尔会安排 8 小时）。节目是预先录制的，但是，他说，“我的做法就像在 KCRW 进行现场表演一样，通常在播出前几分钟就完成了。”

paras.en: From 8 a.m. to noon he plays a block called The Percolator, made of funk, indie rock, older favorites, more chill music to start the day, from noon to 8 p.m. the station plays its flagship show Freak Parade, which he says “goes anywhere genre-wise and is most similar to the old Freaks Only show on KCRW,” leaning into electronic, but also featuring lots of post-punk, disco, indie rock, hip hop and new releases. (This show repeats overnight from midnight to 8am.) From 8 p.m to midnight, he programs the dance music program Aux Out, focused on house, techno and disco, and on weekends the station airs shows from its pre-existing catalog of programming.
paras.zh: 从早上 8 点到中午，他会演奏一首名为 The Percolator 的歌曲，由放克、独立摇滚、老歌和更轻松的音乐组成，从中午到晚上 8 点开始新的一天。该电台播放其旗舰节目《Freak Parade》，他说，“从流派角度来看，该节目与 KCRW 上的旧版 Freaks Only 节目最相似”，倾向于电子音乐，但也包含大量后朋克、迪斯科、独立摇滚、嘻哈和新专辑。 （这个节目从午夜到早上 8 点整夜重复。）从晚上 8 点到午夜，他负责编排舞曲音乐节目 Aux Out，重点关注 house、techno 和迪斯科，周末电视台会播放其现有节目目录中的节目。

paras.en: The economics of the project are tricky, given that the streaming service Holcombe uses for the station increases its fee when he gets more listeners. The streaming service fees include licensing for all the music played, with Holcombe structuring the station legitimately to be respectful to music makers and to get it set up for possible future opportunities.
paras.zh: 该项目的经济效益很棘手，因为霍尔科姆为该电台使用的流媒体服务在吸引更多听众时会增加费用。流媒体服务费用包括所有播放音乐的许可，霍尔科姆合法地构建了该电台，以尊重音乐制作人，并为未来可能的机会做好准备。

paras.en: “There’s ways that I could go much cheaper and not worry about that at all,” he says, “But if this were ever to get upstreamed, I didn’t want to have to owe anybody money or have anyone feeling bad that I’ve been ripping them off or stealing music.”
paras.zh: “有很多方法可以让我的价格变得更便宜，而且完全不用担心这个问题，”他说，“但如果这一切要向上游发展，我不想欠任何人钱，也不想让任何人因为我抄袭他们或窃取音乐而感到难过。”

paras.en: All this effort is driven by a foundational belief that music is better when a human (especially one with excellent taste) is selecting what you hear. Freaks Only FM is, in its way, a stand for personal, old-school radio programming, given Holcombe’s belief is that algorithm driven listening “just finds lesser versions of stuff that you like over and over, and you need a refresh every now and then.”
paras.zh: 所有这些努力都是由一个基本信念驱动的，即当人类（尤其是具有出色品味的人）选择您所听到的音乐时，音乐会更好。 Freaks Only FM 就其本身而言，是个人、老式广播节目的代表，因为 Holcombe 相信算法驱动的收听“只会一遍又一遍地找到你喜欢的东西的较小版本，而你需要时不时地刷新一下。”

paras.en: He’s right. During our conversation he recommends “The Whole of the Moon,” a shimmering production by Watergirls (based on the 1985 original of the same name by Scottish band The Waterboys) released by DFA in August, and the most recent Black Marble album Life in Small Spaces — two releases one could have easily missed that are both, as it turns out, bangers on rotation on Freaks Only FM. By sorting through the daily onslaught of new music and presenting it in a cohesive and consistent format, Freaks Only FM is arguably a high value proposition.
paras.zh: 他是对的。在我们的谈话中，他推荐了 DFA 于 8 月发行的由 Watergirls 制作的闪亮作品《The Whole of the Moon》（改编自苏格兰乐队 The Waterboys 1985 年的同名原作），以及 Black Marble 的最新专辑《Life in Small Spaces》——这两张专辑很容易被人们错过，事实证明，它们都是 Freaks Only FM 上轮播的热门歌曲。通过对每日涌现的新音乐进行分类，并以一种有凝聚力和一致的形式呈现，Freaks Only FM 可以说是一个很高的价值主张。

paras.en: “If we don’t do a better job of fostering and supporting new music, it’s going to disappear, or it’s just going to be for nepo babies that can afford to go on tour or for kids straight out of college who have this dream and then they burn out in two or three years after they realize it’s not going to get better anytime soon.”
paras.zh: “如果我们在培育和支持新音乐方面做得不好，它就会消失，或者只会是那些有能力去巡演的尼波婴儿，或者是那些怀揣着这个梦想的大学刚毕业的孩子，然后他们在意识到这种情况不会很快好转后，两三年后就会精疲力尽。”

paras.en: The difficulty of breaking new artists in 2026 is a recognized industry-wide issue, with streaming favoring catalog music, touring more expensive than ever and the general oversaturation of new music and fractured paths to finding it. “You see it with the festivals, where there’s a lot more legacy acts being booked,” says Holcombe. “The model now is booking three legacy acts at the top and having a smattering of new bands playing at three in the afternoon.”
paras.zh: 2026 年发掘新艺术家的难度是一个公认的全行业问题，流媒体青睐目录音乐，巡演费用比以往任何时候都高，新音乐普遍过度饱和，寻找新音乐的路径也支离破碎。 “你可以在音乐节上看到这一点，那里有更多的传统表演被预订，”霍尔科姆说。 “现在的模式是在顶级预订三场传统演出，并在下午三点有一些新乐队演出。”

paras.en: His mission to support new artists is one Holcombe is also extending into IRL events and more. Last November, he launched a Freaks Only residency at L.A.’s Club Tee Gee where he DJs every Friday. (The next event is Nov. 13.) He curated the August release Freaks Only: Eskimo Selects 2014 to 2026, a compilation of his favorite tracks from the second half of the Belgian label’s 25th anniversary and has also dipped his toes into the world of live promotion, doing a June Freaks Only Presents show at Teragram Ballroom with rising bands Famous Friend, Floats, and Camp Blu. The night sold 450 tickets and led to a new podcast that Holcombe and Famous Friend will launch later this month called Spin or Skip, a music hot takes program. Upcoming guests will include Asa Taccone of Electric Guest and Jack Quaid, from the Amazon superhero show The Boys.
paras.zh: 霍尔科姆支持新艺术家的使命之一也延伸到了现实生活等活动中。去年 11 月，他在洛杉矶的 Club Tee Gee 举办了 Freaks Only 驻场活动，每周五他都会在那里担任 DJ。 （下一次活动将于 11 月 13 日举行。）他策划了 8 月发行的《Freaks Only：Eskimo Selects 2014 to 2026》，这是该比利时唱片公司 25 周年纪念下半年他最喜欢的曲目的合辑，并且还涉足现场推广领域，与新兴乐队 Famous Friend、Floats 和 Camp Blu 一起在 Teragram Ballroom 举办了 6 月的 Freaks Only Presents 演出。当晚售出 450 张门票，Holcombe 和 Famous Friend 将于本月晚些时候推出一个名为“Spin or Skip”的新播客，这是一个热门音乐节目。即将到来的嘉宾包括 Electric Guest 的阿萨·塔科尼 (Asa Taccone) 和亚马逊超级英雄节目《男孩》中的杰克·奎德 (Jack Quiid)。

paras.en: For Holcombe, Freaks Only FM and all of these other new projects contribute to the same goal: that thrill of sharing great new music with people you care about.
paras.zh: 对于 Holcombe 来说，Freaks Only FM 和所有其他新项目都致力于实现同一个目标：与您关心的人分享伟大的新音乐的兴奋感。

paras.en: “There’s nothing I love more than hearing a great song for the first time and being able to share it,” Holcombe says. “Chasing that feeling is the driving force that keeps me going.”
paras.zh: “没有什么比第一次听到一首好歌曲并能够分享它更让我喜欢的了，”霍尔科姆说。 “追逐这种感觉是我前进的动力。”

articles.title: THAT’s a Halloween Song Now?! Some Unexpected Songs Seeing Streaming Bumps This Oct. 31
articles.author: Andrew Unterberger

paras.en: This week: A Halloween post-mortem, starring “Thriller,” Lady Gaga, and a handful of songs we would not have anticipated having to talk about this time of year.
paras.zh: 本周：万圣节尸检，由《Thriller》、Lady Gaga 主演，还有一些我们没想到每年这个时候都会谈论的歌曲。

paras.en: Songs You Won’t Take Home to Mother? Unexpected Spooky-Season Jams Emerge From Rick James, Camila Cabello and More
paras.zh: 你不会带回家给妈妈听的歌曲吗？瑞克·詹姆斯 (Rick James)、卡米拉·卡贝洛 (Camila Cabello) 等人带来意想不到的恐怖季即兴演奏

paras.en: As we find out every year, Halloween is truly in the playlist of the beholder, as songs that seem equally at home the other 364 days of the year to many still get tabbed by some as Oct. 31 standards.
paras.zh: 每年我们都会发现，万圣节确实是情人播放列表中的歌曲，因为对许多人来说，在一年中的其他 364 天中，这些歌曲仍然被一些人视为 10 月 31 日的标准。

paras.en: One of the biggest examples this year undoubtedly comes via Rick James’ 1981 funk classic “Super Freak,” whose sense of freakiness is much more traditionally sexy than spooky. However, with the “Freak” in its title and an arguable tinge of haunted-house energy to its new-wave-y synths, it’s become an unlikely Halloween perennial — streaming in the seven-digits (1.2 million official on-demand U.S. streams, to be exact) this Oct. 31 for the second year in a row, a 328% gain over the 273,000 streams the song racked up the prior Saturday (Oct. 24).
paras.zh: 今年最大的例子之一无疑是 Rick James 1981 年的放克经典歌曲《Super Freak》，其怪异感更多的是传统意义上的性感，而不是怪异。然而，由于其标题中的“Freak”以及新浪潮合成器中带有争议的鬼屋能量色彩，这首歌不太可能成为万圣节常青歌曲——今年 10 月 31 日的播放量已连续第二年达到七位数字（准确地说，美国官方点播流媒体量为 120 万次），比上周六（10 月 10 日）这首歌的流媒体播放量 273,000 次增长了 328%。 24）。

paras.en: Nearly as surprising is the addition to the Halloween canon of Camila Cabello’s DaBaby-featuring 2020 hit “My Oh My,” another song about a lyrical subject more threatening to parental approval than to personal safety, but with a slight melodic eeriness and an appropriate-enough lyric or two (“He comes alive at midnight”) to slip into Halloween playlists relatively inconspicuously. (In the case of “My Oh My,” there’s also a violent-skewing music video to give it slight slasher-soundtrack cred; music video associations have also helped Backstreet Boys’ “Everybody (Backstreet’s Back)”) — up 203% to 890,000 — become an Oct. 31 perennial.) Whatever the contributing factors, “My Oh My” also saw a huge Halloween bump, racking up 405,000 streams on Oct. 31, a 192% gain from the prior Saturday.
paras.zh: 几乎同样令人惊讶的是，卡米拉·卡贝洛 (Camila Cabello) 的 DaBaby 2020 年热门单曲《My Oh My》加入了万圣节经典，这是另一首关于抒情主题的歌曲，它更多地威胁到父母的认可，而不是个人安全，但旋律略显诡异，有一两句恰当的歌词（“他在午夜复活”），可以相对不引人注目地进入万圣节播放列表。 （就《My Oh My》而言，还有一段暴力倾向的音乐录影带，使其具有轻微的恐怖原声带信誉；音乐录影带协会还帮助后街男孩的《Everybody (Backstreet’s Back)》）——增长了 203%，达到 890,000 次——成为 10 月 31 日的常青歌曲。）无论促成因素如何，《My Oh My》在万圣节期间也出现了巨大的增长，收视率也一路飙升。 10 月 31 日播放量达到 405,000 次，比前周六增长 192%。

paras.en: Other emerging Oct. 31 favorites make more sense as Halloween songs, but not necessarily so much as Halloween hits. “My Girlfriend Is a Witch” would not be anyone’s normal idea of 2026 streaming-core, as a little-heard late-’60s nugget from L.A. psych-rockers October Country, who had no major chart history during its career. But whether through long-gestating virality or the whims of the Haunted Algorithm, “Witch” has become a spooky-season streaming staple, generating 493,000 Oct. 31 after posting just 82,000 the prior Saturday, a 505% gain.
paras.zh: 其他新兴的 10 月 31 日热门歌曲作为万圣节歌曲更有意义，但不一定像万圣节热门歌曲那样有意义。 《我的女友是女巫》不会是任何人对 2026 年流媒体核心歌曲的正常看法，因为它是来自洛杉矶心理摇滚乐队 October Country 的 60 年代末鲜为人知的金曲，该乐队在其职业生涯中没有任何重要的排行榜历史。但无论是通过长期酝酿的病毒式传播，还是闹鬼算法的突发奇想，《女巫》已经成为恐怖季流媒体的热门节目，10 月 31 日的观看量达到了 493,000 人，而前周六的观看量仅为 82,000 人，增长了 505%。

paras.en: What other tangentially connected and/or deeply obscure songs will become fright night staples in short order? Queen’s “Death on Two Legs”? Ariana Grande’s “Ghostin”? Adina Howard’s “Freak Like Me”? We’ll be on the lookout for new twists and turns in this spooky saga in the years to come. – ANDREW UNTERBERGER
paras.zh: 还有哪些无关紧要的和/或深刻晦涩的歌曲会在短时间内成为恐怖之夜的主打歌曲？女王的“两条腿的死亡”？阿丽亚娜格兰德的“幽灵”？阿迪娜·霍华德的《像我一样的怪胎》？在未来的几年里，我们将在这个怪异的传奇故事中寻找新的曲折。 – 安德鲁·安特伯格

paras.en: Is Lady Gaga Officially Halloween’s New Music Scream Queen?
paras.zh: Lady Gaga 正式成为万圣节新音乐尖叫女王吗？

paras.en: Who needs screams when you’re racking up streams? Lady Gaga dominated this year’s Halloween streaming gains with a trio of songs that make a strong case for her earning the Scream Queen Crown.
paras.zh: 当你在直播时谁需要尖叫声？ Lady Gaga 凭借三首歌曲主宰了今年万圣节的流媒体音乐盛宴，为她赢得尖叫女王桂冠提供了强有力的理由。

paras.en: On Halloween (Oct. 31), Mother Monster’s catalog received 10.57 million official on-demand U.S. streams, according to Luminate, marking an impressive 65% gain from the 6.39 million streams it collected the week prior (Oct. 24). “The Dead Dance,” her Emmy-nominated synth-pop soundtrack single for Wednesday season two, posted the biggest gain from her spooky-themed tracks. “Dance” earned 1.14 million official on-demand U.S. streams, up a jaw-dropping 414% from the 222,000 streams it pulled the week before (Oct. 24).
paras.zh: 根据 Luminate 的数据，万圣节（10 月 31 日），《Mother Monster》的美国官方点播流媒体播放量达到 1,057 万，较前一周（10 月 24 日）收集的 639 万流媒体播放量增长了 65%，令人印象深刻。她获得艾美奖提名的合成流行音乐单曲第二季的《The Dead Dance》在她的恐怖主题曲目中取得了最大的收获。 《舞动》在美国的官方点播流量达到了 114 万次，比前一周（10 月 24 日）的 22.2 万次增长了 414%，令人瞠目结舌。

paras.en: “The Dead Dance” appears on the reissue of Gaga’s 2025 Grammy-winning Mayhem album, which also houses the dance-pop smash “Abracadabra.” On Halloween, “Abracadabra” jumped 232% to over 1.04 million official streams, an impressive gain from the 313,000 streams it garnered on Oct. 24.
paras.zh: 《The Dead Dance》出现在 Gaga 2025 年格莱美获奖专辑《Mayhem》的重新发行版中，该专辑还收录了热门舞曲《Abracadabra》。万圣节当天，《Abracadabra》的官方播放量猛增 232%，超过 104 万次，较 10 月 24 日的 313,000 次播放量大幅增长。

paras.en: Gaga’s relationship with the Wednesday series actually began with the show’s first season, which revived her 2011 Born This Way deep cut “Bloody Mary,” thanks to fans using a sped-up version of the song in edits and fancams celebrating the titular character’s eye-catching dance. “Bloody” soared to 1.37 million official on-demand U.S. streams this Halloween, marking a 91% jump from the 717,000 streams it earned the week prior.
paras.zh: Gaga 与周三剧集的关系实际上始于该剧的第一季，该剧重演了她 2011 年的《Born This Way》深剪版《血腥玛丽》，这要归功于粉丝们在剪辑和粉丝视频中使用了这首歌的加速版本来庆祝这个同名角色引人注目的舞蹈。今年万圣节，《血腥》在美国的官方点播播放量飙升至 137 万次，较前一周的 717,000 次增加了 91%。

paras.en: As a pop auteur who’s always had an eye for the macabre, it’s not too much of a surprise to see so many new-age Halloween anthems emerge from Gaga’s catalog. Let’s see if she snags another one from the upcoming third season of Wednesday. — KYLE DENIS
paras.zh: 作为一个总是对恐怖事物有敏锐洞察力的流行音乐导演，看到 Gaga 的目录中出现如此多的新时代万圣节歌曲并不令人感到意外。让我们看看她是否能在周三即将到来的第三季中获得另一部作品。 — 凯尔·丹尼斯

paras.en: Did “Thriller” Bring More Screams Than Usual This Year?
paras.zh: 今年《惊悚片》的尖叫声比往年多吗？

paras.en: The best-performing song basically every Halloween season is of course Michael Jackson’s “Thriller,” which was already back in the top 20 of the Billboard Hot 100 for the chart dated Oct. 31 (released last week). Given how much all things Michael Jackson were back in the mainstream this year, and how catalog titles have been proving more culturally impactful than ever across the chart, we spent a lot of last week wondering if “Thriller” might be due for its best Halloween ever this year — and, for the first time, possibly even the No. 1 spot on the Hot 100?
paras.zh: 基本上每个万圣节季节表现最好的歌曲当然是迈克尔·杰克逊的《Thriller》，在 10 月 31 日的排行榜（上周发布）中，它已经重返 Billboard Hot 100 的前 20 名。考虑到迈克尔·杰克逊今年重新回归主流，以及专辑标题在整个排行榜上比以往任何时候都更具文化影响力，我们上周花了很多时间想知道“Thriller”是否会在今年迎来有史以来最好的万圣节——甚至可能首次登上热门 100 强的第一名？

paras.en: The results: conclusive, but perhaps not so decisive. “Thriller” racked up about 10.1 million official on-demand U.S. streams this Halloween, according to Luminate, with another 4 million on Friday (Oct. 30) and 2.3 million on Sunday for a full-weekend total of about 16.4 million. That’s up about 36% from the 12.1 million streams it amassed last Halloween weekend (when Oct. 31 fell on a Friday), and when the rest of the tracking week is added in, it should allow the song to pass its previous best full streaming week (17 million, Oct. 24-31, 2024).
paras.zh: 结果：结论性的，但也许不是那么决定性的。根据 Luminate 的数据，今年万圣节《惊悚片》在美国的官方点播播放量约为 1010 万，周五（10 月 30 日）又增加了 400 万，周日为 230 万，整个周末的总播放量约为 1640 万。这比上个万圣节周末（10 月 31 日是星期五）积累的 1210 万次流媒体增长了约 36%，如果加上跟踪周的剩余时间，这应该会让这首歌超越之前最好的完整流媒体周（2024 年 10 月 24 日至 31 日，1700 万次）。

paras.en: But will it be enough to propel the song to No. 1? Probably not — with “Thriller” predictably running out of steam post-Halloween weekend and “Choosin’ Texas” pacing somewhere between two and three million daily streams each day so far this week, the streaming edge “Thriller” has over “Texas” might not be more than a few million streams, which probably won’t be enough to make up for the considerable edge the still airwave-dominating “Texas” has in radio play. “Thriller” will have a better chance of beating out its prior Hot 100 peak (set back in 1984) of No. 4 — though even there, it will face competition from Tate McRae’s “Housewife” and Tame Impala and JENNIE’s similarly Halloween-boosted “Dracula.”
paras.zh: 但这足以将这首歌推向第一吗？可能不会——预计《Thriller》在万圣节周末后就会失去动力，而《Choosin' Texas》本周到目前为止每天的流媒体播放量在两到三百万之间，《Thriller》相对于《Texas》的流媒体优势可能不会超过几百万个流媒体，这可能不足以弥补仍在广播剧中占据主导地位的《Texas》的相当大优势。 《惊悚片》将有更好的机会击败之前在百强单曲榜上的巅峰（1984 年）排名第四的位置——尽管即便如此，它也将面临来自泰特·麦克雷的《家庭主妇》以及 Tame Impala 和 JENNIE 的类似万圣节推动的《德古拉》的竞争。

paras.en: Nevertheless, every year, “Thriller” continues to creep closer and closer to claiming the Hot 100’s Halloween top spot — and you have to imagine that one of these years, MJ will posthumously earn the last evil cackle on the chart.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，每年，《Thriller》都越来越接近万圣节百强单曲榜首的位置——你必须想象，在这些年里，MJ 死后将赢得排行榜上最后一个邪恶的笑声。

articles.title: MS NOW Bets On New Brand Campaign to Help It Ride Midterm Election Wave (Exclusive)
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: MS NOW is using the blue wave midterm election to launch a new brand campaign that it hopes keeps viewers engaged once the Democratic euphoria dies down.
paras.zh: MS NOW 正在利用中期选举的蓝潮发起一项新的品牌活动，希望在民主党的狂热消退后仍能吸引观众。

paras.en: The new campaign will launch this afternoon during Deadline: White House, The Hollywood Reporter has learned, and it will feature the new tagline “Now There’s More That Unites Us.”
paras.zh: 据《好莱坞报道》获悉，新活动将于今天下午在“截止日期：白宫”期间推出，其新口号将是“现在有更多让我们团结起来”。

paras.en: The initial spot, which you can watch below, is narrated by Rachel Maddow with appearances from a flurry of familiar faces from MS NOW like Eugene Daniels, Peter Alexander, Ali Velshi and Jen Psaki. The score features a new version of “America the Beautiful” as performed by 10-year-old America’s Got Talent alumni Zoe Erianna.
paras.zh: 您可以在下面观看第一段节目，由 Rachel Maddow 担任旁白，MS NOW 中的一众熟悉面孔如尤金·丹尼尔斯 (Eugene Daniels)、彼得·亚历山大 (Peter Alexander)、阿里·维尔希 (Ali Velshi) 和珍·普萨基 (Jen Psaki) 均出现在其中。该乐谱采用了新版本的《美丽的美国》，由 10 岁的《美国达人秀》校友佐伊·埃里安娜 (Zoe Erianna) 演唱。

paras.en: The spot is “inspired by the groundswell of participation, with millions of individuals making their voices heard, standing up for what they believe in,” MS NOW says, with “A celebration of the power of people showing up and the vital role MS NOW plays in telling their stories, helping voters understand the moment we’re living through, and keeping audiences connected to what comes next.”
paras.zh: MS NOW 表示，该广告的灵感来自“参与热潮，数百万人发出自己的声音，捍卫自己的信仰”，“庆祝人们的力量，以及 MS NOW 在讲述他们的故事、帮助选民了解我们正在经历的时刻以及让观众了解接下来会发生什么方面所发挥的重要作用。”

paras.en: The spot ends by asking viewers to “become a member” as MS NOW continues to roll out its membership platform, which combined a live feed of its programming alongside original content, Q&As, and other features like wellness programming.
paras.zh: 该广告最后要求观众“成为会员”，因为 MS NOW 继续推出其会员平台，该平台将节目直播与原创内容、问答和健康节目等其他功能结合起来。

articles.title: Philo Adds Bravo to Its Streaming Lineup After Years of Subscriber Requests
articles.author: Sophie Dunne

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: As of Nov. 5, Philo now includes Bravo, adding one of reality television’s biggest networks to its live TV streaming lineup. The addition marks Philo’s first partnership with NBCUniversal and gives fans a new place to catch popular franchises like The Real Housewives and Below Deck alongside other Bravo favorites. The network is available through Philo’s live TV offering, with subscription plans starting at $25 per month.
paras.zh: 截至 11 月 5 日，Philo 现已纳入 Bravo，将最大的电视真人秀网络之一纳入其直播电视流媒体阵容。此次合作标志着 Philo 与 NBCUniversal 的首次合作，为粉丝提供了一个新的场所，可以观看《The Real Housewives》和《Below Deck》等热门剧集以及其他 Bravo 热门剧集。该网络可通过 Philo 的直播电视服务获得，订阅计划起价为每月 25 美元。

paras.en: What Bravo Shows Can Fans Watch on Philo?
paras.zh: 粉丝可以在 Philo 上观看哪些 Bravo 节目？

paras.en: Bravo brings a year-round selection of reality programming to Philo, including The Real Housewives franchises, Below Deck, Summer House, Southern Charm and Next Gen NYC. Viewers can also tune in to Watch What Happens Live with Andy Cohen for celebrity interviews and conversations about the latest reality TV drama. The live channel is available now, with on-demand episodes expected to arrive later.
paras.zh: Bravo 为 Philo 带来了全年精选的真人秀节目，包括《The Real Housewives》系列、《Below Deck》、《Summer House》、《Southern Charm》和《Next Gen NYC》。观众还可以收看《安迪·科恩现场直播》，了解名人采访和有关最新真人秀电视剧的对话。直播频道现已上线，点播剧集预计稍后推出。

paras.en: With its expanded channel lineup and plans starting at $25 per month, Philo positions itself as a more affordable alternative to competitors that stream Bravo, like Hulu + Live TV, Peacock and YouTube TV.
paras.zh: 凭借其扩大的频道阵容和每月 25 美元起的计划，Philo 将自己定位为比 Hulu + Live TV、Peacock 和 YouTube TV 等流媒体 Bravo 竞争对手更实惠的替代品。

paras.en: Beyond Bravo, Philo offers a packed entertainment lineup featuring networks such as A&E, AMC, BET, Discovery, Hallmark Channel, HGTV, History, ID, Lifetime, MTV, Nickelodeon, OWN, TLC, VH1 and WE tv.
paras.zh: 除了 Bravo 之外，Philo 还提供丰富的娱乐节目，包括 A&E、AMC、BET、Discovery、Hallmark Channel、HGTV、History、ID、Lifetime、MTV、Nickelodeon、OWN、TLC、VH1 和 WE tv 等网络。

paras.en: Philo is a live TV streaming service that combines traditional cable networks with free ad-supported programming and premium streaming content. Its paid subscriptions start at $25 per month and feature more than 70 entertainment and lifestyle networks.
paras.zh: Philo 是一项直播电视流媒体服务，它将传统有线网络与免费广告支持的节目和优质流媒体内容相结合。其付费订阅起价为每月 25 美元，涵盖 70 多个娱乐和生活方式网络。

articles.title: Dark Slope to Open New Virtual Production Stage in Vancouver (Exclusive)
articles.author: Etan Vlessing

paras.en: Virtual production studio operator Dark Slope has unveiled plans to build and open a new virtual production stage at North Shore Studios in Vancouver.
paras.zh: 虚拟制作工作室运营商 Dark Slope 公布了在温哥华北岸工作室建造和开放新虚拟制作舞台的计划。

paras.en: Located within the popular eight-stage suburban Vancouver campus, the new LED stage, to launch in December, will use assets from former Pixomondo LED stages in Toronto and Vancouver.
paras.zh: 新的 LED 舞台位于温哥华郊区热门的八舞台园区内，将于 12 月推出，将使用多伦多和温哥华前 Pixomondo LED 舞台的资产。

paras.en: That follows Dark Slope acquiring Sony Entertainment’s Pixomondo virtual production stage at Pinewood Toronto Studios, and certain assets from Pixomondo’s stages in Vancouver after Sony in March 2026 unveiled plans to shutter the visual effects firm to focus VFX work at Sony Pictures Imageworks, headquartered in the west-coast Canadian city.
paras.zh: 在此之前，Dark Slope 收购了索尼娱乐公司位于多伦多 Pinewood 多伦多工作室的 Pixomondo 虚拟制作舞台，以及索尼于 2026 年 3 月宣布关闭视觉效果公司的计划，将视觉特效工作集中在总部位于加拿大西海岸城市的 Sony Pictures Imageworks 上，并收购了位于温哥华的 Pixomondo 舞台的某些资产。

paras.en: Amy Lang, president of North Shore Studios, welcomed Dark Slope opening an LED stage on her campus. “Dark Slope’s virtual production capabilities are a natural complement to our existing infrastructure, giving producers access to advanced virtual technology alongside our soundstages and resources, and further strengthening Vancouver’s position as a premier destination for film and television production,” Lang said in a statement.
paras.zh: North Shore Studios 总裁 Amy Lang 对 Dark Slope 在其校园内开设 LED 舞台表示欢迎。朗在一份声明中表示：“Dark Slope 的虚拟制作能力是对我们现有基础设施的自然补充，使制片人能够利用先进的虚拟技术以及我们的摄影棚和资源，并进一步巩固温哥华作为电影和电视制作首选目的地的地位。”

paras.en: Virtual production broadly refers to visual effects work done in real time on set. Dark Slope for its new Vancouver stage will use LED screens, motion tracking cameras and computer hardware, along with rigging and trusses, that it brought over from the PXO Clara stages in Vancouver earlier shut down and disassembled.
paras.zh: 虚拟制作广义上是指在片场实时完成的视觉效果工作。 Dark Slope 的温哥华新舞台将使用 LED 屏幕、运动跟踪摄像机和计算机硬件，以及索具和桁架，这些都是从早先关闭和拆卸的温哥华 PXO Clara 舞台上运来的。

paras.en: The new LED stage at North Shore Studios will also use assets from the Pinewood Toronto Studios stage run by the former PXO Clara that were used in virtual production shoots for Star Trek franchise TV series and The Handmaid’s Tale.
paras.zh: 北岸工作室的新 LED 舞台还将使用由前 PXO Clara 运营的 Pinewood Toronto Studios 舞台的资产，这些资产曾用于《星际迷航》系列电视剧和《使女的故事》的虚拟制作拍摄。

paras.en: Dark Slope has already offered in-studio and on-location virtual production for TV shows like Heated Rivalry, Ginny & Georgia, The Boys, its spinoff Gen V and Disasters at Sea. Adding a new virtual production stage in Vancouver to its portfolio underlines the company’s bet on growing demand from producers of scripted and unscripted productions to use LED volumes to create visual environments.
paras.zh: Dark Slope 已经为《激烈的竞争》、《金妮与乔治亚》、《男孩》、其衍生剧《第五代》和《海上灾难》等电视节目提供工作室和现场虚拟制作。在温哥华的投资组合中增加一个新的虚拟制作舞台，突显了该公司对脚本和无脚本制作制作者日益增长的需求的押注，即使用 LED 体来创建视觉环境。

paras.en: That’s as major studios and streamers look to cut VFX-heavy movie and TV series budget costs as AI tools advance, and as those savings may continue to be found in incentive-rich Canada. “British Columbia’s production industry is built on exceptional crews, world-leading visual effects companies and a longstanding culture of innovation. We can’t wait to become a new resource in the local industry,” Dan Fill, president of Dark Slope, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 随着人工智能工具的进步，主要工作室和流媒体希望削减以视觉特效为主的电影和电视剧预算成本，而这些节省可能会继续在激励措施丰富的加拿大找到。 “不列颠哥伦比亚省的制作业建立在优秀的工作人员、世界领先的视觉效果公司和悠久的创新文化的基础上。我们迫不及待地想成为当地行业的新资源，”Dark Slope 总裁 Dan Fill 在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: His company also intends to open a consulting business to support custom virtual production builds with expertise and infrastructure at any location across Canada and globally. Dark Slope will offer to design, build and operate custom LED stages of any size or configuration at studios or production locations internationally as part of its consulting business.
paras.zh: 他的公司还打算开设咨询业务，以在加拿大和全球任何地点利用专业知识和基础设施支持定制虚拟制作构建。作为其咨询业务的一部分，Dark Slope 将在国际工作室或制作地点提供设计、建造和运营任何尺寸或配置的定制 LED 舞台。

articles.title: IRS announces bigger estate and gift tax exemption for 2027

paras.en: The Internal Revenue Service has announced a higher estate and gift tax exemption for 2027.
paras.zh: 美国国税局 (Internal Revenue Service) 宣布 2027 年遗产税和赠与税豁免金额更高。

paras.en: In its announcement Thursday, the agency increased the federal "basic exclusion amount" to $15.48 million per person for 2027, up from $15 million in 2026. The exemptions apply to tax-free transfers during life and at death.
paras.zh: 该机构在周四的公告中，将联邦“基本免税额”从 2026 年的 1500 万美元增加到 2027 年的每人 1548 万美元。这些豁免适用于生前和死亡时的免税转移。

paras.en: State estate and inheritance tax exemptions can be lower.
paras.zh: 州遗产税和遗产税的免税额可能会较低。

paras.en: The IRS also increased figures for dozens of other provisions, including federal income tax brackets, the capital gains tax brackets and eligibility for the earned income tax credit, among others.
paras.zh: 美国国税局还增加了数十项其他条款的数字，包括联邦所得税级、资本利得税级和赚取所得税抵免的资格等。

paras.en: The inflation adjustments for 2027 come as Americans wrestle with affordability amid the rising cost of housing, groceries, gasoline and other living expenses.
paras.zh: 2027 年的通胀调整之际，美国人在住房、食品杂货、汽油和其他生活费用不断上涨的情况下努力应对负担能力。

paras.en: President Donald Trump's "big beautiful bill" increased the estate and gift tax exemption to $15 million per person. Without the change from Congress, the exemption would have reverted to 2017 levels — $5 million plus an inflation adjustment — after 2025, which spurred proactive estate planning from ultra-wealthy families before the legislation.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统的“大而美丽的法案”将遗产税和赠与税豁免额提高到每人 1500 万美元。如果国会没有做出改变，2025 年之后的豁免将恢复到 2017 年的水平——500 万美元加上通货膨胀调整——这刺激了超级富裕家庭在立法之前积极进行遗产规划。

paras.en: Under current law, few families are subject to federal estate taxes. For 2026, families will file about 6,890 federal estate tax returns, and roughly 3,900 will be taxable, according to estimates from the Tax Policy Center, a think tank.
paras.zh: 根据现行法律，很少有家庭需要缴纳联邦遗产税。根据智库税收政策中心的估计，到 2026 年，家庭将提交约 6,890 份联邦遗产税申报表，其中约 3,900 份需要纳税。

articles.title: AI meltdown: Chip stocks and neoclouds plunge, pushing Nasdaq to worst day since April 2025

paras.en: Chipmakers plummeted on Thursday, with Nvidia pushing the Nasdaq toward its worst day in 19 months, after this week's midterm election results raised concerns on Wall Street that the artificial intelligence buildout is poised to slow down. Neoclouds like CoreWeave tumbled for a second straight day.
paras.zh: 芯片制造商周四暴跌，英伟达将纳斯达克指数推向 19 个月来最糟糕的一天，此前本周的中期选举结果引发了华尔街对人工智能建设将放缓的担忧。像 CoreWeave 这样的 Neoclouds 连续第二天下跌。

paras.en: Qualcomm contributed to the selloff after issuing a disappointing earnings forecast for the current quarter. Qualcomm and Nvidia both dropped about 8%.
paras.zh: 高通公司发布令人失望的本季度盈利预测后，造成了抛售。高通和英伟达均下跌约 8%。

paras.en: The environment has gone from bad to worse for companies intimately tied to AI infrastructure, as the combination of rising interest rates, ballooning capital needs and the Democratic sweep in Congress has led to increased fears that wide swaths of the market are going to be weighed down by too much debt and too little revenue.
paras.zh: 对于与人工智能基础设施密切相关的公司来说，环境已经变得越来越糟，因为利率上升、资本需求膨胀以及民主党在国会的大获全胜，这些因素的结合导致人们越来越担心大部分市场将受到债务过多和收入过少的拖累。

paras.en: "The technology is still going to continue on in terms of its development, but if there is a slowdown in the actual development and the buildings and the infrastructure and so forth, that's what stocks are going to trade off," said Peter Boockvar, chief investment officer at OnePoint BFG Wealth Partners, in an interview with CNBC's "Squawk on the Street."
paras.zh: OnePoint BFG Wealth Partners 首席投资官彼得·布克瓦尔 (Peter Boockvar) 在接受 CNBC 节目《Squawk on the Street》采访时表示：“该技术仍将继续发展，但如果实际开发、建筑和基础设施等出现放缓，股市就会受到影响。”

paras.en: Advanced Micro Devices, Micron and Applied Materials all suffered double-digit percentage losses on Thursday. Elon Musk, who contributed hundreds of millions of dollars to try and get Republicans elected in Texas and elsewhere, saw shares of his public companies, SpaceX and Tesla, tumble 7% and 10%, respectively.
paras.zh: Advanced Micro Devices、Micron 和 Applied Materials 周四均出现两位数百分比亏损。埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 捐献了数亿美元，试图让共和党在德克萨斯州和其他地方当选，他的上市公司 SpaceX 和特斯拉的股价分别下跌了 7% 和 10%。

paras.en: In Tuesday's election, the states with the most ambitious AI data center plans all turned blue. Democrats won key contests for governor and the Senate in Texas and Ohio, while also coming up victorious in the gubernatorial race in Georgia, where Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff also cruised to reelection.
paras.zh: 在周二的选举中，人工智能数据中心计划最雄心勃勃的州全部变成了蓝色。民主党赢得了德克萨斯州和俄亥俄州州长和参议院的关键竞选，同时也在佐治亚州州长竞选中获胜，民主党参议员乔恩·奥索夫也顺利连任。

paras.en: There were 41 local ballot measures in 10 states up for a vote on Tuesday that would place restrictions on the construction of data centers in different ways, according to Ballotpedia. Voters sided against data centers in each measure except one in Harwood, North Dakota, according to an analysis by Ballotpedia and additional results gathered by CNBC on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 据Ballotpedia报道，周二，10个州的41项地方投票措施将进行投票，这些措施将以不同的方式限制数据中心的建设。根据 Ballotpedia 的分析和 CNBC 周三收集的其他结果，除了北达科他州哈伍德的一项措施外，选民在每一项措施中都反对数据中心。

paras.en: On Wednesday night, at the Wall Street Journal Tech conference, Meta President Dina Powell McCormick told the audience that building data centers is "going to be harder" following the elections. She added that one of the victorious governors had said that, "As soon as we get past the inauguration, let's meet because we don't want to lose this investment in our town. We don't want these jobs to go elsewhere," according to the Journal.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，在《华尔街日报》科技会议上，Meta 总裁迪娜·鲍威尔·麦考密克 (Dina Powell McCormick) 告诉观众，选举后建设数据中心“将变得更加困难”。她补充说，一位获胜的州长曾表示，“就职典礼结束后，我们就见面，因为我们不想失去对我们镇的这项投资。我们不想让这些工作流向其他地方，”据《华尔街日报》报道。

paras.en: Meta, like its hyperscaler peers — Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft — has laid out an ambitious path for infrastructure development, with spending plans that extend well past $100 billion a year. Meta went free cash flow negative in the latest quarter, joining Alphabet and Amazon, which turned negative in the prior period.
paras.zh: Meta 与 Alphabet、亚马逊和微软等超大规模同行一样，为基础设施开发制定了雄心勃勃的道路，每年的支出计划远远超过 1000 亿美元。 Meta 在最近一个季度的自由现金流为负，加入了上一季度为负的 Alphabet 和亚马逊的行列。

paras.en: Qualcomm on Wednesday became the latest chipmaker to report booming growth in its data center business, though it's still a relatively small unit for the company. Qualcomm had $650 million in data center revenue during the quarter, mostly from customizing and connectivity work, CEO Cristiano Amon said.
paras.zh: 高通周三成为最新一家报告其数据中心业务蓬勃发展的芯片制造商，尽管它对于该公司来说仍然是一个相对较小的部门。高通首席执行官克里斯蒂亚诺·阿蒙 (Cristiano Amon) 表示，该季度数据中心收入为 6.5 亿美元，主要来自定制和连接工作。

paras.en: "We don't have a demand issue; it's a supply issue," Amon told CNBC in an interview. "If I had more supply, I would probably be doing better."
paras.zh: 阿蒙在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“我们没有遇到需求问题，而是供应问题。” “如果我有更多的供应，我可能会做得更好。”

paras.en: The problem for Qualcomm and fellow chipmakers Intel and AMD is that the global memory shortage is jacking up prices, making it harder to get key supplies and leading to surging prices for consumer devices.
paras.zh: 高通以及其他芯片制造商英特尔和 AMD 面临的问题是，全球内存短缺正在推高价格，导致关键供应变得更加困难，并导致消费设备价格飙升。

paras.en: Intel last week reported a 78% jump in data center revenue, but the stock got crushed due to a weaker-than-expected forecast from the memory shortage. And AMD said this week that sales in its data center business more than doubled in the latest period.
paras.zh: 英特尔上周公布数据中心收入增长 78%，但由于内存短缺导致的预测低于预期，该股受到重挫。 AMD 本周表示，最近一段时间其数据中心业务的销售额增长了一倍多。

paras.en: Investors are looking past the numbers and questioning the sustainability of that growth, and whether buyers of the technology will be able to put it all to use.
paras.zh: 投资者正在忽略这些数字，并质疑这种增长的可持续性，以及该技术的买家是否能够充分利用它。

paras.en: "There's going to be a knee-jerk reaction, and that could lead to some delays, and that's going to be some concerns," Richard Clode, a portfolio manager at Janus Henderson, told "Squawk on the Street." "We're not going to solve for that in terms of knowing the answers to that anytime soon, unfortunately."
paras.zh: 骏利亨德森 (Janus Henderson) 的投资组合经理理查德·克洛德 (Richard Clode) 告诉《Squawk on the Street》节目：“将会出现下意识的反应，这可能会导致一些延误，这将会引起一些担忧。” “不幸的是，我们不会很快就知道答案来解决这个问题。”

paras.en: — CNBC's MacKenzie Sigalos contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的 MacKenzie Sigalos 对本报告做出了贡献。

paras.en: WATCH: CNBC's full interview with Janus Henderson's Richard Clode
paras.zh: 观看：CNBC 对 Janus Henderson 的 Richard Clode 的完整采访

articles.title: Top Democrats call to rein in AI buildout after midterms sweep: 'National data center moratorium now'

paras.en: After a big win in the U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday, some Democrats are already signaling they want to take on the artificial build-out, specifically data centers.
paras.zh: 在周二美国中期选举取得巨大胜利后，一些民主党人已经表示他们希望进行人工扩建，特别是数据中心。

paras.en: In a post on X, Sen. Bernie Sanders, I-Vt., touted referendums across the U.S. on Tuesday where voters in localities approved restrictions on data centers. Sanders, who caucuses with the Democrats, said the message to political leaders is clear.
paras.zh: 在 X 上的一篇帖子中，佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯 (Bernie Sanders) 吹捧了周二美国各地的全民公投，各地选民批准了对数据中心的限制。与民主党一起参加党团会议的桑德斯表示，向政治领导人传达的信息是明确的。

paras.en: "National data center moratorium now," he wrote in the post. "Americans don't want Big Tech oligarchs wrecking the environment, gutting jobs and threatening humanity's future."
paras.zh: “国家数据中心现在暂停，”他在帖子中写道。 “美国人不希望大型科技寡头破坏环境、减少就业机会并威胁人类的未来。”

paras.en: In another post on X, Rep. Yassamin Ansari, D-Ariz., wrote that pausing AI development needs to be a top priority for the large Democratic majority in the House on Day 1. Rep. Greg Casar, D-Texas, the chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, amplified the post and said, "Yes!"
paras.zh: 在 X 上的另一篇帖子中，亚利桑那州民主党众议员亚萨明·安萨里 (Yassamin Ansari) 写道，暂停人工智能开发需要成为众议院民主党多数派第一天的首要任务。国会进步核心小组主席、得克萨斯州民主党众议员格雷格·卡萨尔 (Greg Casar) 放大了该帖子并表示：“是的！”

paras.en: According to the CNBC Voter Poll, 56% of voters said AI and data centers were a crucial or major factor in their decision at the ballot box. Of those voters, 65% said they cast a ballot for a Democratic candidate for Congress.
paras.zh: 根据 CNBC 选民民意调查，56% 的选民表示人工智能和数据中心是他们在投票箱中做出决定的关键或主要因素。在这些选民中，65% 表示他们投票给民主党国会候选人。

paras.en: Stocks linked to the artificial intelligence build-out declined slightly on Wednesday in the wake of the election, but the selling intensified on Thursday as investors worried Democratic wins could have a real impact on data center construction. Chip stocks led the decline. The iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) tumbled nearly 9% on Tuesday. Nvidia declined 8%, while Advanced Micro Devices sunk more than 14%.
paras.zh: 选举后，与人工智能建设相关的股票周三小幅下跌，但周四抛售加剧，因为投资者担心民主党的胜利可能对数据中心建设产生真正的影响。芯片股领跌。 iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX) 周二下跌近 9%。 Nvidia 下跌 8%，Advanced Micro Devices 下跌超过 14%。

paras.en: Democrats who flipped critical races on Tuesday also singled out big tech companies and data centers.
paras.zh: 周二扭转关键竞选的民主党人还特别提到了大型科技公司和数据中心。

paras.en: South Carolina Democrat Annie Andrews, who flipped a Senate seat in the state on Tuesday, launched a website during the campaign that branded her opponent — Sen. Darline Graham — "data center Darline."
paras.zh: 周二，南卡罗来纳州民主党人安妮·安德鲁斯(Annie Andrews)推翻了该州的参议院席位，她在竞选期间推出了一个网站，将她的对手参议员达林·格雷厄姆(Darline Graham)称为“数据中心达林”。

paras.en: In her victory speech on Tuesday, Andrews said voters chose a South Carolina "where decisions about communities are made by the people who live in our communities, not the billionaires or data center companies in Washington D.C."
paras.zh: 安德鲁斯在周二的胜利演讲中表示，选民选择了南卡罗来纳州，“社区的决定是由居住在我们社区的人们做出的，而不是华盛顿特区的亿万富翁或数据中心公司”。

paras.en: Ohio Democrat Sherrod Brown, who is heading back to the Senate after defeating incumbent Republican Sen. Jon Husted on Tuesday, said in his victory speech, "I do not work for data centers."
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州民主党人谢罗德·布朗周二击败现任共和党参议员乔恩·赫斯特德后返回参议院，他在胜利演讲中表示，“我不为数据中心工作。”

paras.en: Democratic governors also attacked data centers in their victory speeches. Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro, who signed an executive order in August to slow data center development, said big tech companies shouldn't determine residents' futures. "Instead, the folks in our local communities get the final say," he said.
paras.zh: 民主党州长也在胜利演讲中攻击了数据中心。宾夕法尼亚州州长乔什·夏皮罗 (Josh Shapiro) 在 8 月份签署了一项减缓数据中心发展的行政命令，他表示大型科技公司不应该决定居民的未来。 “相反，我们当地社区的人们拥有最终决定权，”他说。

paras.en: Perhaps most important to the data center build-out is Texas, which is home to 27% of planned data center capacity, according to Wells Fargo.
paras.zh: 富国银行表示，对于数据中心扩建最重要的可能是德克萨斯州，该州拥有 27% 的数据中心规划容量。

paras.en: Gina Hinojosa, the Democrat who ousted incumbent Republican Gov. Greg Abbott, didn't address data centers directly in her victory speech, though they played a key role in her campaign.
paras.zh: 驱逐现任共和党州长格雷格·阿博特的民主党人吉娜·伊诺霍萨(Gina Hinojosa)在她的胜利演讲中没有直接谈到数据中心，尽管数据中心在她的竞选活动中发挥了关键作用。

paras.en: "When I am governor, I will issue a moratorium, a ban, on all data center approvals until laws can be passed by the legislature to protect Texans," she said in a video posted to her X in late October. "This is about one fight. Is this going to be a Texas that is by and for the people, or is this the billionaire's world and we just live here? Data centers are part of that fight."
paras.zh: “当我担任州长时，我将暂停、禁止所有数据中心的审批，直到立法机关通过保护德克萨斯人的法律，”她在 10 月底发布到她的 X 的视频中说道。 “这是一场战斗。这将是一个民有、民享的德克萨斯州，还是亿万富翁的世界，而我们只是住在这里？数据中心是这场战斗的一部分。”

articles.title: Hundreds of stunning ice age drawings discovered inside Spanish cave

paras.en: For decades, Cova de la Font Major has been a tourist destination in northeastern Spain. Despite all the visitors who have passed through the cave, only now are archaeologists revealing its secret: hundreds of stunning ice age rock engravings, including a rare depiction of a bear.
paras.zh: 几十年来，Cova de la Font Major 一直是西班牙东北部的旅游胜地。尽管有很多游客穿过这个洞穴，但考古学家直到现在才揭示了它的秘密：数百个令人惊叹的冰河时代岩石雕刻，其中包括罕见的熊描绘。

paras.en: In a new study published in the journal Antiquity this week, researchers describe the discovery of 280 Paleolithic engravings at the large, underground cave in Espluga de Francolí, Spain. The cave was first excavated in 1957—since then thousands of people have likely been in it, and some even graffitied the walls without realizing they were disturbing ice age art, the researchers say.
paras.zh: 在本周《Antiquity》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，研究人员描述了在西班牙埃斯普卢加德弗兰科利的大型地下洞穴中发现的 280 件旧石器时代雕刻。研究人员表示，该洞穴于 1957 年首次被挖掘，从那时起，可能已有数千人进入其中，有些人甚至在墙壁上涂鸦，但没有意识到它们正在扰乱冰河时代的艺术。

paras.en: The find is among the largest collections of cave art on the Iberian Peninsula. The engravings include 55 animal figures such as horses, deer and at least one bear, as well as less recognizable forms, such as parallel lines and an unusual group of loops.
paras.zh: 该发现是伊比利亚半岛最大的洞穴艺术收藏之一。这些雕刻包括 55 个动物形象，例如马、鹿和至少一只熊，以及不太容易辨认的形式，例如平行线和一组不寻常的环。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: It’s unclear how the engravings went so long without being noticed. In a dark cave, it may have been harder to spot the etchings than other forms of rock art such as paintings, says Míriam Salas-Altès, a co-author of the paper and a Ph.D. student at University of Rovira i Virgili and the Catalan Institute of Human Paleoecology and Social Evolution (IPHES-CERCA), both in Spain.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚这些雕刻是如何在这么长时间内没有被注意到的。该论文的合著者、该论文的博士生米里亚姆·萨拉斯-阿尔特斯 (Míriam Salas-Altès) 表示，在黑暗的洞穴中，可能比绘画等其他形式的岩石艺术更难发现蚀刻图案。西班牙罗维拉维吉利大学和加泰罗尼亚人类古生态学和社会进化研究所（IPHES-CERCA）的学生。

paras.en: Even wearing a helmet with a forward-facing light might not fully illuminate markings either. And the walls are “full” of graffiti, Salas-Altès says. To the untrained eye, Paleolithic engravings may have been difficult to differentiate from modern markings, she adds.
paras.zh: 即使佩戴带有前向灯的头盔也可能无法完全照亮标记。萨拉斯-阿尔特斯说，墙上“满是”涂鸦。她补充说，对于未经训练的人来说，旧石器时代的雕刻可能很难与现代标记区分开来。

paras.en: This type of cave art is also rare for this part of Spain. Before now, most Paleolithic cave art in the area has been found in the Franco-Cantabrian region, an area spanning the border of Spain and France. Just two cave figures had previously been found in Catalonia, Salas-Altès says.
paras.zh: 这种类型的洞穴艺术在西班牙这一地区也很罕见。在此之前，该地区大多数旧石器时代的洞穴艺术都是在跨越西班牙和法国边境的弗朗哥-坎塔布连地区发现的。萨拉斯-阿尔特斯说，此前在加泰罗尼亚只发现了两个洞穴人物。

paras.en: Today tourists’ access to the cave has been limited to protect the engravings, which were first discovered in 2019.
paras.zh: 如今，为了保护 2019 年首次发现的石刻，游客进入该洞穴受到限制。

paras.en: Salas-Altès hopes to continue working to decipher the 280 engravings, as well as to understand the history of human presence in the cave. It’s unclear whether early humans used this cave simply for shelter, ritual practices or something else, she says.
paras.zh: Salas-Altès 希望继续努力破译 280 个雕刻，并了解人类在洞穴中存在的历史。她说，目前尚不清楚早期人类是否只是将这个洞穴用作庇护所、仪式活动或其他用途。

paras.en: And there may be more engravings to find—some galleries within Cova de la Font Major, for instance, have been filled with sediment over the years, Salas-Altès says, and opening them up could reveal even more rock art.
paras.zh: 萨拉斯-阿尔特斯说，可能还会发现更多的雕刻——例如，Cova de la Font Major内的一些画廊多年来已经充满了沉积物，打开它们可能会发现更多的岩石艺术。

articles.title: The Great Pacific Garbage Patch is changing the color of the ocean

paras.en: The Great Pacific Garbage Patch, an area in the Pacific Ocean where debris naturally accumulates, is full of tiny bits of plastic—so full, in fact, that it seems to be changing the color of the ocean.
paras.zh: 太平洋大垃圾带是太平洋上垃圾自然堆积的区域，里面充满了微小的塑料碎片——事实上，塑料碎片如此之多，以至于似乎正在改变海洋的颜色。

paras.en: The ocean is, of course, famously blue. That’s because of the wavelength of light it reflects. Water scatters shorter wavelengths, which we see as blue—while absorbing longer wavelengths, such as red or orange. Additives in the ocean, including phytoplankton, algae and sediment, can affect its color.
paras.zh: 当然，海洋是出了名的蓝色。这是因为它反射的光的波长。水会散射较短的波长，我们将其视为蓝色，同时吸收较长的波长，例如红色或橙色。海洋中的添加剂，包括浮游植物、藻类和沉积物，会影响其颜色。

paras.en: Microplastics, too, can affect the color of the ocean. They can be made of all sorts of materials, including polystyrene, polypropylene, polyester, and more, explains Daniel Koestner, a postdoctoral fellow at the University of Bergen in Norway, and tend to scatter more light than organic material in the ocean.
paras.zh: 微塑料也会影响海洋的颜色。挪威卑尔根大学博士后研究员 Daniel Koestner 解释说，它们可以由各种材料制成，包括聚苯乙烯、聚丙烯、聚酯等，并且往往比海洋中的有机材料散射更多的光。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: To better understand how microplastics may have influenced the ocean’s color, Koestner and his colleagues looked at 20 years of satellite data from the spot in the ocean with perhaps the most of plastic—the Great Pacific Garbage Patch, a zone between Hawaii and California where trash trapped by ocean currents accumulates.
paras.zh: 为了更好地了解微塑料如何影响海洋的颜色，Koestner 和他的同事研究了 20 年来来自可能塑料含量最多的海洋地点——大太平洋垃圾带——夏威夷和加利福尼亚州之间的一个区域的卫星数据，那里被洋流捕获的垃圾堆积起来。

paras.en: Between 2002 and 2022, the researchers found, waters near the garbage patch have gotten brighter in both blue and green wavelengths compared with surrounding areas. The results, published in the journal Communications Earth & Environment on Thursday, don’t yet prove that microplastics have directly brightened the ocean, the researchers emphasize, though their findings are backed up by lab experiments with microplastics. But without taking direct ocean samples, it’s hard to know for sure what’s causing the ocean’s color to change.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，2002 年至 2022 年间，与周围地区相比，垃圾带附近水域的蓝色和绿色波长都变得更亮。研究人员强调，周四发表在《通讯地球与环境》杂志上的研究结果尚未证明微塑料直接照亮了海洋，尽管他们的发现得到了微塑料实验室实验的支持。但如果不直接采集海洋样本，就很难确定是什么导致海洋颜色发生变化。

paras.en: “We’re still one step away from proving definitively that microplastics are causing the shift in color that that we’re seeing,” adds study co-author Shea Cheatham, a Ph.D. student also at the University of Bergen. “We just have to get in there [to the garbage patch] to verify.”
paras.zh: 研究合著者、博士生 Shea Cheatham 补充道：“距离明确证明微塑料正在导致我们所看到的颜色变化，我们还差一步。”也是卑尔根大学的学生。 “我们只需要进入那里（垃圾场）进行验证即可。”

paras.en: Still, the findings underscore just how omnipresent these pollutants are.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，研究结果还是强调了这些污染物是多么普遍。

paras.en: Previous research has shown that microplastics can harm microbes in the ocean, for instance, and can change the behavior of fish. They also accumulate in seafood we eat.
paras.zh: 例如，先前的研究表明，微塑料会损害海洋中的微生物，并会改变鱼类的行为。它们也积聚在我们吃的海鲜中。

paras.en: If the researchers’ approach can be verified, Koestner hopes it can be used to identify other areas across the world where microplastics have accumulated.
paras.zh: 如果研究人员的方法能够得到验证，科斯特纳希望它可以用来识别世界上微塑料积累的其他地区。

paras.en: “That would mean that we have a target area for cleaning up,” he says.
paras.zh: “这意味着我们有一个清理目标区域，”他说。

articles.title: These are the doctors and scientists elected in the 2026 midterms

paras.en: Tuesday’s midterm elections saw dozens of historic wins across the country. Some of these newly elected officials to the Senate, House of Representatives and state governorships are health care professionals, scientists or engineers.
paras.zh: 周二的中期选举在全国各地取得了数十场历史性胜利。这些新当选的参议院、众议院和州长官员中有一些是医疗保健专业人员、科学家或工程师。

paras.en: The current Congress includes 20 physicians, a record that the upcoming Congress could surpass.
paras.zh: 本届国会有 20 名医生，下一届国会可能会超越这一记录。

paras.en: Here’s what you need to know about some of the politicians who will be bringing a scientific background into public office.
paras.zh: 以下是您需要了解的一些将把科学背景带入公职的政治家的信息。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, an epidemiologist by training, was elected to the Senate for the state of Michigan. El-Sayed, who previously led Detroit’s public health department, told Scientific American in October that he sees many parallels between the practice of science and public policy.
paras.zh: 民主党人阿卜杜勒·赛义德是一位受过训练的流行病学家，他当选为密歇根州参议员。底特律公共卫生部门前负责人埃尔-赛义德十月份告诉《科学美国人》，他看到科学实践和公共政策之间有许多相似之处。

paras.en: “Once you train in the sciences, you don’t leave that scientific approach to thinking and that rigor of thinking,” he said. “And I try to bring that to policy problems.”
paras.zh: “一旦你接受了科学训练，你就不会放弃科学的思维方法和严谨的思维，”他说。 “我试图将其带入政策问题。”

paras.en: Democrat Annie Andrews flipped a Senate seat in South Carolina, defeating the incumbent Republican Darline Graham, who succeeded her brother, Lindsey Graham, after his death. Andrews worked as a pediatrician in South Carolina and Washington, D.C., until earlier this year.
paras.zh: 民主党人安妮·安德鲁斯(Annie Andrews)击败了现任共和党人达林·格雷厄姆(Darline Graham)，在南卡罗来纳州赢得了参议院席位，达林·格雷厄姆在她的兄弟林赛·格雷厄姆(Lindsey Graham)去世后继任。安德鲁斯一直在南卡罗来纳州和华盛顿特区担任儿科医生，直到今年早些时候。

paras.en: The Ohio public first came to know Amy Acton when she served as the state’s chief public health officer during the COVID pandemic. Now Acton, a Democrat, will serve as Ohio’s governor.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州公众第一次认识艾米·阿克顿是在她在新冠病毒大流行期间担任该州首席公共卫生官员时。现在，民主党人阿克顿将担任俄亥俄州州长。

paras.en: She beat biotech billionaire Vivek Ramaswamy to become Ohio’s second Democratic governor in 35 years and the state’s first elected female governor.
paras.zh: 她击败生物技术亿万富翁维韦克·拉马斯瓦米 (Vivek Ramaswamy)，成为俄亥俄州 35 年来第二位民主党州长，也是该州第一位民选女州长。

paras.en: Democrat Josh Green, a physician, won a second term as governor of Hawaii on Tuesday, beating Republican challenger Gary Cordery by 45 percentage points. He and Acton are the only two physician-governors in the country.
paras.zh: 周二，医生、民主党人乔什·格林 (Josh Green) 以 45 个百分点的优势击败共和党挑战者加里·科德里 (Gary Cordery)，赢得了夏威夷州州长的第二个任期。他和阿克顿是该国仅有的两位医生兼州长。

paras.en: Jasmine Clark, a microbiologist at Emory University, won a House of Representatives seat in Georgia’s 13th district. Clark, a Democrat, will represent parts of the city of Atlanta and will be the first Black woman with a science Ph.D. in Congress.
paras.zh: 埃默里大学微生物学家 Jasmine Clark 赢得了佐治亚州第 13 选区的众议院席位。克拉克是一名民主党人，将代表亚特兰大市的部分地区，并将成为第一位拥有科学博士学位的黑人女性。在国会。

paras.en: Democrat Rebecca Bennett, a former Navy pilot, who worked in the health care industry and has a degree in chemical engineering, flipped New Jersey’s seventh congressional district, which stretches across the northern and central parts of the state. She beat the two-term, incumbent Republican Tom Kean, Jr.
paras.zh: 民主党人丽贝卡·贝内特(Rebecca Bennett)是一名前海军飞行员，曾在医疗保健行业工作，拥有化学工程学位，她推翻了新泽西州的第七个国会选区，该选区横跨该州北部和中部。她击败了连任两届的现任共和党人小汤姆·基恩(Tom Kean, Jr.)。

paras.en: Christina Bohannan flipped Iowa’s first district, which stretches from the Des Moines suburbs to the southeastern corner of the state. Also a Democrat, Bohannan has worked as an environmental engineer and a lawyer. She beat Republican incumbent Mariannette Miller-Meeks, a physician, by nearly 10 points.
paras.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·博汉南（Christina Bohannan）翻转了爱荷华州的第一个选区，该选区从得梅因郊区一直延伸到该州的东南角。博汉南也是一名民主党人，曾担任环境工程师和律师。她以近 10 个百分点的优势击败了共和党现任医生玛丽安内特·米勒-米克斯 (Mariannette Miller-Meeks)。

paras.en: Democrat Mitchell Berman, an emergency room nurse, flipped Wisconsin’s first district, narrowly beating incumbent Bryan Steil and turning the district, which covers southeastern Wisconsin, blue for the first time in more than 30 years.
paras.zh: 急诊室护士、民主党人米切尔·伯曼(Mitchell Berman)以微弱优势击败了现任总统布莱恩·斯泰尔(Bryan Steil)，推翻了威斯康星州的第一选区，并将覆盖威斯康星州东南部的选区30多年来首次变成蓝色。

paras.en: A newcomer to politics, Berman spent more than a decade as a nurse at the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.
paras.zh: 作为政坛新人，伯曼在美国退伍军人事务部担任了十多年的护士。

paras.en: Elaine Luria worked as a nuclear engineer for the U.S. Navy for two decades. She won the House seat for Virginia’s second district, which covers Virginia Beach and parts of the state’s coast. A Democrat, she previously served as the district’s representative from 2019 to 2023.
paras.zh: 伊莱恩·卢里亚 (Elaine Luria) 在美国海军担任了二十年的核工程师。她赢得了弗吉尼亚州第二选区的众议院席位，该选区覆盖弗吉尼亚海滩和该州部分海岸。她是民主党人，曾于 2019 年至 2023 年担任该区代表。

paras.en: Democrat Adam Hamawy, a plastic surgeon and former U.S. Army physician, won New Jersey’s 12th district. He served as a trauma surgeon in Iraq and has since served as a volunteer doctor in war and disaster zones, including Haiti, Sudan and Gaza.
paras.zh: 整形外科医生、前美国陆军医生、民主党人亚当·哈马威 (Adam Hamawy) 赢得了新泽西州第 12 选区的胜利。他曾在伊拉克担任创伤外科医生，此后一直在海地、苏丹和加沙等战争和灾区担任志愿医生。

paras.en: Daniel Biss, a mathematician and former assistant professor at the University of Chicago, won the House seat in Illinois’s ninth district in a landslide after serving as the mayor of Evanston, Ill., for five years.
paras.zh: 数学家、芝加哥大学前助理教授丹尼尔·比斯 (Daniel Biss) 在担任伊利诺伊州埃文斯顿市市长五年后，以压倒性优势赢得了伊利诺伊州第九选区的众议院席位。

paras.en: Richard Pan, a Democrat and a pediatrician, won the House seat for California’s sixth district, which covers northern and west Sacramento. Pan was a member of the California State Senate from 2014 to 2022, when he championed vaccine mandates and protections, and unsuccessfully ran for mayor of Sacramento in 2024.
paras.zh: 民主党人和儿科医生理查德·潘赢得了加州第六选区的众议院席位，该选区覆盖萨克拉门托北部和西部。潘在 2014 年至 2022 年期间担任加州参议院议员，当时他支持疫苗授权和保护，并于 2024 年竞选萨克拉门托市长，但未能成功。

paras.en: Jacqui Irwin, who worked as a systems engineer before entering politics, won a House seat in California’s 26th district, which covers most of Ventura County.
paras.zh: 杰奎·欧文 (Jacqui Irwin) 在进入政界之前曾担任系统工程师，赢得了加州第 26 选区的众议院席位，该选区覆盖了文图拉县的大部分地区。

paras.en: Republican John Cowan, a neuroscientist, won a House of Representatives seat in Georgia’s 11th district. It will be his first position in public office after he unsuccessfully ran against then representative Marjorie Taylor Greene in the state’s 14th district.
paras.zh: 神经科学家、共和党人约翰·考恩赢得了佐治亚州第 11 选区的众议院席位。这将是他在该州第 14 选区与时任众议员马乔里·泰勒·格林 (Marjorie Taylor Greene) 竞选失败后首次担任公职。

paras.en: Republican and former anesthesiologist Andy Harris won reelection as representative of Maryland’s first district, which covers the state’s eastern shore.
paras.zh: 共和党人、前麻醉师安迪·哈里斯（Andy Harris）赢得连任，成为马里兰州第一选区的代表，该选区覆盖该州东海岸。

paras.en: Ronny Jackson, a Republican who served as physician to the president during Barack Obama’s second term and Donald Trump’s first term, won reelection in Texas’s 13th district, which includes the Texas panhandle.
paras.zh: 共和党人罗尼·杰克逊(Ronny Jackson)在巴拉克·奥巴马(Barack Obama)第二任期和唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)第一任期期间担任总统医生，在德克萨斯州第13选区（包括德克萨斯州狭长地带）赢得连任。

paras.en: Republican John Joyce won reelection in Pennsylvania’s 13th district, where he’s served since 2019. Joyce is a dermatologist by training.
paras.zh: 共和党人约翰·乔伊斯 (John Joyce) 在宾夕法尼亚州第 13 选区赢得连任，他自 2019 年以来一直在该选区任职。乔伊斯是一名皮肤科医生。

paras.en: Rich McCormick, an emergency physician and a former military doctor, won reelection in Georgia’s seventh district, which includes the northern parts of the Atlanta metropolitan area.
paras.zh: 里奇·麦考密克（Rich McCormick）是一名急诊医生，也是一名前军医，他在佐治亚州第七选区赢得连任，该选区包括亚特兰大都会区的北部地区。

paras.en: Republican physician Bob Onder won a second term in Missouri’s third district, beating Democratic challenger and environmental chemist Bethany Mann by eight percentage points.
paras.zh: 共和党医生鲍勃·翁德 (Bob Onder) 在密苏里州第三选区赢得了第二个任期，击败民主党挑战者、环境化学家贝瑟尼·曼 (Bethany Mann) 八个百分点。

paras.en: Democratic physician Ami Bera won an eighth term in the House of Representatives and will represent California’s third district, which was recently redrawn. Bera previously served as the chief medical officer for the County of Sacramento.
paras.zh: 民主党医生阿米·贝拉 (Ami Bera) 赢得了众议院第八个任期，并将代表最近重新划分的加州第三选区。贝拉此前曾担任萨克拉门托县的首席医疗官。

paras.en: Democrat Herb Conaway won a second term as the representative for New Jersey’s third district. A physician specializing in internal medicine, Conaway is currently the only member of the newly elected Congress to hold a medical and law degree.
paras.zh: 民主党人赫伯·科纳威赢得了新泽西州第三选区代表的第二个任期。科纳威是一名专攻内科的医生，目前是新当选的国会中唯一一位拥有医学和法律学位的议员。

paras.en: Democrat Maxine Dexter was elected to represent Oregon’s third district, which includes most of Portland, for a second term. Dexter is a pulmonologist.
paras.zh: 民主党人玛克辛·德克斯特（Maxine Dexter）当选代表俄勒冈州第三选区（包括波特兰大部分地区）连任。德克斯特是一位肺科医生。

paras.en: Obstetrician-gynecologist Kelly Morrison won a second term in Minnesota’s third district. With the loss of incumbent Republican Roger Marshall in Kansas’s Senate race, Morrison will be the only ob-gyn in Congress.
paras.zh: 妇产科医生凯利·莫里森在明尼苏达州第三选区赢得了第二个任期。随着现任共和党人罗杰·马歇尔在堪萨斯州参议员竞选中落败，莫里森将成为国会中唯一的妇产科医生。

paras.en: Democrat Raul Ruiz, an emergency physician, won an eighth term as representative of California’s 25th district, beating Republican challenger Joe Males by nearly 30 percentage points.
paras.zh: 急诊科医生、民主党人劳尔·鲁伊斯(Raul Ruiz)以近30个百分点的优势击败共和党挑战者乔·马尔斯(Joe Males)，赢得加州第25选区代表第八个任期。

paras.en: Democrat Kim Schrier was the first pediatrician elected to Congress in 2018. She won reelection in Washington’s eighth district for a fifth term.
paras.zh: 民主党人 Kim Schrier 是 2018 年第一位当选国会议员的儿科医生。她在华盛顿第八选区赢得连任，第五次连任。

paras.en: A number of races with scientists or health care professionals in the running have not been called yet. These candidates include Democratic nurse Kristina Knickerbocker in Ohio; Democratic nuclear engineer Chris Jones in Arkansas; Democratic physician Amish Shah in Arizona; Republican physician Scott DesJarlais in Tennessee; Republican physician Mike Kennedy in Utah; Republican urologist Greg Murphy in North Carolina; Democrat and former NASA chief of staff Bale Dalton in Florida; and Democratic Army engineer Dwayne Romero in Colorado.
paras.zh: A number of races with scientists or health care professionals in the running have not been called yet. These candidates include Democratic nurse Kristina Knickerbocker in Ohio; Democratic nuclear engineer Chris Jones in Arkansas;亚利桑那州的民主党医生阿米什·沙阿； Republican physician Scott DesJarlais in Tennessee;犹他州的共和党医生迈克·肯尼迪； Republican urologist Greg Murphy in North Carolina; Democrat and former NASA chief of staff Bale Dalton in Florida; and Democratic Army engineer Dwayne Romero in Colorado.
