articles.title: A clever molecular trick unlocks previously impossible properties in glass

paras.en: A clever molecular trick unlocks previously impossible properties in glass
paras.zh: 巧妙的分子技巧解锁了玻璃中以前不可能的特性

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered how to reprogram the internal structure of glass using a special molecule that rearranges chemical bonds while lowering the melting temperature. The breakthrough could unlock entirely new glass materials with precisely controlled magnetic and optical properties, opening possibilities for advanced electronics, sensors, and other technologies.
paras.zh: - 科学家们发现了如何使用一种特殊的分子重新编程玻璃的内部结构，该分子可以重新排列化学键，同时降低熔化温度。这一突破可以解锁具有精确控制的磁和光学特性的全新玻璃材料，为先进电子、传感器和其他技术带来可能性。

paras.en: Scientists have developed a new way to change the internal structure of glass while it is being made, giving them greater control over properties such as magnetism and the way the material interacts with light. The discovery could open the door to advanced glasses with capabilities that were previously difficult or impossible to achieve.
paras.zh: 科学家们开发出了一种在玻璃制造过程中改变其内部结构的新方法，使他们能够更好地控制磁性以及材料与光相互作用的方式等特性。这一发现可能为先进眼镜打开大门，这些眼镜具有以前难以或不可能实现的功能。

paras.en: The breakthrough comes from a collaboration involving TU Dortmund University, Paderborn University, the University of Duisburg-Essen, and the University of Oxford. Published in Nature Materials, the research demonstrates how adding a particular organic molecule during the melting process can rearrange chemical bonds within certain types of glass.
paras.zh: 这一突破来自多特蒙德工业大学、帕德博恩大学、杜伊斯堡-埃森大学和牛津大学的合作。该研究发表在《自然材料》上，展示了在熔化过程中添加特定有机分子如何重新排列某些类型玻璃内的化学键。

paras.en: The method also allows these materials to melt at much lower temperatures, preventing the damage that would otherwise occur during manufacturing. Such specialized glasses have potential applications in gas storage, batteries, optical technologies, and catalysis.
paras.zh: 该方法还允许这些材料在低得多的温度下熔化，从而防止在制造过程中发生损坏。这种特种玻璃在气体储存、电池、光学技术和催化领域具有潜在的应用前景。

paras.en: A Molecular Trick That Changes Glass From Within
paras.zh: 从内部改变玻璃的分子技巧

paras.en: "We have found a way to chemically modify the structure of glasses derived from so-called metal-organic framework compounds - or MOFs for short - right during the manufacturing process," explains Prof. Dr. Sebastian Henke from TU Dortmund University, who led the study.
paras.zh: 领导这项研究的多特蒙德工业大学 Sebastian Henke 教授解释说：“我们找到了一种方法，可以在制造过程中对由所谓的金属有机骨架化合物（简称 MOF）衍生的玻璃结构进行化学修饰。”

paras.en: The key ingredient is a molecule called 1,10-phenanthroline. When introduced during production, it performs two important tasks. It reduces the temperature needed to melt the material while also changing how metal atoms connect with surrounding molecules.
paras.zh: 关键成分是一种称为 1,10-菲咯啉的分子。当在生产过程中引入时，它会执行两项重要任务。它降低了熔化材料所需的温度，同时也改变了金属原子与周围分子的连接方式。

paras.en: This combination allows researchers to create glass with magnetic or light-emitting characteristics that previously could not be achieved without exposing the material to potentially destructive temperatures.
paras.zh: 这种组合使研究人员能够制造出具有磁性或发光特性的玻璃，而以前如果不将材料暴露在具有潜在破坏性的温度下，就无法实现这种特性。

paras.en: To understand why this approach matters, it helps to consider how glass normally forms. When a liquid cools quickly enough, its atoms become locked into a disordered arrangement rather than forming the repeating pattern found in crystals.
paras.zh: 要理解这种方法的重要性，需要考虑玻璃通常是如何形成的。当液体冷却得足够快时，其原子就会被锁定为无序排列，而不是形成晶体中的重复图案。

paras.en: "Normally, glass is formed when a molten liquid cools rapidly. The solid structure then sets without the atoms arranging themselves in a regular pattern. Until now, researchers often had to accept the chemistry of these glasses as dictated by the starting material," explains Prof. Henke.
paras.zh: “通常情况下，玻璃是在熔融液体快速冷却时形成的。固体结构随后会凝固，原子不会以规则的方式排列。到目前为止，研究人员常常不得不接受这些玻璃的化学成分是由起始材料决定的，”亨克教授解释道。

paras.en: The new findings show that scientists can exert much greater control over this process.
paras.zh: 新发现表明科学家可以对这一过程施加更大的控制。

paras.en: Metal-organic frameworks are materials built from metal centers connected by organic compounds. By introducing phenanthroline while these materials are molten, researchers can change the chemical connections within the structure before the glass solidifies.
paras.zh: 金属有机框架是由有机化合物连接的金属中心构建的材料。通过在这些材料熔化时引入菲咯啉，研究人员可以在玻璃凝固之前改变结构内的化学连接。

paras.en: "The crucial point is that the molecule does not simply remain as a filler," Prof. Henke continues. "It enters into a reaction. So we are altering the chemistry at precisely the moment when the material is still liquid."
paras.zh: “关键的一点是，该分子不仅仅只是作为填充剂，”亨克教授继续说道。 “它会发生反应。因此，我们正是在材料仍呈液态时改变化学性质。”

paras.en: How a Single Molecule Restructures Glass
paras.zh: 单分子如何重组玻璃

paras.en: The researchers added phenanthroline to their starting materials before heating them. Once the mixture begins to melt, the molecule does more than simply lower the temperature required for melting. It actively participates in chemical reactions that reorganize the glass network.
paras.zh: 研究人员在加热之前将菲咯啉添加到起始材料中。一旦混合物开始熔化，分子的作用不仅仅是降低熔化所需的温度。它积极参与重组玻璃网络的化学反应。

paras.en: The process changes the immediate surroundings of metal atoms by modifying their connections to neighboring molecules.
paras.zh: 该过程通过改变金属原子与邻近分子的连接来改变金属原子的直接周围环境。

paras.en: "As a flux, the substance lowers the temperature at which the material melts; as a chemical agent, the molecule binds directly to the metal atoms and partially displaces old bonds. In the molten state, the molecule interferes with what is known as the coordination environment. This term describes how many neighbors surround a single atom. Because the new molecule binds more strongly to the metal centers, the number of neighbors increases," explains Prof. Henke.
paras.zh: “作为助熔剂，该物质降低了材料熔化的温度；作为化学试剂，分子直接与金属原子结合并部分取代旧的键。在熔融状态下，分子会干扰所谓的配位环境。这个术语描述了单个原子周围有多少个邻居。因为新分子与金属中心的结合更牢固，所以邻居的数量增加，”Henke教授解释道。

paras.en: These interactions trigger a substantial rearrangement of the internal glass structure. Importantly, the researchers can control how extensively the material changes simply by adjusting the amount of phenanthroline added.
paras.zh: 这些相互作用引发了内部玻璃结构的实质性重新排列。重要的是，研究人员只需调整菲咯啉的添加量即可控制材料变化的程度。

paras.en: This gives scientists a practical way to tune the properties of glass during manufacturing rather than relying entirely on the chemistry of the original ingredients.
paras.zh: 这为科学家们提供了一种在制造过程中调整玻璃性能的实用方法，而不是完全依赖原始成分的化学成分。

paras.en: Lower Temperatures Prevent Damage to Glass
paras.zh: 较低的温度可防止玻璃损坏

paras.en: Another major advantage of the discovery is that it overcomes a longstanding problem in manufacturing specialized glasses.
paras.zh: 这一发现的另一个主要优点是它克服了制造特种玻璃的长期存在的问题。

paras.en: Some of the materials investigated are unable to withstand the temperatures normally required to melt them. Instead of becoming usable glass, they begin to break down, damaging their structure and producing unwanted impurities.
paras.zh: 所研究的一些材料无法承受通常熔化它们所需的温度。它们没有成为可用的玻璃，而是开始分解，破坏其结构并产生不需要的杂质。

paras.en: The new molecular approach avoids much of this problem by allowing the materials to melt under gentler conditions.
paras.zh: 新的分子方法通过允许材料在更温和的条件下熔化，在很大程度上避免了这个问题。

paras.en: "Thanks to this molecular trick, the material melts at significantly lower temperatures and remains stable. Studies on cobalt-containing glasses have shown that this gentler process prevents the formation of harmful decomposition products," explains Prof. Dr. Matthias Bauer from Paderborn University.
paras.zh: “由于这种分子技巧，该材料在显着较低的温度下熔化并保持稳定。对含钴玻璃的研究表明，这种温和的过程可以防止有害分解产物的形成，”帕德博恩大学的 Matthias Bauer 教授解释说。

paras.en: Preventing these unwanted byproducts is particularly important when studying magnetic properties. Impurities can interfere with measurements and conceal the material's actual magnetic behavior. By keeping the glass chemically stable, the researchers can observe these effects more clearly.
paras.zh: 在研究磁特性时，防止这些不需要的副产品尤为重要。杂质会干扰测量并隐藏材料的实际磁性行为。通过保持玻璃的化学稳定性，研究人员可以更清楚地观察这些效应。

paras.en: Advanced X-ray Measurements Confirm the Changes
paras.zh: 先进的 X 射线测量证实了这些变化

paras.en: To verify that the molecular treatment genuinely altered the glass, the research team turned to sophisticated analytical techniques.
paras.zh: 为了验证分子处理确实改变了玻璃，研究小组转向了复杂的分析技术。

paras.en: Studying glass presents a challenge because its atoms do not follow the regular, repeating arrangement found in crystalline materials. This limits what conventional X-ray methods can reveal about its internal structure.
paras.zh: 研究玻璃是一个挑战，因为它的原子不遵循晶体材料中规则的重复排列。这限制了传统 X 射线方法揭示其内部结构的能力。

paras.en: Prof. Bauer explains: "Instead, we used X-ray absorption spectroscopy, amongst other techniques. This method enabled us to investigate the immediate surroundings of the cobalt atoms."
paras.zh: Bauer 教授解释说：“相反，我们使用了 X 射线吸收光谱法等技术。这种方法使我们能够研究钴原子的直接周围环境。”

paras.en: The measurements provided strong evidence that the new molecule changes the arrangement of atoms around the metal centers.
paras.zh: 测量结果提供了强有力的证据，证明新分子改变了金属中心周围原子的排列。

paras.en: Although the cobalt atoms maintained the same chemical state (oxidation state), their local surroundings changed considerably. The bonds connecting them to nearby molecules were reorganized to accommodate the added phenanthroline.
paras.zh: 尽管钴原子保持相同的化学状态（氧化态），但它们的局部环境发生了很大变化。连接它们与附近分子的键被重组以适应添加的菲咯啉。

paras.en: These observations confirmed that the method does more than simply help the material melt. It changes the underlying chemistry of the glass itself.
paras.zh: 这些观察结果证实，该方法不仅仅是帮助材料熔化。它改变了玻璃本身的基本化学成分。

paras.en: A New Generation of Glass With Tunable Properties
paras.zh: 具有可调特性的新一代玻璃

paras.en: The researchers also demonstrated that their approach works beyond the original materials they investigated. Successful experiments with carboxylate-based framework structures suggest that the technique could be applied to a broader range of glass materials.
paras.zh: 研究人员还证明，他们的方法的效果超出了他们研究的原始材料。基于羧酸盐的框架结构的成功实验表明该技术可以应用于更广泛的玻璃材料。

paras.en: This versatility is especially promising because it transforms the melting stage of production into an opportunity to design new material properties.
paras.zh: 这种多功能性特别有前途，因为它将生产的熔化阶段转变为设计新材料特性的机会。

paras.en: Prof. Henke summarizes the significance for the future: "The melt is no longer a rigid intermediate state. It becomes a reaction space in which we can program the structure."
paras.zh: Henke 教授总结了其对未来的意义：“熔体不再是刚性的中间状态。它变成了一个反应空间，我们可以在其中对结构进行编程。”

paras.en: The ability to precisely modify metal centers could eventually lead to advanced glass components designed for specific technological purposes.
paras.zh: 精确修改金属中心的能力最终可能会导致为特定技术目的而设计的先进玻璃组件。

paras.en: Potential applications include chemical catalysts, sensors, and optoelectronic devices that use interactions between light and electricity. Researchers could also develop materials capable of controlling magnetic behavior, manipulating light, or influencing chemical reactions with greater precision.
paras.zh: 潜在的应用包括化学催化剂、传感器和利用光与电之间相互作用的光电设备。研究人员还可以开发能够更精确地控制磁性行为、操纵光或影响化学反应的材料。

paras.en: By turning molten glass into a material whose chemistry can be deliberately adjusted, the discovery offers a new route toward specialized glasses with properties that conventional manufacturing techniques could not easily produce.
paras.zh: 通过将熔融玻璃转变为化学性质可以有意调整的材料，这一发现为制造具有传统制造技术无法轻易生产的特性的特种玻璃提供了一条新途径。

articles.title: Scientists discover that a clogged filter could revolutionize oil refining

paras.en: Scientists discover that a clogged filter could revolutionize oil refining
paras.zh: 科学家发现堵塞的过滤器可以彻底改变炼油业

paras.en: - The Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
paras.zh: - 韩国科学技术院 (KAIST)

paras.en: - Scientists have developed a remarkable new membrane that separates crude oil at room temperature, using the oil itself to create microscopic filtration channels. The breakthrough could cut refining energy consumption by nearly 32%, carbon emissions by almost 38%, and operating costs by 36%, potentially transforming one of the world's most energy-intensive industries.
paras.zh: - 科学家们开发出了一种非凡的新型膜，可以在室温下分离原油，利用油本身创建微观过滤通道。这一突破可以将炼油能源消耗减少近 32%，碳排放减少近 38%，运营成本减少 36%，有可能改变世界上能源最密集的行业之一。

paras.en: Researchers have developed a surprisingly simple way to separate crude oil without heating it, potentially transforming one of the world's most energy-intensive industrial processes. The breakthrough uses an inexpensive membrane that could significantly reduce the energy required for oil refining while lowering operating costs and carbon emissions.
paras.zh: 研究人员开发出一种令人惊讶的简单方法，可以在不加热的情况下分离原油，这有可能改变世界上能源最密集的工业流程之一。这一突破使用了一种廉价的膜，可以显着减少炼油所需的能源，同时降低运营成本和碳排放。

paras.en: The international research effort was led by Professor Dong-Yeun Koh at the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology, known as KAIST, in collaboration with Professor Ryan Lively's research group at Georgia Tech. KAIST(President Kwang Hyung Lee) announced that the team had successfully demonstrated a membrane capable of separating crude oil at room temperature. The findings were published in Nature, one of the world's leading scientific journals.
paras.zh: 这项国际研究工作由韩国科学技术院（KAIST）的 Dong-Yeun Koh 教授领导，并与佐治亚理工学院的 Ryan Lively 教授的研究小组合作。 KAIST（总裁 Kwang Hyung Lee）宣布，该团队已成功展示了一种能够在室温下分离原油的膜。研究结果发表在世界领先的科学期刊之一《自然》上。

paras.en: Crude oil is essential for far more than gasoline and other transportation fuels. It also supplies the raw materials used to manufacture plastics, packaging, clothing, and numerous everyday products. Because refining costs affect the prices of these materials, making the process more efficient could have widespread economic and environmental benefits.
paras.zh: 原油的重要性远远超出汽油和其他运输燃料。它还提供用于制造塑料、包装、服装和众多日常用品的原材料。由于精炼成本会影响这些材料的价格，因此提高工艺效率可以产生广泛的经济和环境效益。

paras.en: Why Traditional Crude Oil Refining Requires So Much Energy
paras.zh: 为什么传统原油炼制需要如此多的能源

paras.en: For more than a century, oil refineries have relied heavily on distillation to separate crude oil into useful components. The process involves heating oil to temperatures above 350 °C, turning portions of it into vapor, and then cooling those vapors to collect different fractions.
paras.zh: 一个多世纪以来，炼油厂严重依赖蒸馏将原油分离成有用的成分。该过程包括将油加热到 350°C 以上的温度，将部分油转化为蒸气，然后冷却这些蒸气以收集不同的馏分。

paras.en: This approach requires an enormous amount of energy. Worldwide, crude oil distillation consumes approximately 1,100 terawatt-hours (TWh) annually. That is comparable to the combined yearly electricity production of roughly 130 continuously operating nuclear power plants, each with a capacity of about one gigawatt.
paras.zh: 这种方法需要大量的能量。全球范围内，原油蒸馏每年消耗约 1,100 太瓦时 (TWh)。这相当于大约 130 座连续运行的核电站的年发电量总和，每座核电站的容量约为 1 吉瓦。

paras.en: The massive energy demand makes distillation a major contributor to both fuel consumption and greenhouse gas emissions within the refining industry. Meanwhile, growing economic pressures across global petrochemical markets have increased interest in technologies that can separate oil more efficiently.
paras.zh: 巨大的能源需求使得蒸馏成为炼油行业燃料消耗和温室气体排放的主要贡献者。与此同时，全球石化市场日益增长的经济压力增加了人们对能够更有效地分离石油的技术的兴趣。

paras.en: Membranes have emerged as a promising alternative because they can separate substances without requiring the extreme temperatures used in conventional distillation. However, previous designs have faced significant obstacles.
paras.zh: 膜已成为一种有前途的替代品，因为它们可以分离物质，而不需要传统蒸馏中使用的极端温度。然而，以前的设计面临着重大障碍。

paras.en: Traditionally, researchers have assumed that effective molecular separation requires a membrane covered with an extremely thin, specialized coating. Although these coatings can provide the necessary precision, they are expensive to produce and can develop defects when manufactured on a large scale. These limitations have made widespread industrial adoption difficult.
paras.zh: 传统上，研究人员认为有效的分子分离需要覆盖有极薄的专门涂层的膜。尽管这些涂层可以提供必要的精度，但它们的生产成本昂贵，并且在大规模制造时可能会出现缺陷。这些限制使得广泛的工业应用变得困难。

paras.en: A Surprising Discovery Turns Clogged Filters Into an Advantage
paras.zh: 令人惊讶的发现将堵塞的过滤器变成了优势

paras.en: The KAIST and Georgia Tech researchers approached the problem differently. Rather than adding a complicated coating, they used a bare membrane made from porous polyacrylonitrile (PAN), an inexpensive, chemically stable polymer already commonly used as a supporting material in industrial filtration systems.
paras.zh: 韩国科学技术院和佐治亚理工学院的研究人员以不同的方式处理这个问题。他们没有添加复杂的涂层，而是使用由多孔聚丙烯腈（PAN）制成的裸膜，这是一种廉价且化学稳定的聚合物，已普遍用作工业过滤系统中的支撑材料。

paras.en: What happened when crude oil passed through the membrane was unexpected.
paras.zh: 当原油通过膜时发生的事情是出乎意料的。

paras.en: As the oil flowed through its pores, heavier hydrocarbon molecules accumulated along the inner walls. This buildup gradually reduced the size of the openings, producing extremely narrow channels measuring less than 2 nanometers across.
paras.zh: 当石油流过其孔隙时，较重的碳氢化合物分子沿着内壁积累。这种堆积逐渐减小了开口的尺寸，产生了宽度小于 2 纳米的极窄通道。

paras.en: In effect, the crude oil helped create the microscopic pathways needed to separate its own components.
paras.zh: 实际上，原油帮助创造了分离其自身成分所需的微观途径。

paras.en: These naturally formed channels allowed lighter oil fractions, including naphtha, gasoline, and kerosene, to pass through quickly while preventing heavier substances from traveling through the membrane as easily.
paras.zh: 这些自然形成的通道允许较轻的油馏分（包括石脑油、汽油和煤油）快速通过，同时防止较重的物质轻松通过膜。

paras.en: The discovery was especially surprising because the buildup of material inside membrane pores, known as fouling, is normally considered a serious problem. Fouling typically reduces filtration performance and requires cleaning or replacement. In this case, however, the same phenomenon made the membrane highly effective at separating different molecules.
paras.zh: 这一发现尤其令人惊讶，因为膜孔内物质的堆积（称为污垢）通常被认为是一个严重的问题。污垢通常会降低过滤性能，需要清洁或更换。然而，在这种情况下，同样的现象使得膜在分离不同分子方面非常有效。

paras.en: The results were impressive. The uncoated PAN membrane achieved crude oil permeation rates approximately 23 times higher than those reported for previous leading crude oil separation membranes. It also continued operating with stable performance for 28 consecutive days.
paras.zh: 结果令人印象深刻。未涂层的 PAN 膜实现的原油渗透率比之前报道的领先原油分离膜高出约 23 倍。并连续28天保持稳定运行。

paras.en: Professor Ryan Lively (Georgia Tech) commented: "One of the key challenges facing membrane systems for crude oil separation was the low productivities of the membrane units -- the PAN membranes with their surprising separation mechanism -- dramatically increase the productivity of the membrane unit, to the point where industry should seriously consider adopting the technology."
paras.zh: Ryan Lively 教授（佐治亚理工学院）评论道：“用于原油分离的膜系统面临的主要挑战之一是膜装置的低生产率——PAN 膜及其令人惊讶的分离机制——极大地提高了膜装置的生产率，以至于工业界应该认真考虑采用该技术。”

paras.en: New Membrane Could Cut Oil Refining Energy Use by Nearly a Third
paras.zh: 新膜可以将炼油能源消耗减少近三分之一

paras.en: One of the technology's biggest advantages is that refineries would not necessarily need to replace their existing equipment to use it.
paras.zh: 该技术的最大优势之一是炼油厂不一定需要更换现有设备才能使用它。

paras.en: The membrane could instead be installed as a modular filtration system that processes crude oil before it enters conventional distillation equipment. This would reduce the amount of work required during the heating and separation stages while allowing facilities to continue using much of their current infrastructure.
paras.zh: 该膜可以作为模块化过滤系统安装，在原油进入传统蒸馏设备之前对其进行处理。这将减少加热和分离阶段所需的工作量，同时允许设施继续使用大部分现有基础设施。

paras.en: Computer simulations suggest that incorporating the membrane into the refining process could deliver substantial improvements. Energy consumption could fall by 31.6%, while carbon dioxide emissions could decrease by 37.6%. The same calculations projected a 20.7% reduction in cooling water consumption and a 36% decrease in operating costs.
paras.zh: 计算机模拟表明，将膜纳入精炼过程可以带来实质性的改进。能源消耗量可下降31.6%，二氧化碳排放量可减少37.6%。同样的计算预计冷却水消耗量将减少 20.7%，运营成本将减少 36%。

paras.en: The potential environmental benefits could be considerable if the technology were adopted widely.
paras.zh: 如果该技术得到广泛采用，潜在的环境效益将是巨大的。

paras.en: Researchers estimate that implementing the system throughout Korea's refining and petrochemical industries could prevent approximately 10 million tonnes of greenhouse gas emissions each year. That is roughly equivalent to the annual emissions produced by four million vehicles powered by internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 研究人员估计，在整个韩国炼油和石化行业实施该系统每年可以减少约 1000 万吨温室气体排放。这大致相当于 400 万辆内燃机汽车每年产生的排放量。

paras.en: These savings are projections based on process simulations rather than reductions already demonstrated across operating refineries. Nevertheless, the findings suggest that membrane filtration could become a practical way to improve the efficiency of existing facilities.
paras.zh: 这些节省是基于过程模拟的预测，而不是已经在运营的炼油厂中证明的减少量。尽管如此，研究结果表明膜过滤可能成为提高现有设施效率的实用方法。

paras.en: Although crude oil separation was the main focus of the research, the same technology could eventually be useful in several other industries.
paras.zh: 尽管原油分离是研究的主要焦点，但相同的技术最终可以用于其他几个行业。

paras.en: One potential application involves treating pyrolysis oil produced when waste plastics are broken down for recycling. The membranes could also help recover solvents used in battery manufacturing, purify pharmaceutical compounds, and improve biofuel production.
paras.zh: 一种潜在的应用涉及处理废塑料分解回收时产生的热解油。这些膜还可以帮助回收电池制造中使用的溶剂、纯化药物化合物并提高生物燃料的生产。

paras.en: The broader opportunity lies in using complex liquid mixtures to help form the tiny filtration channels needed to separate their components. This approach could provide a more affordable and versatile alternative to conventional membranes that require precisely manufactured surface coatings.
paras.zh: 更广泛的机会在于使用复杂的液体混合物来帮助形成分离其成分所需的微小过滤通道。这种方法可以为需要精确制造表面涂层的传统膜提供更实惠、更通用的替代品。

paras.en: Professor Dong-Yeun Koh of KAIST said, "This study reveals a new scientific principle in which a membrane interacts with a complex mixture and spontaneously forms its own separation channels. Working with real crude oil supplied by HD Hyundai Oilbank allowed us to validate the technology under conditions relevant to industrial operation."
paras.zh: 韩国科学技术院的 Dong-Yeun Koh 教授表示：“这项研究揭示了一种新的科学原理，即膜与复杂的混合物相互作用，并自发形成自己的分离通道。通过使用 HD Hyundai Oilbank 提供的真实原油，我们能够在与工业操作相关的条件下验证该技术。”

paras.en: The use of actual crude oil was an important part of the research because it allowed the team to examine how the membrane performed with the complicated mixture of hydrocarbons found in industrial feedstocks.
paras.zh: 使用实际原油是研究的重要组成部分，因为它使团队能够检查膜在工业原料中发现的复杂碳氢化合物混合物中的表现。

paras.en: Before the technology can be deployed more widely, the researchers plan to improve membrane production at larger scales and establish its reliability during extended operation.
paras.zh: 在该技术得到更广泛的部署之前，研究人员计划提高更大规模的膜生产能力，并在长期运行过程中建立其可靠性。

paras.en: Professor Jae W. Lee of KAIST, a co-corresponding author of the study, added, "By advancing large-area membrane modularization and long-term operational reliability, we hope to broaden the adoption of membrane-based processes throughout the refining and petrochemical industries."
paras.zh: 该研究的共同通讯作者、韩国科学技术院的 Jae W. Lee 教授补充道：“通过推进大面积膜模块化和长期运行可靠性，我们希望扩大基于膜的工艺在整个炼油和石化行业的采用。”

paras.en: Dr. Jihoon Choi and Dr. Hyeokjun Seo of KAIST, the study's co-first authors, said, "Our goal is to precisely control this spontaneous pore-constriction phenomenon and develop it into a membrane platform applicable to the entire refining process. We also aim to expand the technology to plastic recycling, biofuel purification, and other sustainable chemical processes that support carbon neutrality."
paras.zh: 该研究的共同第一作者、韩国科学技术院的 Jihoon Choi 博士和 Hyeokjun Seo 博士表示：“我们的目标是精确控制这种自发的孔隙收缩现象，并将其开发成适用于整个精炼过程的膜平台。我们还旨在将该技术扩展到塑料回收、生物燃料纯化和其他支持碳中和的可持续化学过程。”

paras.en: The research received support from Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT through the Basic Research Program for Outstanding Early-Career Researchers and the Engineering Research Center (ERC) Program.
paras.zh: 该研究通过杰出早期职业研究人员基础研究计划和工程研究中心 (ERC) 计划获得了韩国科学和信息通信技术部的支持。

articles.title: You don't have to go to the moon to see Earth differently: Artemis II astronaut Victor Glover on what really matters
articles.author: Daisy Dobrijevic

paras.en: TENERIFE, Canary Islands — Imagine traveling over 250 million miles from home, watching Earth disappear behind the moon and losing contact with the billions of people who call it home. What would you miss most?
paras.zh: 加那利群岛特内里费岛——想象一下，离开家乡超过 2.5 亿英里，看着地球消失在月球后面，并与数十亿称之为家乡的人失去联系。你最想念什么？

paras.en: For Artemis II astronaut Victor Glover, the answer wasn't a particular place, a familiar view or even the comforts of home. It was something much more fundamental: human connection.
paras.zh: 对于阿耳忒弥斯二号宇航员维克多·格洛弗来说，答案不是某个特定的地方、熟悉的景色，甚至不是舒适的家。这是更基本的东西：人与人之间的联系。

paras.en: Speaking during a discussion with former astronaut Chris Hadfield at the Starmus VIII festival on Oct. 18 in Tenerife, Canary Islands, Glover reflected on the extraordinary experience of traveling around the moon and how being so far from Earth had given him a renewed appreciation for the people living on it.
paras.zh: 10 月 18 日，在加那利群岛特内里费岛举行的 Starmus VIII 音乐节上，格洛弗在与前宇航员克里斯·哈德菲尔德 (Chris Hadfield) 的讨论中发表讲话，回顾了绕月旅行的非凡经历，以及远离地球如何让他对生活在月球上的人们重新产生了感激之情。

paras.en: "The greatest reason to go to space, it isn't to be a swashbuckler hero," Glover said. "It's to do something that only 651 people have been able to do: miss Earth and miss other Earthlings."
paras.zh: “进入太空的最大原因不是成为一名虚张声势的英雄，”格洛弗说。 “这是为了做一些只有 651 个人能够做到的事情：想念地球并想念其他地球人。”

paras.en: Glover was one of the four astronauts aboard NASA's Artemis II mission, which launched on April 1, 2026, marking humanity's first crewed journey to the moon since Apollo 17 in 1972. Alongside NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman and Christina Koch and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen, the crew traveled farther from Earth than any humans before them.
paras.zh: 格洛弗是美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯二号任务的四名宇航员之一，该任务于 2026 年 4 月 1 日发射，标志着人类自 1972 年阿波罗 17 号以来首次载人登月之旅。与美国宇航局宇航员里德·怀斯曼、克里斯蒂娜·科赫以及加拿大航天局宇航员杰里米·汉森一起，宇航员们比之前的任何人类都离地球更远。

paras.en: As the Orion spacecraft traversed the far side of the moon, the Artemis II crew watched Earth disappear below the lunar horizon before losing radio contact with our planet. Around 40 minutes later, Earth came back into view as the spacecraft emerged from behind the moon.
paras.zh: 当猎户座宇宙飞船穿越月球背面时，阿耳忒弥斯二号船员看到地球消失在月球地平线以下，然后与我们的星球失去了无线电联系。大约 40 分钟后，随着航天器从月球后面出现，地球重新出现在人们的视野中。

paras.en: For Glover, however, the experience was about much more than the view. He believes that if everyone on Earth had the opportunity to make the same journey, they would come away with a similar appreciation for what they'd left behind.
paras.zh: 然而，对于格洛弗来说，体验的意义远不止于风景。他相信，如果地球上的每个人都有机会进行同样的旅程，他们会对自己留下的东西有类似的感激之情。

paras.en: "I think all of us would say something in our native language, in the most basic way we can communicate about love, joy, hope and inspiration," Glover said.
paras.zh: “我认为我们所有人都会用我们的母语说一些话，以最基本的方式我们可以交流爱、欢乐、希望和灵感，”格洛弗说。

paras.en: Although Glover shared the extraordinary journey with three fellow astronauts, the four of them were separated from the rest of humanity by hundreds of thousands of miles.
paras.zh: 尽管格洛弗与三名宇航员同伴分享了这段非凡的旅程，但他们四人与其他人类相距数十万英里。

paras.en: And for Glover, that distance brought with it a strange contradiction: the farther he traveled from humanity, the more he longed to connect with it.
paras.zh: 对于格洛弗来说，这种距离带来了一个奇怪的矛盾：他离人类越远，他就越渴望与人类建立联系。

paras.en: "At the point of ultimate disconnection, [there is] this longing for connection," Glover said.
paras.zh: “在最终断开连接的时刻，[存在]这种对联系的渴望，”格洛弗说。

paras.en: The experience gave him a perspective that he carried back into everyday life.
paras.zh: 这次经历给了他一种视角，并将其带回到日常生活中。

paras.en: "There are moments where I am rushing through traffic and want to get where I'm going because I'm being selfish," Glover admitted. "But I don't have to stay there."
paras.zh: “有时候我会冲过车流，想要到达我要去的地方，因为我很自私，”格洛弗承认。 “但我不必留在那里。”

paras.en: Instead, he remembers what it felt like to look back at a planet so distant that everyone who has ever lived could be covered by his hand.
paras.zh: 相反，他记得回望一颗如此遥远的星球的感觉，以至于所有曾经生活过的人都可以被他的手覆盖。

paras.en: "I wish you could all feel what it's like to come back home after that disconnection," he said.
paras.zh: “我希望你们都能感受到断网后回到家的感觉，”他说。

paras.en: Astronauts often describe experiencing the "overview effect", a profound shift in perspective that can come from seeing Earth from space. But Glover believes that there's something equally powerful waiting to be discovered much closer to home.
paras.zh: 宇航员经常描述体验“概览效应”，这是从太空观察地球所带来的一种深刻的视角转变。但格洛弗相信，在离家更近的地方还有同样强大的东西等待被发现。

paras.en: When asked by a Starmus VIII attendee whether people needed to undergo something extraordinary to develop a greater sense of kindness toward others, his answer was no.
paras.zh: 当 Starmus VIII 的一位与会者问人们是否需要经历一些非凡的事情才能对他人产生更大的友善感时，他的答案是否定的。

paras.en: Glover encouraged people to look more closely at the natural world around them, whether that meant walking along the beach, watching the ocean or simply examining a leaf held up to sunlight.
paras.zh: 格洛弗鼓励人们更仔细地观察周围的自然世界，无论这意味着沿着海滩散步、观看海洋还是只是检查阳光下的树叶。

paras.en: Even something as ordinary as a leaf, he explained, is capable of turning sunlight into food through photosynthesis. And although science can explain how that happens, understanding the process doesn't make it any less remarkable.
paras.zh: 他解释说，即使是像叶子这样普通的东西，也能够通过光合作用将阳光转化为食物。尽管科学可以解释这是如何发生的，但理解这个过程并不会让它变得不那么引人注目。

paras.en: "We have to choose to be moved by these things," Glover said.
paras.zh: “我们必须选择被这些事情感动，”格洛弗说。

paras.en: He worries that modern life, with its endless technological distractions, has made it all too easy to overlook the extraordinary things happening around us.
paras.zh: 他担心现代生活充满了无尽的科技干扰，让我们很容易忽视周围发生的非凡事情。

paras.en: "Familiarity breeds contempt. Have you heard this? I think it's worse than that. Familiarity breeds indifference," he said.
paras.zh: “熟悉会滋生蔑视。你听说过这个吗？我认为比这更糟糕。熟悉会滋生冷漠，”他说。

paras.en: Glover has a name for this perspective he hopes people can rediscover without traveling into space: The sea level effect.
paras.zh: 格洛弗希望人们无需进入太空就能重新发现这种观点，他为这种观点起了一个名字：海平面效应。

paras.en: It's about finding the same sense of wonder and connection that astronauts experience in orbit, but right here on Earth, where most of us spend our lives. And ultimately, Glover believes the greatest wonder isn't the moon, the stars, or even the incredible complexity of nature. It's the people we share our planet with.
paras.zh: 这是为了找到宇航员在轨道上所经历的同样的惊奇和联系感，但就在我们大多数人度过一生的地球上。最终，格洛弗认为，最伟大的奇迹不是月亮、星星，甚至不是大自然令人难以置信的复杂性。这是与我们共享地球的人们。

paras.en: "I think the hardest place to see this miracle is in the actual greatest miracle in the universe: other humans," he said.
paras.zh: “我认为最难看到这个奇迹的地方是宇宙中最伟大的奇迹：其他人类，”他说。

paras.en: "We all feel it with babies, but when we get old enough to have opinions, we start to want to argue with each other."
paras.zh: “我们在婴儿时期都有这种感觉，但当我们长大到有自己的观点时，我们就开始想要互相争论。”

paras.en: Glover hopes that by taking the time to appreciate the natural world, people might become a little more willing to appreciate one another too.
paras.zh: 格洛弗希望，通过花时间欣赏自然世界，人们也可能会变得更愿意互相欣赏。

paras.en: "That's the mission that I want to be part of for the rest of my life," Glover said.
paras.zh: “这就是我想在余生中参与的使命，”格洛弗说。

paras.en: Daisy Dobrijevic joined Space.com in February 2022, having previously worked as a staff writer for All About Space magazine. She completed an editorial internship with BBC Sky at Night Magazine and worked at the National Space Centre, communicating space science to the public.
paras.zh: Daisy Dobrijevic 于 2022 年 2 月加入 Space.com，此前曾担任《All About Space》杂志的特约撰稿人。她完成了 BBC Sky 夜间杂志的编辑实习，并在国家航天中心工作，向公众传播空间科学。

paras.en: Daisy holds a PhD in plant physiology and a Master's in Environmental Science. Based in Nottingham, U.K., she covers all things space, with a special focus on solar activity and space weather. She also has a keen interest in astrotourism and is always on the lookout for the next northern lights adventure.
paras.zh: 黛西拥有植物生理学博士学位和环境科学硕士学位。她居住在英国诺丁汉，研究太空的所有事物，特别关注太阳活动和太空天气。她还对天文旅游有着浓厚的兴趣，并且总是在寻找下一次北极光冒险。

paras.en: She will join Hurtigruten as an onboard astronomer for a northern lights sailing in January 2027.
paras.zh: 她将作为船上天文学家加入海达路德号，于 2027 年 1 月进行北极光航行。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 5, 2002: NASA's Galileo spacecraft flies by Jupiter moon Almathea only to find it's a 'pile of icy rubble less dense than water'
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 5, 2002, NASA's old Galileo spacecraft was almost out of fuel. But the Jupiter mission still had some science to do. Galileo flew by a small moon called Amalthea. Amalthea is small, but it's interesting for scientists.
paras.zh: 2002年11月5日，美国宇航局的旧伽利略号宇宙飞船几乎耗尽了燃料。但木星任务仍然有一些科学工作要做。伽利略飞过一颗名为阿玛尔忒亚的小卫星。 Amalthea 虽然很小，但对科学家来说很有趣。

paras.en: The Jupiter moon Amalthea is the reddest object in our solar system. It also generates more heat than it gets from the sun. Scientists think Amalthea creates electrical currents as it orbits in Jupiter's huge magnetic field. Near this little moon, strong radiation from Jupiter is dangerous for spacecraft.
paras.zh: 木星卫星阿玛尔忒亚是太阳系中最红的天体。它还产生比从太阳获得的热量更多的热量。科学家认为，阿玛尔忒亚在木星巨大的磁场中绕轨道运行时会产生电流。在这颗小卫星附近，来自木星的强烈辐射对航天器来说是危险的。

paras.en: The flyby caused some problems for Galileo. The spacecraft went into safe mode only 30 minutes after going past Amalthea. NASA said it was ready for problems, because Galileo was on its last legs, and the radiation near Amalthea was strong. However, NASA quickly fixed the problem and got Galileo working again.
paras.zh: 这次飞越给伽利略带来了一些问题。航天器在经过阿玛尔西娅仅 30 分钟后就进入安全模式。美国宇航局表示，它已做好应对问题的准备，因为伽利略已经奄奄一息，而且阿马尔西亚附近的辐射很强。然而，美国宇航局很快解决了这个问题，让伽利略号再次工作。

paras.en: Less than a year later, Galileo threw itself into Jupiter's atmosphere. The spacecraft was crushed by the high pressure in Jupiter's atmosphere, but its data still survives on Earth.
paras.zh: 不到一年后，伽利略号就进入了木星的大气层。航天器被木星大气层的高压压碎，但其数据仍然保存在地球上。

paras.en: The Galileo spacecraft was running on cosmic fumes by the time it reached Amalthea and the flyby would be the last time the probe would ever swing by one of Jupiter's moons.
paras.zh: 当伽利略号宇宙飞船到达阿玛尔忒亚时，它已经在宇宙烟雾中运行，这次飞越将是探测器最后一次绕过木星的卫星。

paras.en: While it may not look like it in Galileo's black and white images above and below, Amalthea is tinted red due sulfur contamination on its surface. The moon is small, about 168 miles long, and orbits about 112,468 miles (181,000 km) from Jupiter (much closer to the planet than the Earth and its moon).
paras.zh: 虽然它看起来可能不像伽利略的上下黑白图像中的样子，但阿马尔泰亚由于其表面的硫污染而呈现红色。月球很小，长约 168 英里，绕木星运行约 112,468 英里（181,000 公里）（比地球及其月球更靠近木星）。

paras.en: Galileo flew within 99 miles of Amalthea during its flyby, which also marked the closest Galileo would get to Jupiter before its death dive in September 2005.
paras.zh: 伽利略号在飞越阿玛尔忒亚时距离木星 99 英里以内，这也标志着伽利略号在 2005 年 9 月死亡潜水之前距离木星最近的一次。

paras.en: "Scientists studying data from NASA's Galileo spacecraft have found that Jupiter's moon Amalthea is a pile of icy rubble less dense than water," NASA announced in May 2005
paras.zh: NASA 于 2005 年 5 月宣布：“研究 NASA 伽利略号宇宙飞船数据的科学家发现，木星的卫星 Amalthea 是一堆密度比水还小的冰冷碎石”

paras.en: "Amalthea is throwing us a curve ball," Torrence Johnson, a study co-author on the Almathea flyby and project scientist for the Galileo mission at JPL, said in 2005. "Its density is well below that of water ice, and even with substantial porosity, Amalthea probably contains a lot of water ice, as well as rock."
paras.zh: “阿玛西亚正在向我们抛出一个曲线球，”托伦斯·约翰逊（Torrence Johnson）是阿玛西亚飞越研究的合著者，也是喷气推进实验室伽利略任务的项目科学家，他在 2005 年表示，“它的密度远低于水冰的密度，即使孔隙度很大，阿玛西亚可能含有大量的水冰以及岩石。”

paras.en: Originally known as Jupiter V (because it was the fifth Jupiter moon discovered after the so-called Galilean moons Io, Europa, Ganymede, Callisto), Amalthea was named after naiad, or water nymph, from Greek mythology.
paras.zh: 阿玛尔忒亚最初被称为木星五号（因为它是继所谓的伽利略卫星木卫一、欧罗巴、木卫三、木卫四之后发现的第五颗木星卫星），阿玛尔忒亚以希腊神话中的水仙女（naiad）命名。

paras.en: It is fitting that Amalthea was the last of Jupiter's moons to be visited by the Galileo spacecraft. The moon was also last Jupiter moon to be discovered by visual observations when it was first disovered by astronomer Edward Emerson Barnard in September 1892 using the Lick Observatory telescope in California.
paras.zh: 阿玛尔忒亚是伽利略号宇宙飞船访问的最后一颗木星卫星，这是很恰当的。这颗卫星也是最后一颗通过目视观测发现的木星卫星，由天文学家爱德华·爱默生·巴纳德 (Edward Emerson Barnard) 于 1892 年 9 月使用加利福尼亚州利克天文台望远镜首次发现。

paras.en: The Galileo spacecraft ultimately crashed into Jupiter on Sept. 21, 2005, less than a year after its Amalthea flyby.
paras.zh: 伽利略号宇宙飞船最终于 2005 年 9 月 21 日坠入木星，此时距其飞越阿马尔西娅还不到一年。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: Earth has captured a new mini moon  — but it won't stick around for long
articles.author: Robert Lea

paras.en: Earth has caught itself a new mini-moon, and it is sticking around for Christmas.
paras.zh: 地球已经捕获了一个新的迷你月亮，并且它将在圣诞节期间留下来。

paras.en: The space rock, designated 2026 QQ8, was first observed in August 2026 after entering orbit around Earth in April 2026. The discovery was reported by the International Astronomical Union's Minor Planet Center on Thursday (Oct. 29).
paras.zh: 这颗太空岩石被命名为 2026 QQ8，于 2026 年 4 月进入绕地球轨道后于 2026 年 8 月首次被观测到。国际天文学联合会小行星中心周四（10 月 29 日）报告了这一发现。

paras.en: The stay of QQ8 is a temporary one. The mini-moon will remain in the thrall of Earth's gravity through December before breaking away in 2027.
paras.zh: QQ8的停留是暂时的。整个 12 月，这颗小卫星将一直受到地球引力的束缚，然后在 2027 年脱离地球。

paras.en: Scientists have recreated the orbital path of QQ8, finding that it takes 359 days, or about 0.98 of an Earth year, to orbit the sun. QQ8 closely approaches Earth around once every ten years, but this time the object came so close that Earth has been able to gravitationally seize it.
paras.zh: 科学家们重建了 QQ8 的轨道路径，发现绕太阳运行一周需要 359 天，即大约 0.98 个地球年。 QQ8大约每十年靠近地球一次，但这一次该物体距离地球如此之近，以至于地球能够通过引力抓住它。

paras.en: According to the Minor Planet Center, the closest QQ8 will come to our planet during this stay is around 353,000 miles (568,000 kilometers). That is around 110,000 miles (177,000 km) further out than the average distance between Earth and the moon.
paras.zh: 根据小行星中心的数据，QQ8 在这次停留期间距离我们星球最近的距离约为 353,000 英里（568,000 公里）。这比地球和月球之间的平均距离远约 110,000 英里（177,000 公里）。

paras.en: Even if QQ8 were to come close enough to collide with Earth, it would likely be completely destroyed in our planet's atmosphere before it reaches the surface, as it is only around 6 feet (2 meters) in diameter.
paras.zh: 即使 QQ8 距离地球足够近，足以与地球相撞，它也可能在到达地表之前在地球大气层中被完全摧毁，因为它的直径仅为 6 英尺（2 米）左右。

paras.en: This is far from the first time Earth has snagged itself a mini-moon, more accurately called a temporary satellite. In fact, research last year suggested that our planet could be orbited by as many as six mini-moons at any given time, with many of these being fragments of our more permanent natural satellite, the moon.
paras.zh: 这远非地球第一次为自己捕获一颗迷你卫星，更准确地说是一颗临时卫星。事实上，去年的研究表明，在任何给定时间，我们的星球可能有多达六个迷你卫星围绕其运行，其中许多是我们更永久的天然卫星月球的碎片。

paras.en: While QQ8 is tiny, it is larger than the average mini-moon. That is according to modelling earlier this year that suggested the average size for a temporary satellite is 75 centimeters (30 inches) across.
paras.zh: 虽然QQ8很小，但它比普通的迷你月亮还要大。根据今年早些时候的模型，临时卫星的平均尺寸为 75 厘米（30 英寸）宽。

paras.en: The same modelling suggested the average stay for such an object would be around nine months.
paras.zh: 同一模型表明，此类物体的平均停留时间约为九个月。

paras.en: So if QQ8 was captured in April 2026, that means it should move away in January 2027.
paras.zh: 因此，如果 QQ8 在 2026 年 4 月被捕获，那就意味着它应该在 2027 年 1 月离开。

paras.en: The researchers behind those findings suggested that, were Earth to gravitationally grip a space rock around 10 feet (3 meters) wide, it could serve as a mini-moon for 10 to 20 years.
paras.zh: 这些发现背后的研究人员表示，如果地球能够通过引力抓住一块大约 10 英尺（3 米）宽的太空岩石，它可以充当迷你月球 10 到 20 年。

paras.en: Robert Lea is a science journalist in the U.K. whose articles have been published in Physics World, New Scientist, Astronomy Magazine, All About Space, Newsweek and ZME Science. He also writes about science communication for Elsevier and the European Journal of Physics. Rob holds a bachelor of science degree in physics and astronomy from the U.K.’s Open University. Follow him on Twitter @sciencef1rst.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·李 (Robert Lea) 是一位英国科学记者，其文章发表在《物理世界》、《新科学家》、《天文学杂志》、《All About Space》、《新闻周刊》和《ZME Science》上。他还为爱思唯尔和《欧洲物理学杂志》撰写有关科学传播的文章。 Rob 拥有英国开放大学物理和天文学理学学士学位。在 Twitter 上关注他@sciencef1rst。

articles.title: Simera Sense and Spacemanic to Collaborate on a New Complete Dual-Use Mission Solution
articles.author: Spacemanic

paras.en: Czech company Spacemanic and Belgian optical leader Simera Sense are teaming up to deliver a new dual-use satellite solution that can compete with bigger and heavier satellites. Simera Sense xScape200 Dual-Use (DU) camera is integrated into Spacemanic 16U CubeSat platform, bringing high-resolution imaging capabilities to a lightweight, compact spacecraft designed for repeatable deployment and constellation growth.
paras.zh: 捷克公司 Spacemanic 和比利时光学领导者 Simera Sense 正在联手提供一种新的两用卫星解决方案，可以与更大、更重的卫星竞争。 Simera Sense xScape200 两用 (DU) 相机集成到 Spacemanic 16U CubeSat 平台中，为专为可重复部署和星座增长而设计的轻型紧凑型航天器带来高分辨率成像功能。

paras.en: The xScape200 DU combines a compact 12U form factor, low SWaP, and standardised integration to give commercial and defence organisations high-resolution, dual-use imaging capabilities without the need for a larger spacecraft, increased launch costs, or power-intensive mission architectures.
paras.zh: xScape200 DU 结合了紧凑的 12U 外形尺寸、低 SWaP 和标准化集成，为商业和国防组织提供高分辨率、两用成像功能，而无需更大的航天器、增加发射成本或功耗密集型任务架构。

paras.en: Spacemanic designs and builds its satellite platforms, core subsystems and deployers in-house. Owning the whole chain lets the company shape the satellite around the camera instead of forcing the camera into a standard form factor. That covers the satellite’s structure and envelope, its mechanical, electrical, thermal and data interfaces, and how the satellite integrates with the deployer.
paras.zh: Spacemanic 在内部设计和建造卫星平台、核心子系统和部署器。拥有整个链条可以让公司围绕相机塑造卫星，而不是强迫相机采用标准的外形尺寸。其中涵盖了卫星的结构和外壳、机械、电气、热和数据接口，以及卫星如何与部署者集成。

paras.en: The SPACE CANNON deployer accommodates CubeSats up to 16U, with an expanded integration envelope for payloads with protruding elements on the sides and a tuna can at the bottom. This additional space supports larger payload configurations such as the xScape200 DU camera. Removable side panels on all four sides provide direct access to the satellite after integration, enabling final adjustments right before launch. SPACE CANNON is designed for integration with launch vehicles including Falcon 9, Ariane 6, Vega-C, HyImpulse SL1, InnoSpace Hanbit, Spectrum by Isar Aerospace, RFA ONE and HyPrSpace Baguette One.
paras.zh: SPACE CANNON 部署器可容纳高达 16U 的立方体卫星，并具有扩展的有效载荷集成外壳，侧面有突出元件，底部有一个金枪鱼罐头。这个额外的空间支持更大的有效负载配置，例如 xScape200 DU 相机。所有四个侧面的可拆卸侧面板可在集成后直接访问卫星，从而在发射前进行最终调整。 SPACE CANNON 设计用于与 Falcon 9、Ariane 6、Vega-C、HyImpulse SL1、InnoSpace Hanbit、Spectrum by Isar Aerospace、RFA ONE 和 HyPrSpace Baguette One 等运载火箭集成。

paras.en: Together, the camera, tailored platform and deployer form a complete mission solution that simplifies the path from payload integration to launch. Beyond the technical development, Spacemanic and Simera are shaping the future of the commercial and dual use market.
paras.zh: 相机、定制平台和部署器共同构成了完整的任务解决方案，简化了从有效载荷集成到发射的路径。除了技术开发之外，Spacemanic 和 Simera 还在塑造商业和军民两用市场的未来。

articles.title: Cork Takes the Heat So DRACO’s Data Can Survive
articles.author: Amorim Cork Solutions

paras.en: Mozelos, Portugal, September 2, 2026 – Amorim Cork Solutions is contributing its P50 cork-based thermal protection material to DRACO, a European Space Agency (ESA) mission designed to capture rare in-flight data on how satellites break apart during atmospheric reentry.
paras.zh: 葡萄牙莫泽洛斯，2026 年 9 月 2 日 – Amorim Cork Solutions 正在向 DRACO 贡献其 P50 软木热防护材料，DRACO 是欧洲航天局 (ESA) 的一项任务，旨在捕获有关卫星在重返大气层期间如何分解的罕见飞行数据。

paras.en: Scheduled for launch in 2027, DRACO, short for Destructive Reentry Assessment Container Object, will deliberately reenter Earth’s atmosphere and break apart. Around 200 sensors and four cameras will record what happens to the spacecraft throughout the process, generating data that could help improve reentry models and support the development of safer, more sustainable spacecraft.
paras.zh: DRACO（破坏性再入评估容器物体的缩写）计划于 2027 年发射，将故意重新进入地球大气层并解体。大约 200 个传感器和四个摄像头将记录航天器在整个过程中发生的情况，生成有助于改进再入模型并支持开发更安全、更可持续的航天器的数据。

paras.en: At the heart of this unusual engineering challenge is a 40 cm survival capsule. While the spacecraft around it is designed to break apart, the capsule must survive long enough to preserve and transmit the mission’s critical scientific data. Its heat shield will use Amorim P50, a cork-based ablative thermal protection material developed for demanding aerospace environments.
paras.zh: 这项不同寻常的工程挑战的核心是一个 40 厘米的救生舱。虽然它周围的航天器被设计为会分解，但太空舱必须存活足够长的时间才能保存和传输任务的关键科学数据。其隔热罩将使用 Amorim P50，这是一种基于软木的烧蚀热防护材料，专为要求苛刻的航空航天环境而开发。

paras.en: During reentry, DRACO will encounter intense thermal and mechanical conditions as the spacecraft progressively breaks apart. Data collected by its sensors and cameras will be processed onboard, with the most valuable information transferred to the survival capsule.
paras.zh: 在重返大气层期间，随着航天器逐渐解体，DRACO 将遇到强烈的热和机械条件。其传感器和摄像头收集的数据将在船上进行处理，最有价值的信息将传输到救生舱中。

paras.en: Protecting that capsule is therefore essential to the mission.
paras.zh: 因此，保护​​该太空舱对于此次任务至关重要。

paras.en: The von Karman Institute for Fluid Dynamics (VKI), which is responsible for key aspects of the capsule’s design, aerothermodynamics, and thermal protection development and validation, selected Amorim P50 for its heat shield.
paras.zh: 冯卡门流体动力学研究所 (VKI) 负责胶囊设计、空气热力学以及热防护开发和验证的关键方面，选择 Amorim P50 作为其隔热罩。

paras.en: P50 is a lightweight, cork-based ablative material designed to provide thermal protection in demanding aerospace applications. Its selection for DRACO builds on approximately 15 years of collaboration between Amorim and VKI in the field of aerothermodynamics and thermal protection.
paras.zh: P50 是一种轻质软木烧蚀材料，旨在为要求苛刻的航空航天应用提供热保护。 DRACO 的选择建立在 Amorim 和 VKI 在空气热力学和热防护领域约 15 年的合作基础上。

paras.en: “DRACO represents a remarkable engineering challenge: designing a spacecraft to break apart while ensuring that the knowledge generated during that process survives,” said Sofia Paixão, Global Technical & Product Manager at Amorim Cork Solutions. “We are proud to see Amorim P50 contributing to that challenge and to a mission that could deepen our understanding of atmospheric reentry and help inform the design of future spacecraft.”
paras.zh: Amorim Cork Solutions 全球技术和产品经理 Sofia Paixão 表示：“DRACO 代表了一项非凡的工程挑战：设计一艘能够分解的航天器，同时确保该过程中产生的知识得以保存。” “我们很自豪看到 Amorim P50 为这一挑战和任务做出贡献，该任务可以加深我们对大气层再入的理解，并有助于为未来航天器的设计提供信息。”

paras.en: Ahead of the mission, the capsule’s thermal protection system has undergone experimental validation at VKI.
paras.zh: 在执行任务之前，太空舱的热保护系统已在 VKI 进行了实验验证。

paras.en: A half-scale version of the capsule was exposed to plasma flows in VKI’s facilities to reproduce key aspects of the aerothermal environment expected during atmospheric reentry. The tests allowed the team to evaluate the heat shield and overall thermal protection design under reentry-like conditions before progressing toward the full-scale capsule.
paras.zh: 半比例版本的太空舱在 VKI 设施中暴露于等离子流中，以重现大气再入期间预期的气热环境的关键方面。这些测试使团队能够在类似重返大气层的条件下评估隔热罩和整体热防护设计，然后再进入全尺寸太空舱。

paras.en: “We have extensively tested P50 within the DRACO programme. It is a highly insulating, robust, and predictable ablative material that is readily available on the commercial market,” said Dr. Bernd Helber, Research Expert in Aerothermochemistry at the von Karman Institute for Fluid Dynamics (VKI).
paras.zh: “我们在 DRACO 计划中对 P50 进行了广泛的测试。它是一种高度绝缘、坚固且可预测的烧蚀材料，在商业市场上很容易买到，”冯卡门流体动力学研究所 (VKI) 空气热化学研究专家 Bernd Helber 博士说。

paras.en: The DRACO mission is not the first time Amorim P50 has been used by VKI for an experimental reentry spacecraft. The material was previously selected for QARMAN, the QubeSat for Aerothermodynamic Research and Measurements on AblatioN, developed by VKI to collect data during atmospheric reentry.
paras.zh: DRACO 任务并不是 VKI 第一次将 Amorim P50 用于实验性再入航天器。该材料之前曾被用于QARMAN（用于空气热力学研究和烧蚀测量的QubeSat）选择，该卫星由VKI 开发，用于收集大气再入过程中的数据。

paras.en: DRACO marks the next chapter in this long-standing collaboration, bringing cork-based thermal protection technology to a new European mission with an ambitious scientific objective.
paras.zh: DRACO 标志着这一长期合作的新篇章，将基于软木塞的热防护技术带入新的欧洲使命，实现雄心勃勃的科学目标。

paras.en: Once DRACO begins its final descent, its sensors and cameras will document the spacecraft’s breakup and transfer the most important information to the protected capsule.
paras.zh: 一旦 DRACO 开始最后的下降，它的传感器和摄像机将记录航天器的解体并将最重要的信息传输到受保护的太空舱。

paras.en: The data collected by DRACO is expected to provide valuable insight into how spacecraft structures and materials behave during atmospheric reentry. The findings will help improve reentry models and support ESA’s work on Design for Demise, an approach aimed at designing spacecraft so that they break up more completely during reentry, reducing the risk posed by surviving debris.
paras.zh: DRACO 收集的数据预计将为航天器结构和材料在重返大气层期间的行为提供有价值的见解。这些发现将有助于改进再入模型，并支持欧空局的“死亡设计”工作，该方法旨在设计航天器，使其在再入过程中更彻底地解体，从而降低残存碎片带来的风险。

paras.en: The mission contributes to ESA’s broader Zero Debris approach, which aims to significantly reduce the creation of debris in Earth and lunar orbits by 2030.
paras.zh: 该任务为欧空局更广泛的零碎片方法做出了贡献，该方法的目标是到 2030 年大幅减少地球和月球轨道上碎片的产生。

paras.en: For Amorim Cork Solutions, DRACO further demonstrates the role cork-based thermal protection materials can play in demanding space applications, combining the natural thermal properties of cork with engineered solutions developed to perform under extreme conditions.
paras.zh: 对于阿莫林软木解决方案，DRACO 进一步展示了基于软木的热防护材料在要求苛刻的空间应用中可以发挥的作用，将软木的自然热性能与为在极端条件下运行而开发的工程解决方案相结合。

articles.title: Hubble Learns Galactic History From Stars

paras.en: This NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope image provides a lesson in galactic history. The sparkling collection of stars is named Messier 30 (M30) after the French astronomer, Charles Messier, who cataloged M30 and other diffuse objects that might be mistaken for comets in the early telescopes of Messier’s time. M30 lies about 27,500 light-years away in the constellation Capricornus.
paras.zh: 这张美国宇航局/欧洲航天局哈勃太空望远镜的图像为银河历史提供了教训。这个闪闪发光的恒星集合被命名为梅西耶 30 (M30)，以法国天文学家查尔斯·梅西耶 (Charles Messier) 的名字命名，他对 M30 和其他在梅西耶时代的早期望远镜中可能被误认为彗星的漫射天体进行了编目。 M30 位于摩羯座，距离我们约 27,500 光年。

paras.en: M30 is a globular cluster: a roughly spherical grouping of stars containing anywhere from tens of thousands to millions of stars. These clusters generally reside on the outskirts of galaxies, orbiting within a vast, diffuse region called the halo like a swarm of moths around a lightbulb. Our Milky Way galaxy has at least 150 globular clusters, the nearest of which is about 6,000 light-years away. These clusters are impressively ancient: astronomers estimate their ages are between 11.5 to 13.5 billion years, making certain globular clusters nearly as old as the universe itself.
paras.zh: M30 是一个球状星团：大致呈球形的恒星群，包含数万到数百万颗恒星。这些星团通常位于星系的外围，在一个巨大的、分散的区域（称为光环）内绕轨道运行，就像一群飞蛾围绕着灯泡一样。我们的银河系至少有 150 个球状星团，其中最近的球状星团距我们约 6000 光年。这些星团非常古老：天文学家估计它们的年龄在 11.5 至 135 亿年之间，使得某些球状星团几乎与宇宙本身一样古老。

paras.en: Globular clusters have long played an important role in helping us learn about our galaxy. More than a century ago, astronomer Harlow Shapley used observations of a particular type of variable star to measure the locations of and distances to dozens of globular clusters within our galaxy. His work showed that the Sun is not in the center of our galaxy, and that the galactic center lies toward the constellation Sagittarius. (His distance measurements were incorrect, however, and he concluded that our galaxy is about twice as large as it really is.)
paras.zh: 球状星团长期以来在帮助我们了解银河系方面发挥着重要作用。一个多世纪前，天文学家哈洛·沙普利利用对特定类型变星的观测来测量银河系内数十个球状星团的位置和距离。他的工作表明太阳并不位于我们银河系的中心，银河系中心位于人马座附近。 （然而，他的距离测量是不正确的，他得出的结论是，我们的星系大约是实际大小的两倍。）

paras.en: Today, astronomers continue to learn about our galaxy by observing globular clusters. Because globular clusters are so ancient, they can give us clues about how our galaxy developed long ago. Globular clusters that formed within our galaxy can act as time capsules, preserving the original chemistry of our young galaxy.
paras.zh: 今天，天文学家继续通过观察球状星团来了解我们的星系。由于球状星团非常古老，它们可以为我们提供有关银河系很久以前如何发展的线索。在我们的星系内形成的球状星团可以充当时间胶囊，保留我们年轻星系的原始化学成分。

paras.en: However, it’s possible that not all globular clusters that orbit within our galaxy today formed there. Researchers have discovered that M30 and many other globular clusters orbit in the direction opposite from the way our galaxy spins. This may mean that these clusters did not form within our galaxy at all. Instead, our Milky Way galaxy may have captured them in the distant past!
paras.zh: 然而，今天在我们银河系内运行的所有球状星团可能并非都是在那里形成的。研究人员发现，M30 和许多其他球状星团的轨道运行方向与我们星系的自转方向相反。这可能意味着这些星团根本不是在我们的银河系内形成的。相反，我们的银河系可能在遥远的过去捕获了它们！

paras.en: Hubble has observed M30 multiple times. A previously released image of M30 featured data from Hubble’s Advanced Camera for Surveys (ACS) and was part of an observing program (#10775; PI: Sarajedini) that surveyed dozens of Milky Way globular clusters in red and near-infrared light, revealing stars down to just 20% of the mass of the Sun. A more recent program (#13297; PI: Piotto) returned to M30 and other globular clusters in our galaxy, this time observing the clusters with Hubble’s Wide Field Camera 3 and using three filters that captured bluer light. This program collected data that was critical for studying exotic objects like “blue straggler” stars as well as for investigating the multiple populations of stars that can inhabit a single globular cluster.
paras.zh: 哈勃曾多次观测到 M30。之前发布的 M30 图像包含来自哈勃高级巡天相机 (ACS) 的数据，并且是观测计划 (#10775；PI：Sarajedini) 的一部分，该计划在红光和近红外光下观测了数十个银河系球状星团，揭示了质量仅为太阳质量 20% 的恒星。最近的一个项目（#13297；PI：Piotto）返回了 M30 和我们银河系中的其他球状星团，这次用哈勃的广域相机 3 观察这些星团，并使用三个捕捉蓝光的滤光片。该计划收集的数据对于研究“蓝散乱”恒星等奇异天体以及研究可以居住在单个球状星团中的多个恒星群体至关重要。

paras.en: More recently, Hubble’s ACS viewed many of these globular clusters again. Those observations were part of a program (#16298, PI: Libralato) that looked at how different populations of stars in globular clusters moved over the 15 years since Hubble first observed them — a feat made possible by Hubble’s longevity and ability to discern fantastically small details in distant objects.
paras.zh: 最近，哈勃的 ACS 再次观测到了许多这样的球状星团。这些观测是一个项目（#16298，PI：Libralato）的一部分，该项目研究了自哈勃首次观测球状星团中不同恒星群以来的 15 年间如何移动——哈勃的长寿和辨别遥远天体中极其微小细节的能力使这一壮举成为可能。

paras.en: The image above was created with data from all three observing programs and includes the wide range of wavelengths Hubble can see — ultraviolet, visible, and near-infrared light. Each wavelength helps us better understand how these groups of stars formed and evolved.
paras.zh: 上面的图像是根据所有三个观测计划的数据创建的，包括哈勃可以看到的广泛波长范围——紫外线、可见光和近红外光。每个波长都有助于我们更好地了解这些恒星群是如何形成和演化的。

articles.title: NASA Astronauts to Answer Questions from Florida Students
articles.author: Gerelle Q. Dodson

paras.en: Students in Florida will hear from NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney as they answer prerecorded STEM questions while aboard the International Space Station.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州的学生将在国际空间站上听到 NASA 宇航员 Jessica Watkins 和 Luke Delaney 回答预先录制的 STEM 问题。

paras.en: The Earth-to-space call will begin at 10:40 a.m. EST Tuesday, Nov. 10, and will stream live on the agency’s Learn With NASA YouTube channel.
paras.zh: 地对空通话将于美国东部时间 11 月 10 日星期二上午 10:40 开始，并将在该机构的 Learn With NASA YouTube 频道上进行直播。

paras.en: This event is hosted by Freedom Crossing Academy in St. Johns, Florida, for students in grades K-12, and the community. This unique opportunity aims to deepen understanding of space exploration and enhance awareness of STEM careers.
paras.zh: 该活动由佛罗里达州圣约翰斯的 Freedom Crossing Academy 为 K-12 年级的学生和社区举办。这一独特的机会旨在加深对太空探索的理解并增强对 STEM 职业的认识。

paras.en: Media interested in covering the event must RSVP no later than 5 p.m. EST, Monday, Nov. 9, to Christina Upchurch at (904) 547-7517, or at christina.upchurch@stjohns.k12.fl.us.
paras.zh: 有兴趣报道该活动的媒体必须在下午 5 点之前回复。美国东部时间，11 月 9 日星期一，致电 Christina Upchurch，电话 (904) 547-7517，或发送电子邮件至 christina.upchurch@stjohns.k12.fl.us。

paras.en: For more than 26 years, people have lived and worked continuously aboard the International Space Station, advancing scientific knowledge and making research breakthroughs not possible on Earth. The space station helps NASA understand and overcome the challenges of human spaceflight, expand commercial opportunities in low Earth orbit, and build on the foundation for long-duration missions to the Moon, as part of the Artemis program, and to Mars.
paras.zh: 26 年多来，人们在国际空间站上持续生活和工作，推进科学知识进步，取得地球上不可能的研究突破。该空间站帮助美国宇航局了解和克服载人航天的挑战，扩大近地轨道的商业机会，并为长期月球任务（作为阿尔忒弥斯计划的一部分）和火星任务奠定基础。
