articles.title: Fuel price shock: Why developing economies are paying the most at the pump

paras.en: Fuel price shock: Why developing economies are paying the most at the pump
paras.zh: 燃油价格冲击：为什么发展中经济体在加油站支付的费用最高

paras.en: When war shut the Strait of Hormuz in February, oil prices soared everywhere. But the pain at the pump has been far from equal, and the world’s developing economies are paying the heaviest price, according to a new report from UNCTAD, the UN trade and development agency.
paras.zh: 当二月份战争关闭霍尔木兹海峡时，各地石油价格飙升。但根据联合国贸易和发展机构贸发会议的一份新报告，加油站所承受的痛苦远非同等，世界发展中经济体正在付出最沉重的代价。

paras.en: Diesel prices in Nigeria jumped by about 83 per cent between late February and the end of August, compared with nine per cent in Ireland. Gasoline rose by about 51 per cent in Myanmar, but just three per cent in Sweden.
paras.zh: 2 月底至 8 月底期间，尼日利亚的柴油价格上涨了约 83%，而爱尔兰的柴油价格上涨了 9%。缅甸的汽油价格上涨了约 51%，但瑞典的汽油价格仅上涨了 3%。

paras.en: The reason lies partly in local conditions: taxes, subsidies, domestic pricing rules and exchange rates all shape what people end up paying.
paras.zh: 部分原因在于当地条件：税收、补贴、国内定价规则和汇率都会影响人们最终支付的费用。

paras.en: The price of Brent crude, the most widely used global benchmark, rose from around $70 a barrel in January to over $120 in March, as the closure of a route that normally carries a fifth of the world’s oil sent markets into a spin.
paras.zh: 作为使用最广泛的全球基准布伦特原油的价格从 1 月份的每桶 70 美元左右上涨到 3 月份的 120 美元以上，原因是一条通常承载全球五分之一石油的航线的关闭导致市场陷入混乱。

paras.en: Prices eased between April and June as diplomatic talks progressed, then climbed again when negotiations collapsed and fighting resumed.
paras.zh: 随着外交谈判的进展，价格在 4 月至 6 月期间有所下降，然后在谈判破裂和战斗重新开始时再次攀升。

paras.en: Futures markets suggest oil will stay expensive until the end of the year, keeping fuel and transport bills high for businesses and households.
paras.zh: 期货市场表明，直到今年年底，石油价格仍将保持昂贵，从而使企业和家庭的燃料和运输费用居高不下。

paras.en: Higher fuel prices trickle down to higher costs of living overall – even for those who never buy fuel directly. For instance, higher diesel prices mean it becomes more costly to transport goods, which brings up their price.
paras.zh: 燃油价格上涨会导致整体生活成本上升——即使对于那些从不直接购买燃油的人来说也是如此。例如，柴油价格上涨意味着运输货物的成本变得更高，从而推高了货物的价格。

paras.en: Earlier research on developing economies found that a 25 cent rise in fuel prices per litre could reduce household purchasing power by more than five percent on average.
paras.zh: 早期对发展中经济体的研究发现，每升燃油价格上涨 25 美分可能会使家庭购买力平均降低 5% 以上。

paras.en: Economies that depend heavily on imported fuel are particularly affected by oil price increases, UNCTAD noted, as they must spend more to meet their energy needs.
paras.zh: 贸发会议指出，严重依赖进口燃料的经济体尤其受到油价上涨的影响，因为它们必须花费更多资金来满足能源需求。

paras.en: For some countries, fuel imports already represent a significant economic burden. In 2023, net fuel imports – spending on fuel imports minus earnings from fuel exports – amounted to a quarter of Cabo Verde’s GDP and nearly a fifth of Lebanon’s.
paras.zh: 对于一些国家来说，燃料进口已经构成了巨大的经济负担。 2023年，燃料净进口量（燃料进口支出减去燃料出口收入）相当于佛得角国内生产总值的四分之一，接近黎巴嫩国内生产总值的五分之一。

paras.en: A higher fuel bill leaves less money for other imports like food, medicines and equipment, so governments already facing budget pressures have particularly less room to protect households from rising costs, UNCTAD stressed.
paras.zh: 贸发会议强调，燃料费用上涨导致用于食品、药品和设备等其他进口产品的资金减少，因此已经面临预算压力的政府保护家庭免受成本上升影响的空间尤其缩小。

paras.en: The UNCTAD report called for more varied energy supplies and investment in affordable renewables to reduce exposure to future shocks.
paras.zh: 贸发会议的报告呼吁更加多样化的能源供应和对负担得起的可再生能源的投资，以减少未来的冲击。

paras.en: Renewable energy sources like wind and solar rays are not vulnerable to geopolitical shocks and cannot be depleted.
paras.zh: 风能和太阳能等可再生能源不易受到地缘政治冲击的影响，也不会耗尽。

paras.en: UNCTAD also noted that in over 90 per cent of cases, renewables are less expensive than the cheapest new fossil fuel alternatives.
paras.zh: 贸发会议还指出，在超过 90% 的情况下，可再生能源比最便宜的新化石燃料替代品便宜。

articles.title: Two new Ebola vaccines to join DR Congo clinical trial

paras.en: Two new Ebola vaccines to join DR Congo clinical trial
paras.zh: 两种新的埃博拉疫苗将参加刚果民主共和国临床试验

paras.en: Two new Ebola vaccine candidates will be added to a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as the country continues to battle a deadly outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo species of the virus.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 正在继续抗击由本迪布焦 (Bundibugyo) 病毒引起的致命疫情，两种新的埃博拉候选疫苗将被添加到刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 的临床试验中。

paras.en: The announcement by the UN World Health Organization (WHO) follows the recommendation of its independent Technical Advisory Group on Candidate Vaccines Prioritization.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织（WHO）的这一宣布是根据其候选疫苗优先顺序独立技术咨询小组的建议而做出的。

paras.en: This will mark the first time that vaccines specifically designed for Bundibugyo virus will be evaluated during an outbreak of the disease.
paras.zh: 这将标志着专门针对本迪布焦病毒设计的疫苗将首次在疾病爆发期间进行评估。

paras.en: “The fact that these vaccines are ready to enter clinical trials is a testament to the power of science and partnership,” said WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus.
paras.zh: 世卫组织总干事谭德塞表示：“这些疫苗已准备好进入临床试验，这证明了科学和伙伴关系的力量。”

paras.en: He stressed that while vaccines alone will not end the outbreak, “they could become a powerful new tool for bringing it under control”.
paras.zh: 他强调，虽然疫苗本身并不能结束疫情，但“它们可以成为控制疫情的强大新工具”。

paras.en: The two vaccine candidates are ChAdOx1, developed by the University of Oxford with the Serum Institute of India, and mRNA-1469, developed by the American pharmaceutical and biotech company Moderna.
paras.zh: 这两种候选疫苗分别是牛津大学与印度血清研究所合作开发的 ChAdOx1 和美国制药和生物技术公司 Moderna 开发的 mRNA-1469。

paras.en: WHO convened the expert group which this week recommended them for further clinical evaluation, based on available evidence.
paras.zh: 世卫组织召集了专家组，本周建议他们根据现有证据进行进一步的临床评估。

paras.en: The DRC has been battling a deadly outbreak of Ebola disease caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus species for nearly six months and it has become the largest in the country’s history. As of 1 November, there were more than 10,500 confirmed cases and 5,126 deaths.
paras.zh: 近六个月来，刚果民主共和国一直在与罕见的本迪布焦病毒引起的致命埃博拉疫情作斗争，这已成为该国历史上规模最大的一次。截至11月1日，确诊病例超过10,500例，死亡病例5,126例。

paras.en: WHO is supporting the Tumaini multi-vaccine trial, named after the Swahili word for “hope”. It was launched on 23 October in the eastern city of Bunia, capital of Ituri province, which remains the epicentre of the outbreak.
paras.zh: 世卫组织正在支持图迈尼多种疫苗试验，该试验以斯瓦希里语“希望”一词命名。它于 10 月 23 日在伊图里省省会东部城市布尼亚启动，该省仍然是疫情的中心。

paras.en: The Ervebo vaccine, used to treat the Zaire species of the Ebola virus, is already being tested to determine if it is effective against Bundibugyo species. The two new vaccine candidates will enter the trial following national approvals.
paras.zh: 用于治疗扎伊尔埃博拉病毒的 Ervebo 疫苗已经过测试，以确定它是否对本迪布焦病毒有效。这两种新候选疫苗将在国家批准后进入试验。

paras.en: Tumaini is designed to test multiple vaccine candidates within a single trial, using a ring-vaccination approach that focuses on contacts of people with confirmed Ebola Bundibugyo.
paras.zh: Tumaini 旨在在一次试验中测试多种候选疫苗，采用环疫苗接种方法，重点关注已确诊的埃博拉本迪布焦患者的接触者。

paras.en: WHO and partners pioneered the strategy during the West Africa Ebola outbreak a decade ago, where a trial in Guinea established the efficacy of the Ervebo vaccine.
paras.zh: 十年前，世卫组织和合作伙伴在西非埃博拉疫情爆发期间率先采用了这一战略，几内亚的一项试验证实了 Ervebo 疫苗的功效。

paras.en: Four vaccination rings have been set up and several more are being prepared, while research into other potential treatments is also moving forward.
paras.zh: 四个疫苗接种环已经建立，另外几个疫苗接种环正在准备中，同时对其他潜在治疗方法的研究也在进行中。

articles.title: Children at risk as war zone attacks on water and sanitation more than triple

paras.en: Children at risk as war zone attacks on water and sanitation more than triple
paras.zh: 战区对水和卫生设施的攻击使儿童面临三倍以上的危险

paras.en: Attacks that damaged or destroyed water and sanitation systems in conflict zones tripled between 2021 and 2025, increasing children’s risk of exposure to disease outbreaks, malnutrition and violence.
paras.zh: 2021 年至 2025 年间，冲突地区破坏或破坏供水和卫生系统的袭击增加了两倍，增加了儿童遭受疾病爆发、营养不良和暴力的风险。

paras.en: That’s one key finding from the latest Water Under Fire report by the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF), published on Thursday.
paras.zh: 这是联合国儿童基金会 (UNICEF) 周四发布的最新《水下火灾》报告中的一项重要发现。

paras.en: It documents airstrikes and other assaults on water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) systems – and their personnel and communities that depend on these facilities – in 23 countries and territories.
paras.zh: 它记录了 23 个国家和地区对水、环境卫生和个人卫生 (WASH) 系统以及依赖这些设施的人员和社区的空袭和其他攻击。

paras.en: Attacks rose from fewer than 45 incidents across eight countries in 2021 to more than 135 incidents across 15 countries in 2025.
paras.zh: 攻击事件从 2021 年在 8 个国家发生的不到 45 起事件增加到 2025 年在 15 个国家发生的超过 135 起事件。

paras.en: UNICEF Executive Director Catherine Russell stressed that attacks on water and sanitation systems “deprive children of safe drinking water and the essential services that rely on water to function effectively”.
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会执行主任凯瑟琳·拉塞尔强调，对供水和卫生设施系统的攻击“剥夺了儿童的安全饮用水和依赖水有效运作的基本服务”。

paras.en: Water Under Fire 4 covers the period from January 2021 to June 2026, revealing an increasing pattern of attacks worldwide.
paras.zh: 《Water Under Fire 4》涵盖了 2021 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月期间，揭示了全球范围内不断增加的攻击模式。

paras.en: The report identified seven assault categories, ranging from strikes on treatment plants, pipelines and wells, to contamination of water sources, and imposing restrictions on the supply of spare parts and chemicals needed for water treatment.
paras.zh: 该报告确定了七种攻击类别，包括袭击处理厂、管道和水井，污染水源，以及限制水处理所需的备件和化学品的供应。

paras.en: It cited examples from places such as Sudan, where by March 2024, only one of the 13 water treatment plants in Khartoum state was fully operational, while more than 130,000 meters of sewage pipelines have been destroyed in the Gaza Strip since October 2023.
paras.zh: 报告列举了苏丹等地的例子，截至2024年3月，喀土穆州13座水处理厂中只有1座全面投入运营，而加沙地带自2023年10月以来已毁坏了超过13万米的污水管道。

paras.en: The report revealed how water supply disruptions can occur even if pipes and pumps remain intact.
paras.zh: 该报告揭示了即使管道和水泵完好无损，供水也会发生中断。

paras.en: In Iraq, a drone attack on a gas field in November 2025 reduced electricity production in the Kurdistan region by about 80 per cent, forcing authorities to ration and distribute power between water projects, hospitals and cities.
paras.zh: 在伊拉克，2025 年 11 月，无人机袭击了一个气田，导致库尔德斯坦地区的发电量减少了约 80%，迫使当局在水利项目、医院和城市之间进行配给和分配电力。

paras.en: Beyond access to drinking water, attacks also have indirect and long-term consequences – what the UNICEF report called “reverberating effects”.
paras.zh: 除了获得饮用水之外，袭击还会产生间接和长期的后果——联合国儿童基金会的报告称之为“回响效应”。

paras.en: The agency said lack of clean water means that health systems cannot sterilize equipment, deliver babies safely or prepare therapeutic milk for children suffering from severe malnutrition.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，缺乏清洁水意味着卫生系统无法对设备进行消毒、安全分娩或为患有严重营养不良的儿童准备治疗性牛奶。

paras.en: The report also documented instances of children being killed, injured, or harmed while waiting in line for water, citing numerous examples from the Gaza Strip.
paras.zh: 报告还引用了加沙地带的许多例子，记录了儿童在排队取水时被杀、受伤或伤害的情况。

paras.en: It highlighted the threats faced by women and girls, who are often responsible for fetching water for their families, including risk of sexual violence and loss of educational opportunities.
paras.zh: 它强调了经常负责为家人取水的妇女和女孩所面临的威胁，包括性暴力风险和失去教育机会。

paras.en: Attention was also given to the risks faced by workers in water facilities, with the UN, for example, recording the killing of 14 water facility employees in Lebanon during the 2024 conflict.
paras.zh: 人们还关注供水设施工人面临的风险，例如，联合国记录了 2024 年冲突期间黎巴嫩有 14 名供水设施员工被杀。

paras.en: UNICEF's Louise Wateridge in Ukraine reports on attacks that disrupted water supply in Kyiv this week:
paras.zh: 联合国儿童基金会驻乌克兰办事处的路易丝·沃特里奇 (Louise Wateridge) 报告了本周基辅供水中断的袭击事件：

paras.en: UNICEF called on warring parties, Member States, donors, and humanitarian and development actors to:
paras.zh: 儿童基金会呼吁交战各方、会员国、捐助者以及人道主义和发展行为体：

paras.en: 🔹 Protect water, sanitation and hygiene systems in conflict zones as an indispensable element for the survival of civilians, especially children.
paras.zh: 🔹 保护冲突地区的供水、环境卫生和个人卫生系统，这是平民（尤其是儿童）生存不可或缺的要素。

paras.en: 🔹 Establish a mechanism to systematically collect data on attacks targeting water, sanitation and hygiene facilities in conflict contexts.
paras.zh: 🔹 建立机制，系统收集冲突背景下针对水、环境卫生和个人卫生设施的攻击的数据。

paras.en: 🔹 Protect children and communities seeking access to water, sanitation and hygiene services, as well as protecting workers in these sectors and in the energy sector.
paras.zh: 🔹 保护寻求水、环境卫生和个人卫生服务的儿童和社区，并保护这些部门和能源部门的工人。

paras.en: 🔹 Facilitate safe and unhindered access for humanitarian, water and energy workers to those in need, and to the essential supplies necessary for the continued operation of water and energy systems, and
paras.zh: 🔹 帮助人道主义工作者、水务和能源工作者安全、不受阻碍地接触有需要的人，并获得水和能源系统持续运行所需的基本物资，以及

paras.en: 🔹 Invest in approaches that are resilient to conflict, and supporting locally led service continuity arrangements.
paras.zh: 🔹 投资能够抵御冲突的方法，并支持当地主导的服务连续性安排。

paras.en: The report noted that funding cuts are undermining humanitarian efforts to ensure access to clean water.
paras.zh: 报告指出，资金削减正在破坏确保获得清洁水的人道主义努力。

paras.en: Among countries experiencing a coordinated humanitarian response in the WASH sector, 137.9 million people need assistance in this area, while only 26 per cent of the funding required this year has been received.
paras.zh: 在 WASH 领域经历协调人道主义响应的国家中，有 1.379 亿人需要该领域的援助，而今年所需资金只收到了 26%。

paras.en: “Humanitarian workers do their best to keep water flowing despite increasing attacks,” said Ms. Russell. “However, repairs cannot substitute for the protection of these facilities that is required under international humanitarian law.”
paras.zh: “尽管袭击不断增加，人道主义工作者仍尽最大努力保持水源流动，”拉塞尔女士说。 “但是，修复不能替代国际人道法所要求的对这些设施的保护。”

articles.title: LIV Golf: Timeline from big beginnings to liquidation

paras.en: LIV Golf League timeline: Key moments from breakaway circuit's history, rivalry with the PGA Tour and what happens next
paras.zh: LIV 高尔夫联盟时间表：突破巡回赛历史上的关键时刻、与 PGA 巡回赛的竞争以及接下来会发生什么

paras.en: How has the LIV Golf League grown and fallen since its launch in 2021? Timeline of its breakthrough into the men's professional game and the challenges it faced over world rankings, funding changes and rivalries with other tours before entering liquidation
paras.zh: 自 2021 年推出以来，LIV 高尔夫联盟经历了怎样的发展和衰落？ Timeline of its breakthrough into the men's professional game and the challenges it faced over world rankings, funding changes and rivalries with other tours before entering liquidation

paras.en: LIV Golf League appears to be over after five years after it was announced it will enter liquidation.
paras.zh: LIV 高尔夫联盟在宣布进入清算五年后似乎结束了。

paras.en: Its arrival earlier in the decade sparked division and debate in a fractured men's game, with players leaving the PGA Tour and DP World Tour to join the breakaway circuit.
paras.zh: 它在本世纪初的到来在一场支离破碎的男子比赛中引发了分裂和争论，球员们离开了 PGA 巡回赛和 DP 世界巡回赛，加入了突破性的巡回赛。

paras.en: A shock framework agreement between the PGA Tour, DP World Tour and Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) was unable to unify men's golf, with LIV Golf facing fresh challenges to retain its place in the sport, and on Thursday it was announced it will "wind down" ahead of 2027.
paras.zh: PGA 巡回赛、DP 世界巡回赛和沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金 (PIF) 之间令人震惊的框架协议未能统一男子高尔夫运动，LIV 高尔夫面临着保持其在这项运动中的地位的新挑战，周四宣布将在 2027 年之前“结束”。

paras.en: From its initial inception and increasing growth through to players leaving and cuts in funding, we look at the timeline of LIV Golf's history so far...
paras.zh: 从最初的成立和不断增长到球员离开和资金削减，我们回顾了 LIV Golf 迄今为止的历史时间表……

paras.en: October 2021: LIV Golf Investments was officially announced and two-time Open champion Greg Norman revealed as the league's founding CEO.
paras.zh: 2021 年 10 月：LIV Golf Investments 正式宣布，两届公开赛冠军格雷格·诺曼 (Greg Norman) 出任联盟创始首席执行官。

paras.en: February 2022: In an interview with Golf Digest, Phil Mickelson criticised the PGA Tour's policy on player media rights. He said: "It was the tour's obnoxious greed that has really opened the door for opportunities elsewhere." He later told journalist Alan Shipnuck that the Saudis were "scary m************ to be involved with".
paras.zh: 2022 年 2 月：在接受《高尔夫文摘》采访时，菲尔·米克尔森批评了美巡赛关于球员媒体权利的政策。他说：“正是巡回赛令人讨厌的贪婪，才真正为其他地方的机会打开了大门。”他后来告诉记者艾伦·希普纳克（Alan Shipnuck），沙特人“参与其中真是太可怕了”。

paras.en: March 2022: LIV Golf announced it would launch an eight-tournament schedule on June 9, titled the LIV Invitational Series. The total prize pot for the eight events was set at £191.32m ($255m).
paras.zh: 2022 年 3 月：LIV Golf 宣布将于 6 月 9 日推出包含八场比赛的赛程，名为 LIV Invitational Series。八项赛事的总奖金定为 1.9132 亿英镑（2.55 亿美元）。

paras.en: May 2022: Norman branded the PGA Tour "anti-competitive", after the US circuit denied players their release requests to play in LIV Golf events. Former Masters champions Dustin Johnson and Sergio Garcia were revealed among the first group of players to tee up at LIV's inaugural event in London.
paras.zh: 2022 年 5 月：美国巡回赛拒绝了球员参加 LIV 高尔夫赛事的释放请求后，诺曼将 PGA 巡回赛称为“反竞争”。前大师赛冠军达斯汀·约翰逊 (Dustin Johnson) 和塞尔吉奥·加西亚 (Sergio Garcia) 是首批参加 LIV 在伦敦举行的首届赛事的球员之一。

paras.en: June 2022: Mickelson confirmed he would play in LIV Golf's first event, won by Charl Schwartzel. The PGA Tour sent a letter to its members announcing those in the field at LIV Golf London were suspended indefinitely. Bryson DeChambeau and Brooks Koepka both joined the breakaway league ahead of its second event.
paras.zh: 2022 年 6 月：米克尔森确认他将参加 LIV Golf 的首场比赛，由查尔·施瓦策尔 (Charl Schwartzel) 获胜。美巡赛致函会员，宣布伦敦 LIV 高尔夫场的参赛人员无限期停赛。布莱森·德尚博 (Bryson DeChambeau) 和布鲁克斯·科普卡 (Brooks Koepka) 在第二场比赛之前都加入了脱离联盟。

paras.en: July 2022: The DP World Tour issued fines of £100,000 ($133,921) to LIV players who featured in LIV Golf London. Meanwhile, LIV Golf submitted an application for its players to be given Official World Golf Ranking (OWGR) points.
paras.zh: 2022 年 7 月：DP 世界巡回赛对参加 LIV Golf London 比赛的 LIV 球员处以 100,000 英镑（133,921 美元）的罚款。与此同时，LIV Golf 提交了一份申请，要求其球员获得官方世界高尔夫排名 (OWGR) 积分。

paras.en: July 2022: Henrik Stenson sent shockwaves through the golfing world by joining LIV Golf and was subsequently stripped of his role as Team Europe's captain for the 2023 Ryder Cup in Italy.
paras.zh: 2022 年 7 月：亨利克·斯滕森 (Henrik Stenson) 加入 LIV Golf，震惊了高尔夫界，随后被剥夺了参加 2023 年意大利莱德杯欧洲队队长的职务。

paras.en: August 2022: A group of 11 LIV Golf players, including Mickelson, Ian Poulter and Johnson, filed an antitrust lawsuit against the PGA Tour. LIV Golf later joined the lawsuit. After winning The Open at St Andrews and at the end of the PGA Tour season, Cameron Smith became the latest player to join LIV Golf.
paras.zh: 2022 年 8 月：包括米克尔森、伊恩·保尔特和约翰逊在内的 11 名 LIV 高尔夫运动员对 PGA 巡回赛提起反垄断诉讼。 LIV Golf 随后也加入了诉讼。在圣安德鲁斯赢得公开赛并在 PGA 巡回赛赛季结束后，卡梅伦·史密斯 (Cameron Smith) 成为最新加入 LIV Golf 的球员。

paras.en: September 2022: Rory McIlroy likened LIV Golf to a "soap opera" and said his relationship with some of his Ryder Cup team-mates who joined LIV had been damaged.
paras.zh: 2022 年 9 月：罗里·麦克罗伊将 LIV Golf 比作“肥皂剧”，并表示他与加入 LIV 的一些莱德杯队友的关系受到了损害。

paras.en: October 2022: The PGA Tour filed a federal lawsuit against Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) and Yasir Al-Rumayyan, the governor of the PIF.
paras.zh: 2022 年 10 月：美巡赛对沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金 (PIF) 和 PIF 总裁 Yasir Al-Rumayyan 提起联邦诉讼。

paras.en: November 2022: McIlroy called for Norman to leave the rebel league and Tiger Woods also encouraged Norman to go in order for a peace settlement to be negotiated.
paras.zh: 2022 年 11 月：麦克罗伊呼吁诺曼离开叛军联盟，泰格·伍兹也鼓励诺曼离开，以便通过谈判达成和平解决方案。

paras.en: December 2022: Augusta National chairman Fred Ridley confirmed eligible LIV Golfers could play at The Masters. Jon Rahm said PGA Tour players should be 'thankful' for LIV.
paras.zh: 2022 年 12 月：奥古斯塔国家主席 Fred Ridley 确认符合条件的 LIV 高尔夫球手可以参加大师赛。 Jon Rahm 表示 PGA 巡回赛球员应该“感谢”LIV。

paras.en: January 2023: Patrick Reed and McIlroy were involved in the 'tee-gate' saga, where Reed flicked a 4Aces GC tee at the Northern Irishman after the American accused McIlroy of ignoring him.
paras.zh: 2023 年 1 月：帕特里克·里德和麦克罗伊卷入了“发球门”传奇，在美国人指责麦克罗伊无视他之后，里德向北爱尔兰人投出了 4Aces GC 发球台。

paras.en: February 2023: The DP World Tour and LIV Golf went to court for an arbitration hearing, held over five days.
paras.zh: 2023 年 2 月：DP 世界巡回赛和 LIV Golf 向法庭提起为期五天的仲裁听证会。

paras.en: April 2023: The DP World Tour won its legal battle against players who elected to join LIV Golf, enabling them to impose £100,000 ($134,706) fines against LIV players for competing in conflicting events.
paras.zh: 2023 年 4 月：DP 世界巡回赛赢得了对选择加入 LIV Golf 的球员的法律诉讼，使他们能够对参加冲突赛事的 LIV 球员处以 100,000 英镑（134,706 美元）的罚款。

paras.en: May 2023: Koepka became the first LIV Golfer to win a major at the PGA Championship, lifting the Wanamaker Trophy for a third time.
paras.zh: 2023 年 5 月：科普卡成为第一位在 PGA 锦标赛上赢得大满贯的 LIV 高尔夫球手，第三次举起沃纳梅克奖杯。

paras.en: June 2023: The PGA Tour, DP World Tour and PIF announce a shock 'framework agreement', where the organisations ended all pending lawsuits and said they wanted to cooperate to "unify the game of golf".
paras.zh: 2023 年 6 月：PGA 巡回赛、DP 世界巡回赛和 PIF 宣布了一项令人震惊的“框架协议”，各组织结束了所有未决诉讼，并表示希望合作“统一高尔夫运动”。

paras.en: McIlroy hit back at the announcement, saying he felt like a "sacrificial lamb", while PGA Tour commissioner Jay Monahan faced calls to resign.
paras.zh: 麦克罗伊对这一消息进行了回击，称他感觉自己像一只“牺牲品”，而美巡赛专员杰伊·莫纳汉则面临辞职的呼声。

paras.en: October 2023: LIV Golf lost its initial bid to be awarded OWGR points.
paras.zh: 2023 年 10 月：LIV Golf 失去了获得 OWGR 积分的最初竞标。

paras.en: December 2023: Rahm, who won The Masters in April, joined LIV Golf for a deal reportedly worth up to £450m ($607.7m).
paras.zh: 2023 年 12 月：四月份赢得美国大师赛冠军的拉姆加入 LIV Golf，据报道这笔交易价值高达 4.5 亿英镑（6.077 亿美元）。

paras.en: January 2024: Tyrrell Hatton follows Rahm to LIV Golf for a then-reported fee of £47.3m ($60m).
paras.zh: 2024 年 1 月：泰瑞尔·哈顿 (Tyrrell Hatton) 追随拉姆前往 LIV Golf，当时报道的转会费为 4730 万英镑（6000 万美元）。

paras.en: February 2024: Anthony Kim ended a 12-year absence from professional golf by joining the breakaway league. McIlroy softened his stance on LIV Golf, saying players who joined the rebel league should be allowed to come back to the PGA Tour.
paras.zh: 2024 年 2 月：安东尼·金 (Anthony Kim) 加入脱离联盟，结束了 12 年缺席职业高尔夫的时光。麦克罗伊软化了他对 LIV Golf 的立场，称加入反叛联盟的球员应该被允许重返 PGA 巡回赛。

paras.en: March 2024: Norman confirmed LIV Golf had withdrawn its application for OWGR points. Woods formed part of a delegation of PGA Tour members to meet with LIV Golf powerbrokers, including Al-Rumayyan, in the Bahamas, to discuss the merger. PGA Tour commissioner Monahan said the talks were "constructive".
paras.zh: 2024 年 3 月：诺曼确认 LIV Golf 已撤回 OWGR 积分申请。伍兹率领美巡赛会员代表团前往巴哈马与包括 Al-Rumayyan 在内的 LIV Golf 权力掮客会面，讨论合并事宜。美巡赛专员莫纳汉表示，会谈是“建设性的”。

paras.en: April 2024: McIlroy denied claims he was previously close to joining LIV Golf.
paras.zh: 2024 年 4 月：麦克罗伊否认了他之前曾接近加入 LIV Golf 的说法。

paras.en: June 2024: DeChambeau claimed a one-shot victory at the US Open, following Koepka as the second LIV player to win a major, after McIlroy's dramatic late collapse at Pinehurst No 2.
paras.zh: 2024 年 6 月：德尚博在美国公开赛上以一杆优势获胜，成为继科普卡之后第二位赢得大满贯赛冠军的 LIV 球员，此前麦克罗伊在松林二号球场最后戏剧性崩溃。

paras.en: September 2024: The PGA of America confirmed LIV Golfers would be eligible to play for Team USA at the Ryder Cup the following year.
paras.zh: 2024 年 9 月：美国 PGA 确认 LIV 高尔夫球手将有资格代表美国队参加次年的莱德杯。

paras.en: October 2024: Monahan and Al-Rumayyan played together at the Alfred Dunhill Links Championship, signalling that merger talks were progressing.
paras.zh: 2024 年 10 月：Monahan 和 Al-Rumayyan 一起参加了 Alfred Dunhill Links 锦标赛，这表明合并谈判正在取得进展。

paras.en: January 2025: Norman was replaced as LIV Golf's CEO by Scot O'Neil. McIlroy praised Norman for "getting LIV Golf off the ground".
paras.zh: 2025 年 1 月：斯科特·奥尼尔 (Scot O'Neil) 取代诺曼 (Norman)，担任 LIV Golf 的首席执行官。麦克罗伊称赞诺曼“让 LIV Golf 取得了飞速发展”。

paras.en: February 2025: Woods joined Al-Rumayyan and Adam Scott for talks at the White House with US President Donald Trump regarding the ongoing merger.
paras.zh: 2025 年 2 月：伍兹与 Al-Rumayyan 和 Adam Scott 在白宫与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普就正在进行的合并进行会谈。

paras.en: March 2025: Monahan said Trump's involvement in ongoing talks between golf's key stakeholders made the prospect of a reunification between the tours "very real".
paras.zh: 2025 年 3 月：莫纳汉表示，特朗普参与高尔夫主要利益相关者之间正在进行的谈判，使得巡回赛之间重新统一的前景“非常现实”。

paras.en: November 2025: Having launched a fresh bid for OWGR points in July, LIV looked to enhance its push by expanding from 54-hole events to a 72-hole format, a move which McIlroy called "peculiar".
paras.zh: 2025 年 11 月：LIV 在 7 月发起了新的 OWGR 积分竞标后，希望通过从 54 洞赛事扩展到 72 洞赛制来增强其推动力，麦克罗伊称此举“奇特”。

paras.en: December 2025: Koepka announced he was leaving LIV Golf due to personal reasons. He then confirmed his return to the PGA Tour via the Returning Member Program, where he was subjected to certain conditions and required to make a £3.7m ($5m) donation to charity.
paras.zh: 2025 年 12 月：科普卡宣布因个人原因离开 LIV Golf。随后，他确认通过回归会员计划重返美巡赛，但他必须遵守某些条件，并被要求向慈善机构捐款 370 万英镑（500 万美元）。

paras.en: January 2026: Reed also confirmed his departure from LIV Golf and returned to play on the DP World Tour.
paras.zh: 2026 年 1 月：里德也确认离开 LIV Golf 并重返 DP 世界巡回赛。

paras.en: February 2026: LIV Golf was granted world ranking points by the OWGR, but the breakaway league's bosses criticised the allocation of ranking points LIV players could receive - only the top 10 and ties - as "unfair".
paras.zh: 2026 年 2 月：LIV Golf 获得 OWGR 授予的世界排名积分，但脱离联盟的老板批评 LIV 球员可以获得的排名积分分配（仅限前 10 名和平局）“不公平”。

paras.en: The DP World Tour offered conditional releases to eight members, including Hatton, provided they paid off their outstanding fines. Rahm insisted he had "no intention" of paying his fines.
paras.zh: DP世界巡演向包括哈顿在内的八名成员提供了有条件释放，只要他们付清未缴罚款。拉姆坚称他“无意”支付罚款。

paras.en: March 2026: Rahm withdrew his appeal against sanctions imposed by the DP World Tour for playing in conflicting LIV Golf events. His fines were believed to be around £2.2m ($3m). He said the tour's conditional release programme was "extorting players".
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月：拉姆撤回了对 DP 世界巡回赛因参加冲突的 LIV 高尔夫赛事而实施的制裁的上诉。据信他的罚款约为 220 万英镑（300 万美元）。他说巡回赛的有条件释放计划是“敲诈球员”。

paras.en: April 2026: The PIF confirmed it was pulling its funding of LIV at the end of 2026 but it was funded through the rest of the season. LIV released a statement saying it was looking for external investors to finance the series going forward. PGA Tour commissioner Brian Rolapp said the tour was thinking about pathways to reinstate LIV players.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月：PIF 确认将在 2026 年底停止对 LIV 的资助，但该资助贯穿了整个赛季的剩余时间。 LIV 发表声明称，正在寻找外部投资者为该系列电影的未来提供资金。美巡赛专员布莱恩·罗拉普 (Brian Rolapp) 表示，美巡赛正在考虑恢复 LIV 球员的途径。

paras.en: May 2026: Rahm agreed to pay his outstanding DP World Tour penalties and ensure he remained eligible to play at the 2027 Ryder Cup. Elsewhere, US President Trump backed LIV Players to return to the PGA Tour.
paras.zh: 2026 年 5 月：拉姆同意支付其未缴的 DP 世界巡回赛罚款，并确保他仍然有资格参加 2027 年莱德杯。在其他地方，美国总统特朗普支持 LIV 球员重返 PGA 巡回赛。

paras.en: DeChambeau said his future on the PGA Tour depended on whether players wanted him back, as speculation mounted over whether he would agree a new LIV Golf contract.
paras.zh: 德尚博表示，他在美巡赛的未来取决于球员们是否希望他回来，因为关于他是否会同意新的 LIV Golf 合同的猜测越来越多。

paras.en: July 2026: Rahm said he was hopeful LIV Golf could continue but was tight-lipped on what the future would hold for the league.
paras.zh: 2026 年 7 月：拉姆表示，他希望 LIV Golf 能够继续下去，但对联盟的未来守口如瓶。

paras.en: August 2026: After much speculation, LIV Golf CEO O'Neil said the league had found a new lead investor, although was unable to provide details. The league also said players would become majority equity holders.
paras.zh: 2026 年 8 月：经过多次猜测，LIV Golf 首席执行官奥尼尔表示，联盟已经找到了新的主要投资者，但无法提供细节。联盟还表示球员将成为多数股权持有者。

paras.en: August 2026: LIV Golf finally confirmed its season-ending Team Championship in Michigan would no longer go ahead, following weeks of speculation, seeing the 2026 campaign finish a week early in Indianapolis.
paras.zh: 2026 年 8 月：经过数周的猜测，LIV Golf 最终确认其在密歇根州赛季结束的团体锦标赛将不再继续进行，2026 年赛季将提前一周在印第安纳波利斯结束。

paras.en: September 2026: The league informed 'the majority of its workforce' that their employment under LIV 1.0 would end, having previously warned of redundancies earlier in the year.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月：联盟通知“大多数员工”，LIV 1.0 下的雇佣关系将结束，此前曾在今年早些时候警告过裁员。

paras.en: September 2026: LIV Golf filed for bankruptcy protection in the United States but reiterated its intention to start a new version of the league, dubbed LIV 2.0, from 2027. Rahm and DeChambeau are listed as the players still owed the most.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月：LIV Golf 在美国申请破产保护，但重申有意从 2027 年开始启动新版本的联赛，称为 LIV 2.0。拉姆和德尚博被列为仍欠债最多的球员。

paras.en: October 2026: A representative for Rahm told a bankruptcy hearing that the Spaniard did not intend to participate in LIV 2.0, with the 2023 Masters champion deeming the terms for the league's proposed relaunch to be "unacceptable".
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月：拉姆的代表在破产听证会上表示，这位西班牙人不打算参加 LIV 2.0，这位 2023 年大师赛冠军认为联赛重新启动的条款“不可接受”。

paras.en: November 2026: LIV Golf confirmed it plans to wind down operations and enter the liquidation phase, instead of launching a new version, because of a lack of financial support.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月：LIV Golf 确认，由于缺乏财务支持，计划结束运营并进入清算阶段，而不是推出新版本。

articles.title: Bournemouth's super subs extend winning run with Sparta Prague victory

paras.en: Sparta Prague vs Bournemouth; UEFA Europa League
paras.zh: 布拉格斯巴达 vs 伯恩茅斯；欧洲联赛

paras.en: Sparta Prague vs Bournemouth. UEFA Europa League.
paras.zh: 布拉格斯巴达对阵伯恩茅斯。欧洲足联欧洲联赛。

paras.en: Sparta Prague 1-3 Bournemouth: Tyler Adams, Evanilson and Rayan rescue Cherries in Europa League to extend winning run
paras.zh: 布拉格斯巴达 1-3 伯恩茅斯：泰勒·亚当斯、埃文尼尔森和拉扬在欧罗巴联赛中拯救樱桃队延续连胜

paras.en: Match report as Bournemouth go top of Europa League table; Lewis Cook missed Bournemouth penalty in first-half; Ebrima Singhateh netted opener for Sparta Prague, who then had Tobias Guddal sent off; Tyler Adams, Evanilson and Rayan came off bench to earn seventh consecutive win
paras.zh: 伯恩茅斯在欧罗巴联赛积分榜上名列前茅的比赛报道；刘易斯·库克在上半场错过了伯恩茅斯的点球；埃布里玛·辛哈特 (Ebrima Singhateh) 为布拉格斯巴达队攻入首球，随后托比亚斯·古达尔 (Tobias Guddal) 被罚下场。泰勒·亚当斯、埃文尼尔森和雷恩替补登场，取得七连胜

paras.en: Tyler Adams, Evanilson, and Rayan came off the bench to rescue Bournemouth in the Europa League with a 3-1 turnaround victory over 10-man Sparta Prague, extending their winning run to seven matches.
paras.zh: 泰勒·亚当斯、埃文尼尔森和拉扬替补登场，在欧罗巴联赛中拯救了伯恩茅斯，以 3-1 逆转战胜 10 人的布拉格斯巴达，将连胜场数扩大到七场。

paras.en: Bournemouth continued their red-hot form and now sit top of the league phase table, having made a dream start to their first-ever European campaign with four wins.
paras.zh: 伯恩茅斯继续保持着火热的状态，目前在联赛积分榜上名列前茅，以四场胜利为他们的首个欧洲赛季取得了梦幻般的开局。

paras.en: Marco Rose made eight changes from their victory over Leeds last Saturday, but had to call upon his main men after Bournemouth fell behind to Ebrima Singhateh's wonderful solo effort in the first half.
paras.zh: 马可·罗斯在上周六战胜利兹联的比赛中做出了八项调整，但在伯恩茅斯上半场埃布里玛·辛哈特的精彩个人射门落后后，他不得不召集他的主力球员。

paras.zh: - 团队|统计 |欧洲联赛赛程和结果 |最新：伯恩茅斯

paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播英超联赛📺

paras.en: The winger ran from his own half to end Bournemouth's six-game streak without conceding, just five minutes after the visitors' Lewis Cook had missed a penalty, sending his low shot against the inside of the left post after a handball decision.
paras.zh: 这位边锋从本方半场跑出，结束了伯恩茅斯连续六场不失球的记录，就在五分钟前，客队的刘易斯·库克因手球判罚错失点球，低射击中左门柱内侧。

paras.en: But within 120 seconds of the restart, the hosts were down to 10 men when centre-back Tobias Guddal picked up a second yellow for needlessly hauling down striker Alvaro Rodriguez.
paras.zh: 但在比赛重新开始后的 120 秒内，主队的人数只剩下 10 人，中后卫托拜厄斯·古达尔因不必要地拖倒前锋阿尔瓦罗·罗德里格斯而吃到第二张黄牌。

paras.en: Rose introduced Adams at the break and he led the turnaround. The midfielder strode onto a loose ball just outside the area and placed a brilliant, first-time shot into the bottom left corner.
paras.zh: 罗斯在中场休息时引进了亚当斯，他带领球队实现了逆转。这名中场球员大步走到禁区外的一个松散的球上，并在左下角第一次射出精彩的射门。

paras.en: Bournemouth went for the win, bringing on Adrian Truffert, Marcus Tavernier, Evanilson and Rayan. They had to be patient to break down the resilient Czech side before a moment of quality from Evanilson put them ahead.
paras.zh: 伯恩茅斯派上了阿德里安·特鲁弗特、马库斯·塔维尼尔、埃文尼尔森和拉扬，力争胜利。他们必须要有耐心才能击败顽强的捷克队，然后埃文尼尔森的精彩表现让他们取得了领先。

paras.en: Ryan Christie found the striker in a crowded penalty box and, with little room to manoeuvre, he shifted the ball onto his right foot before rolling an inch-perfect shot inside the right post for his sixth goal in his last seven matches.
paras.zh: 瑞安·克里斯蒂在拥挤的禁区内找到了这位前锋，在几乎没有回旋余地的情况下，他将球转移到右脚，然后将一英寸完美射门打入右门柱，这是他在过去七场比赛中的第六个进球。

paras.en: Rayan sealed it in the final minute, sending a low shot from 25 yards into the bottom right corner to keep Bournemouth's winning streak going.
paras.zh: 拉扬在最后时刻锁定胜局，25码处一脚低射入球右下角，帮助伯恩茅斯继续保持连胜。

articles.title: Kamada earns Palace injury-time Hoffenheim draw and offers Sage respite

paras.en: Crystal Palace vs TSG Hoffenheim; UEFA Europa League
paras.zh: 水晶宫 vs TSG 霍芬海姆；欧洲联赛

paras.en: Crystal Palace vs TSG Hoffenheim. UEFA Europa League.
paras.zh: 水晶宫对阵 TSG 霍芬海姆。欧洲足联欧洲联赛。

paras.en: Crystal Palace 1-1 Hoffenheim: Daichi Kamada snatches late equaliser as 10-man Eagles ease pressure on Pierre Sage
paras.zh: 水晶宫 1-1 霍芬海姆：镰田大地在最后时刻扳平比分，十人老鹰队减轻了皮埃尔·萨奇的压力

paras.en: Report as Daichi Kamada scores a stoppage-time equaliser to earn 10-man Crystal Palace a 1-1 draw with Hoffenheim in the Europa League; Adam Wharton's red card had threatened another defeat for under-pressure Pierre Sage after three successive Premier League losses
paras.zh: 镰田大地在伤停补时阶段扳平比分，帮助 10 人应战的水晶宫队在欧罗巴联赛中 1-1 战平霍芬海姆队；亚当·沃顿的红牌威胁着压力之下的皮埃尔·萨奇在英超联赛三连败后再次失利

paras.en: Pierre Sage was handed a much-needed lifeline as Crystal Palace snatched a dramatic late 1-1 draw against Hoffenheim in the Europa League, despite playing the final stages with 10 men following Adam Wharton's dismissal.
paras.zh: 尽管在亚当·沃顿被罚下场后，水晶宫在最后阶段以 10 人的身份参加了欧罗巴联赛，但水晶宫在最后阶段戏剧性地以 1-1 战平霍芬海姆，皮埃尔·萨奇得到了急需的救生索。

paras.en: Palace arrived at Selhurst Park desperate for a response after three consecutive Premier League defeats had left them in the relegation zone, with growing questions over Sage's future as manager.
paras.zh: 水晶宫抵达塞尔赫斯特公园球场，在英超联赛连续三场失利后，他们陷入了降级区，迫切需要得到回应，而人们对塞奇作为主教练的未来的疑问也越来越多。

paras.en: But their defensive vulnerabilities were exposed once again as Alexander Prass opened the scoring for Hoffenheim in the seventh minute, his effort squirming underneath Dean Henderson after the hosts were caught on the counter.
paras.zh: 但他们的防守弱点再次暴露​​出来，亚历山大·普拉斯在第7分钟为霍芬海姆首开纪录，在主队被反击后，他的射门在迪恩·亨德森身下蠕动。

paras.en: - Teams | Stats | Europa League fixtures and results | Latest: Crystal Palace
paras.zh: - 团队|统计 |欧洲联赛赛程和结果 |最新：水晶宫

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream Premier League games with no contract📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播英超联赛📺

paras.en: Sage's side showed some attacking promise but struggled to turn possession into clear-cut opportunities, while Hoffenheim looked dangerous whenever they broke forward.
paras.zh: 塞奇的球队展现出了一些进攻潜力，但很难将控球转化为明确的机会，而霍芬海姆每当突破时都显得很危险。

paras.en: Henderson was forced into an excellent save to deny Andrej Kramaric from close range, while Palace's evening took another turn for the worse when Wharton was shown a second yellow card in the 77th minute for catching Wouter Burger with his arm in an aerial challenge.
paras.zh: 亨德森被迫做出精彩扑救，挡住了安德烈·克拉马里奇的近距离射门，而水晶宫的夜晚又变得更糟，沃顿在第77分钟因在空中挑战中用手臂接住沃特·伯格而被出示第二张黄牌。

paras.en: But just when it looked as though another damaging defeat was inevitable, Daichi Kamada rescued a point in stoppage time. Yeremy Pino delivered a cross into the area, Tyrick Mitchell nodded the ball down and Kamada finished through the goalkeeper's legs to spark relief around Selhurst Park and give Sage a precious moment of respite.
paras.zh: 但就在这场灾难性的失败似乎不可避免时，镰田大地在补时阶段挽救了一分。耶里米·皮诺（Yeremy Pino）传中到禁区，泰里克·米切尔（Tyrick Mitchell）点头将球压低，卡马达（Kamada）穿过门将的腿部射门，为塞尔赫斯特公园周围的人带来了救援，并给了塞奇（Sage）宝贵的喘息时间。

paras.en: The draw leaves Palace with plenty to address, particularly defensively, but the manner of their late equaliser could prove significant for a manager whose position has come under increasing scrutiny. Sage will breathe easier, although this was hardly a performance to silence his critics ahead of Sunday's Premier League meeting with Liverpool, live on Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 这场平局给水晶宫留下了很多需要解决的问题，尤其是在防守方面，但他们最后扳平比分的方式对于一位位置受到越来越多关注的主教练来说可能意义重大。塞奇会松口气，尽管在周日天空体育直播的英超联赛对阵利物浦之前，这并不是一个让批评他的人安静下来的表现。

paras.en: 7: GOAL! Prass puts Hoffenheim ahead as Henderson lets his effort slip underneath him.
paras.zh: 7：目标！普拉斯帮助霍芬海姆取得领先，而亨德森的努力却被他忽视了。

paras.en: 24: SAVE! Henderson produces a brilliant stop to deny Kramaric from close range.
paras.zh: 24：保存！亨德森精彩的拦截将克拉马里奇近距离挡出。

paras.en: 67: CHANCE! Pino goes one on one but Oliver Baumann comes out on top.
paras.zh: 67：机会！皮诺（Pino）一对一，但奥利弗·鲍曼（Oliver Baumann）获胜。

paras.en: 77: RED CARD! Wharton is sent off after picking up a second yellow card.
paras.zh: 77：红牌！沃顿在吃到第二张黄牌后被罚下场。

paras.en: 90+1: GOAL! Kamada strikes late to rescue a point for 10-man Palace!
paras.zh: 90+1：进球！镰田迟到为十人皇宫挽救一分！

articles.title: Melania Trump calls for ‘enduring’ Russia-Ukraine peace as she hosts top officials at the White House
articles.author: Monica Alba

paras.en: First lady Melania Trump expressed hope that a humanitarian ceasefire around a city in Ukraine would inspire progress toward a “more enduring” peace, as she hosted representatives from Russia and Ukraine at the White House on Thursday.
paras.zh: 第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普周四在白宫接待了俄罗斯和乌克兰的代表，她表示希望乌克兰一座城市周围的人道主义停火能够激励实现“更持久”的和平。

paras.en: The unprecedented meeting came as the Trump administration pushes for progress in broader peace negotiations, with the United States set to lead renewed trilateral talks with Russia and Ukraine in the United Arab Emirates, next week.
paras.zh: 这次史无前例的会议召开之际，特朗普政府正在推动更广泛的和平谈判取得进展，美国将于下周在阿拉伯联合酋长国与俄罗斯和乌克兰重新举行三边会谈。

paras.en: Speaking at the White House, the first lady expressed hope that the six-day ceasefire around Oleshky would inspire a peace “more enduring than a temporary ceasefire,” before praising the “highly cooperative” Russian and Ukrainian leaders for helping bring about the pause.
paras.zh: 第一夫人在白宫发表讲话时表示，希望奥列什基周围为期六天的停火能够激发“比临时停火更持久”的和平，然后赞扬俄罗斯和乌克兰领导人“高度合作”帮助实现停火。

paras.en: Melania Trump was joined by Kirill Dmitriev, Vladimir Putin’s special envoy, who thanked her on behalf of the Russian leader. “This humanitarian mission shows what can be achieved when compassion, determination and cooperation come together,” he said.
paras.zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京的特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫也与梅拉尼娅·特朗普一起，代表俄罗斯领导人向她表示感谢。他说：“这项人道主义使命表明，当同情心、决心和合作齐心协力时，可以取得什么样的成就。”

paras.en: Russia has repeatedly rejected calls for a wider ceasefire since launching its full-scale invasion of Ukraine nearly five years ago.
paras.zh: 自近五年前全面入侵乌克兰以来，俄罗斯一再拒绝更广泛停火的呼吁。

paras.en: The limited ceasefire around Oleshky, which started Oct. 27 and lasted six days, allowed for the evacuation of hundreds of people trapped by fighting, blockades and extensive minefields, via neighboring Belarus. The city in Ukraine’s southern Kherson region was home to some 2,000 remaining residents on the brink of starvation.
paras.zh: 奥列什基周围的有限停火于 10 月 27 日开始，持续了六天，使数百名因战斗、封锁和大片雷区而被困的人能够经由邻国白俄罗斯撤离。这座位于乌克兰南部赫尔松地区的城市约有 2000 名居民，仍处于饥饿边缘。

paras.en: Both sides held fire throughout the truce, making it the largest de-escalation effort since the war began.
paras.zh: 双方在整个休战期间一直交火，这是自战争开始以来最大规模的降级努力。

paras.en: Urging the first lady to keep going with her mission, David Arakhamia, the head of President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s ruling faction in Ukraine’s parliament, said he hoped the deal would create a momentum “to actually keep the peace when the peace comes.”
paras.zh: 总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在乌克兰议会的执政派系负责人大卫·阿拉卡米亚敦促第一夫人继续履行她的使命，他表示希望这项协议能够创造一种势头，“在和平到来时真正维护和平”。

paras.en: Dmytro Lubinets, the Ukrainian parliamentary commissioner for human rights, then handed Melania Trump with Ukraine’s highest state honor, the Order of Princess Olga, 1st Class.
paras.zh: 乌克兰议会人权专员德米特罗·鲁宾涅茨随后向梅拉尼娅·特朗普授予乌克兰最高国家荣誉——一级奥尔加公主勋章。

paras.en: Melania Trump then gave Dmitriev and Arakhamia personal letters to deliver to Putin and Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普（ Melania Trump ）随后将德米特里耶夫（ Dmitriev ）和阿拉哈米亚（ Arakhamia ）的私人信件

paras.en: She did not respond to shouted questions from NBC News.
paras.zh: 她没有回答NBC新闻大喊大叫的问题。

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV and some officials in Europe also lobbied heavily for the ceasefire in Oleshky.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世和一些欧洲官员也大力游说奥列什基停火。

paras.en: Thursday’s gathering appears to be the first time both sides met face-to-face at the White House.
paras.zh: 周四的聚会似乎是双方首次在白宫面对面会面。

paras.en: It comes as President Donald Trump ramped up pressure on Kyiv, after he agreed on deals with the Kremlin in a bid to break a monthslong deadlock in negotiations to settle the war.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统与克里姆林宫达成协议，以打破解决战争的谈判长达数月的僵局，随后加大了对基辅的压力。

paras.en: Next week’s Abu Dhabi peace talks will be the first since Republicans suffered major losses in the midterm elections, a blow to the president’s authority.
paras.zh: 下周的阿布扎比​​和平谈判将是共和党在中期选举中遭受重大损失以来的首次和平谈判，这对总统的权威造成了打击。

paras.en: Ukraine has been reeling from the worst collapse in relations with Washington since the start of the war. Trump signed a deal to buy Russian diesel and waived new sanctions on Moscow last month, while Kyiv complained of gaps in U.S. intelligence sharing and the slowdown of tech billionaire Elon Musk’s Starlink service, crucial for Ukraine’s military and air defense.
paras.zh: 自战争开始以来，乌克兰与华盛顿的关系一直处于最严重的崩溃之中。特朗普上个月签署了购买俄罗斯柴油的协议，并放弃了对莫斯科的新制裁，而基辅则抱怨美国情报共享存在缺陷，以及科技亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克的星链服务速度放缓，该服务对乌克兰的军事和防空至关重要。

paras.en: Ukraine has since said that both intelligence sharing and Starlink service have been restored, and that it was looking forward to resuming trilateral talks with the U.S. and Russia next week.
paras.zh: 乌克兰此后表示情报共享和星链服务均已恢复，并期待下周恢复与美国和俄罗斯的三边会谈。

paras.en: “This will be a team-level format, and we count on the work in this format and our other diplomatic steps opening the way to a trilateral format at the leaders’ level,” Zelenskyy said Tuesday. “It is precisely such a format — at the leaders’ level — that can resolve the key issues in order to achieve a lasting peace and guaranteed security.”
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周二表示：“这将是团队级别的形式，我们指望这种形式的工作以及我们的其他外交步骤为领导人级别的三边形式开辟道路。” “正是这样一种形式——在领导人层面——能够解决关键问题，以实现持久和平和有保障的安全。”

paras.en: The meeting comes after Democrats captured full control of Congress in a striking repudiation of Trump’s agenda.
paras.zh: 这次会议是在民主党完全控制国会并彻底否定特朗普的议程之后举行的。

paras.en: Kremlin said it “sincerely hoped” that Trump would continue his “peace-building efforts” after the midterm elections. Ukraine offered no official response to the dramatic results, but some in the country expressed cautious optimism the Democratic surge would ease pressure from Washington.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫表示，“真诚地希望”特朗普在中期选举后继续其“建设和平的努力”。乌克兰没有对这一戏剧性的结果做出官方回应，但该国一些人对民主党的崛起将缓解华盛顿的压力表示谨慎乐观。

paras.en: The negotiations to settle the war, led by Trump’s special envoy Steve Witkoff and son-in-law Jared Kushner, have stalled over the key question of Ukraine’s eastern Donbas industrial region, which Putin wants to seize in its entirety.
paras.zh: 由特朗普特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和女婿贾里德·库什纳领导的解决战争的谈判因乌克兰东部顿巴斯工业区的关键问题陷入僵局，普京希望完全占领该地区。

paras.en: Ukraine still controls key stronghold cities in the Donbas and has refused to give up this land, arguing Putin may be eyeing not just a public relations success but a powerful launchpad for future invasion attempts.
paras.zh: 乌克兰仍然控制着顿巴斯的主要据点城市，并拒绝放弃这片土地，认为普京可能不仅着眼于公共关系的成功，而且着眼于未来入侵企图的强大发射台。

articles.title: Russell Brand found guilty of rape and sexual assault
articles.author: Adela Suliman

paras.en: LONDON — British comedian and actor Russell Brand has been found guilty of rape and sexual assault in a London court on Thursday.
paras.zh: 伦敦——周四，英国喜剧演员兼演员拉塞尔·布兰德在伦敦一家法院被判犯有强奸和性侵犯罪。

paras.en: Brand, once one of Britain’s most high-profile broadcasters and the former husband of singer Katy Perry, had denied the accusations, saying the incidents had either been consensual, reinvented or re-imagined.
paras.zh: 布兰德曾经是英国最知名的广播公司之一，也是歌手凯蒂·佩里的前夫，他否认了这些指控，称这些事件要么是双方同意的，要么是经过重新发明或重新想象的。

paras.en: Brand, 51, was accused of three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault and one count of attempted indecent assault. Ultimately he was found guilty of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault. He was acquitted of the other charges.
paras.zh: 51 岁的布兰德被指控犯有三项强奸罪、三项性侵犯罪和一项企图猥亵罪。最终他被判犯有一项强奸罪和三项性侵犯罪。他被判无罪释放其他罪名。

paras.en: He had pleaded not guilty to all counts and consistently denied all of the allegations.
paras.zh: 他对所有罪名均表示不认罪，并始终否认所有指控。

paras.en: The judge, Justice Joel Bennathan, told Brand in court that the consequence of the verdicts is a “significant custodial term” and said he would have to remain in prison until he is formally sentenced on Monday.
paras.zh: 法官乔尔·本纳森(Joel Bennathan)法官在法庭上告诉布兰德，判决的后果是“重大监禁期限”，并表示他将必须留在监狱里，直到周一正式宣判。

paras.en: “You’ve been convicted of a number of offenses including rape,” Bennathan said, adding that Brand inevitably faced a “significant” prison sentence.
paras.zh: 本纳森说：“你已被判犯有包括强奸在内的多项罪行。”他补充说，布兰德不可避免地面临“重大”监禁。

paras.en: The maximum sentence for rape is life imprisonment and 10 years for one count of sexual assault, according to Britain’s Sentencing Council.
paras.zh: 根据英国量刑委员会的说法，强奸罪的最高刑罚是无期徒刑，一项性侵犯罪的最高刑罚是十年监禁。

paras.en: An investigation into allegations of rape made by two women remains ongoing, a spokesperson for London’s Metropolitan Police said.
paras.zh: 伦敦大都会警察局发言人表示，对两名妇女强奸指控的调查仍在进行中。

paras.en: The accusations date back to Brand’s rise as a stand-up comedian and risqué presenter on British television. He also had a prominent radio show on the BBC and authored several best-selling biographies where he detailed his addictions to drugs and alcohol.
paras.zh: 这些指控可以追溯到布兰德作为一名单口喜剧演员和英国电视上的下流主持人的崛起时期。他还在 BBC 上主持了一档著名的广播节目，并撰写了几本畅销传记，详细描述了他对毒品和酒精的成瘾。

paras.en: At the height of his fame, Brand featured in several Hollywood movies including: “Forgetting Sarah Marshall” and “Get Him to the Greek.”
paras.zh: 在他名气的鼎盛时期，布兰德出演了多部好莱坞电影，包括：《忘记莎拉·马歇尔》和《带他去希腊》。

paras.en: His fame stateside was cemented when he briefly wed pop star Katy Perry in a lavish ceremony in India in 2010. The couple divorced in 2012.
paras.zh: 2010 年，他在印度与流行歌星凯蒂·佩里 (Katy Perry) 举行了一场奢华的婚礼，短暂结婚后，他在美国的名声进一步巩固。两人于 2012 年离婚。

paras.en: In recent years, Brand has moved away from mainstream media, relocated to Florida and built a large online following with videos that discuss U.S. politics, wellness, conspiracy theories and his newfound Christian faith.
paras.zh: 近年来，布兰德已经远离主流媒体，搬到了佛罗里达州，并通过讨论美国政治、健康、阴谋论和他新发现的基督教信仰的视频在网上建立了大批追随者。

paras.en: The four-week trial at Southwark Crown Court in London saw prosecutors label Brand “ruthless.”
paras.zh: 在伦敦南华克刑事法院进行的为期四个星期的审判中，检察官给布兰德贴上了“无情”的标签。

paras.en: Prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones told jurors that Brand at the time had an “indiscriminate and voracious” desire for sexual contact, and that “women were simply a means to an end.” The prosecutor described Brand as “calculating, he was manipulative. And, the prosecution say, he was a sexual predator.”
paras.zh: 检察官里尔·卡米·琼斯告诉陪审员，布兰德当时对性接触有着“不分青红皂白和贪婪”的渴望，而“女性只是达到目的的一种手段”。检察官形容布兰德“精于算计，善于操纵。而且，检方称，他是一个性掠夺者。”

paras.en: Brand was found guilty of raping one woman in 2009. She said he anally raped her at his home after she met him at one of his shows.
paras.zh: 2009 年，布兰德被判强奸一名女子。她说，当她在他的一场演出中遇见他后，布兰德在他家中对她进行了肛交。

paras.en: He was also found guilty of sexually assaulting a woman whose breasts he grabbed at a party in 2004 and another woman who said he had kissed and groped her at a London radio station in 2004 or 2005.
paras.zh: 他还被判犯有 2004 年在一次聚会上性侵犯一名妇女的罪名，该妇女曾被他抓住，并于 2004 年或 2005 年在伦敦一家广播电台对另一名妇女进行了亲吻和抚摸。

paras.en: Prosecutors said the women do not know one another and separately went to police after a TV documentary was broadcast in Britain in 2023.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，这些妇女彼此不认识，并在 2023 年一部电视纪录片在英国播出后分别向警方报案。

paras.en: His appearances outside the court, holding hands with his wife and flanked by security guards, made daily headlines in the British press.
paras.zh: 他与妻子手牵着手，在保安陪同下出现在法庭外，成为英国媒体的每日头条新闻。

paras.en: Last week, Brand took the stand and said the claims had made a “devastating” impact on his life, leaving him without a single friend or colleague who could testify on his behalf.
paras.zh: 上周，布兰德出庭表示，这些指控对他的生活造成了“毁灭性”影响，使他没有一个朋友或同事可以代表他作证。

paras.en: “My entire life has been consumed by these events,” he said inside court, adding later that dealing with the “traumatic” allegations had come “at the expense of my marriage, my children and health.”
paras.zh: “我的一生都被这些事件占据了，”他在法庭上说，后来又补充说，处理这些“创伤性”指控是“以牺牲我的婚姻、孩子和健康为代价的”。

paras.en: He admitted in court to being sex obsessed as a young and famous man.
paras.zh: 他在法庭上承认，作为一名年轻的名人，他对性有痴迷。

paras.en: “I have been persuasive, seductive, begging and flirting, and have dedicated a lot of my life to what seems now beyond reckless philandering and idiocy,” he told the court as he gave evidence last Wednesday.
paras.zh: “我一直在劝说、诱惑、乞讨和调情，并将我的大部分生命奉献给了现在看来超越了鲁莽的调情和白痴的事情，”他在上周三作证时告诉法庭。

paras.en: “I was in a position of fame. As I became more successful and famous I was very comfortable allowing that to facilitate sexual access, which I agree was wrong,” he added.
paras.zh: “我当时处于出名的地位。随着我变得更加成功和出名，我很乐意允许这种情况促进性接触，我同意这是错误的，”他补充道。

paras.en: Brand also told the court: “Consent is fundamental, essential, necessary and indeed more important than sex itself.”
paras.zh: 布兰德还告诉法庭：“同意是根本、必要、必要的，而且确实比性本身更重要。”

paras.en: Brand’s wife, Laura Gallacher, also made headlines when she testified last week, stating that he was a “caring, kind and a wonderful father.” The couple married in 2017 and have three young children.
paras.zh: 布兰德的妻子劳拉·加拉赫(Laura Gallacher)上周作证时也成为头条新闻，她表示布兰德是一位“有爱心、善良、很棒的父亲”。这对夫妇于 2017 年结婚，育有三个年幼的孩子。

paras.en: Brand and his wife have been posting videos online where they analyze bible verses together and discuss their broad experiences of the trial.
paras.zh: 布兰德和他的妻子一直在网上发布视频，他们一起分析圣经经文并讨论他们在审判中的广泛经历。

paras.en: When the trial first got underway last month, Brand told a scrum of photographers and journalists that he felt “blessed.” He said he was “hopeful that this process will lead to good outcomes for everybody involved.”
paras.zh: 上个月审判首次开始时，布兰德告诉一群摄影师和记者，他感到“很幸运”。他说，他“希望这一过程将为所有参与者带来良好的结果。”

paras.en: In a statement after the verdict, Detective Superintendent Andy Furphy from London’s Metropolitan Police said Brand had “used his influence, status and fame to exploit and sexually offend against women.”
paras.zh: 伦敦大都会警察局侦探警司安迪·弗菲在判决后的一份声明中表示，布兰德“利用他的影响力、地位和名气来剥削和性侵犯女性。”

paras.en: “As his profile grew, so too did his sense of entitlement,” he said.
paras.zh: “随着他的知名度不断提高，他的权利感也随之增强，”他说。

paras.en: Praising the victims for their “extraordinary courage,” he added: “Despite intense media and public scrutiny, they relived deeply personal and traumatic experiences and placed their trust in us. Without their bravery, this outcome would not have been possible.”
paras.zh: 他赞扬受害者“非凡的勇气”，并补充道：“尽管受到媒体和公众的强烈监督，他们还是重温了深刻的个人和创伤经历，并对我们表示信任。没有他们的勇敢，就不可能有这样的结果。”

paras.en: If you or someone you know has been sexually assaulted, call the National Sexual Assault Hotline at 1-800-656-4673. The hotline, run by the Rape, Abuse, & Incest National Network (RAINN), can put you in contact with your local rape crisis center. You can also access RAINN’s online chat service at rainn.org/get-help.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的人遭到性侵犯，请拨打全国性侵犯热线 1-800-656-4673。该热线由全国强奸、虐待和乱伦网络 (RAINN) 运营，可以让您与当地的强奸危机中心取得联系。您还可以访问 RAINN 的在线聊天服务：rainn.org/get-help。

articles.title: Clashes erupt in France as ‘Black Thursday’ protests sweep the nation
articles.author: Henry Austin

paras.en: PARIS — Riot police clashed with protesters in Lyon on Thursday as a nationwide public sector strike tapped into growing anger over deteriorating services and the rising cost of living.
paras.zh: 巴黎——周四，防暴警察在里昂与抗议者发生冲突，全国范围内的公共部门罢工引发了人们对服务恶化和生活成本上升的日益高涨的愤怒。

paras.en: Paris’ iconic Eiffel Tower was closed because of the strike.
paras.zh: 巴黎标志性的埃菲尔铁塔因罢工而关闭。

paras.en: Officers clad in black helmets and protective clothing charged at crowds in Lyon after the demonstrations against rising living costs and in support of the high school protest movement turned violent and fires were set in the streets. Water cannons were also deployed. Some of the protesters wore gas masks and safety glasses as a precaution against tear gas.
paras.zh: 在里昂，反对生活成本上涨和支持高中抗议运动的示威活动演变成暴力活动并在街道上纵火后，戴着黑色头盔和穿着防护服的警察向人群发起冲锋。还出动了水炮。一些抗议者戴着防毒面具和安全眼镜，以预防催泪瓦斯。

paras.en: Images from Paris showed students and other protesters facing off against riot police.
paras.zh: 来自巴黎的图像显示学生和其他抗议者与防暴警察对峙。

paras.en: Police were “keeping the situation under control, but it remains tense,” the French Interior Ministry said in a statement at 1 p.m. local time (7 a.m. ET).
paras.zh: 法国内政部下午 1 点在一份声明中表示，警方“正在控制局势，但局势仍然紧张”。当地时间（东部时间上午 7 点）。

paras.en: “Several violent acts have been committed as part of the high school student movement,” the statement said. After fireworks were fired at a school near the southern city of Toulouse, a fire broke out “that burned the student services office,” it added.
paras.zh: 声明称：“高中学生运动中发生了几起暴力行为。”报道补充说，南部城市图卢兹附近的一所学校燃放烟花后，发生火灾，“烧毁了学生服务办公室”。

paras.en: In the city of Rennes in northwest France, metal pétanque balls were thrown at officers, the statement said, adding that police had been pelted with other projectiles in the cities of Pau and Orleans.
paras.zh: 声明称，在法国西北部的雷恩市，有人向警察投掷金属滚球，并补充说，在波城和奥尔良市，警察也遭到其他投掷物投掷。

paras.en: Around 250 rallies against rising living costs had been planned in cities and towns across the country and hundreds of thousands of people would likely turn out, unions said before the events kicked off.
paras.zh: 工会在活动开始前表示，全国城镇计划举行约 250 场反对生活成本上涨的集会，可能会有数十万人参加。

paras.en: France’s main unions, including the CGT and CNT representing public and private sector workers, and the UNEF, representing students, warned the government of President Emmanuel Macron’s that the country was on the brink or recession.
paras.zh: 法国主要工会，包括代表公共和私营部门工人的 CGT 和 CNT，以及代表学生的 UNEF，警告总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙的政府，该国正处于衰退的边缘。

paras.en: “Everything is going up except wages and pensions,” they said in a joint statement. “Anger is immense.”
paras.zh: 他们在一份联合声明中表示：“除了工资和养老金之外，一切都在上涨。” “愤怒是巨大的。”

paras.en: “The situation in this country is fragile. The pressing social and environmental challenges must be addressed without delay,” the statement added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“这个国家的局势很脆弱。必须立即解决紧迫的社会和环境挑战。”

paras.en: The movement grew from a student protest over staff shortages at the Antoine de Saint-Exupéry High School in Créteil, a southeastern suburb of Paris. Videos of the blockade spread on social media, and soon protests expanded to high schools across the nation.
paras.zh: 该运动起源于巴黎东南郊区克雷泰伊的安东尼·圣埃克苏佩里高中因学生人手短缺而举行的抗议活动。封锁的视频在社交媒体上传播，抗议活动很快扩展到全国各地的高中。

paras.en: As the movement grew, the list of grievances expanded beyond the failings of the public school system to encompass broader economic, political and social dissatisfaction. Soon, university students, teachers, parents and politicians also joined.
paras.zh: 随着运动的发展，不满的范围超出了公立学校系统的失败，涵盖了更广泛的经济、政治和社会不满。很快，大学生、教师、家长和政界人士也加入进来。

paras.en: Hundreds of thousands of protesters have since taken to the streets as the demonstrations expanded, with participants holding signs criticizing the far-right National Rally party and warning of the risks of climate change and artificial intelligence. A multitude of Palestinian flags have also been seen.
paras.zh: 随着示威活动扩大，数十万抗议者走上街头，参与者举着标语批评极右翼国家集会党，并警告气候变化和人工智能的风险。人们还看到了许多巴勒斯坦旗帜。

paras.en: Macron, who will leave office in May, convened a defense and security meeting Wednesday ahead of the protests. Later, Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said that 70,000 police officers would be deployed Thursday, backed by armored vehicles, drones and helicopters.
paras.zh: 将于五月离任的马克龙周三在抗议活动前召开了一次国防和安全会议。随后，内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，周四将部署 7 万名警察，并配备装甲车、无人机和直升机。

paras.en: Police have previously been criticized for injuring protesters with heavy-handed tactics. Last month, a 15-year-old was maimed by a sting ball grenade fired by police and a 14-year-old suffered a jaw fracture in a similar incident.
paras.zh: 警方此前因使用高压手段伤害抗议者而受到批评。上个月，一名 15 岁的青少年被警方发射的刺球手榴弹致残，一名 14 岁的青少年在类似事件中下巴骨折。

paras.en: Several other have also suffered life-changing injuries and a 59-year-old man, identified as Christophe M, died Oct. 17 of “a critical cardio-respiratory failing” after leaving Paris’ Place de la République which had been tear-gassed be police. An investigation into his death is ongoing.
paras.zh: 其他几人也遭受了改变生活的伤害，一名名叫 Christophe M 的 59 岁男子于 10 月 17 日离开被警察发射催泪瓦斯的巴黎共和广场后，因“严重的心肺功能衰竭”死亡。对他死亡的调查正在进行中。

paras.en: Zacharie Petit reported from Paris and Henry Austin from London.
paras.zh: 扎卡里·佩蒂特从巴黎报道，亨利·奥斯汀从伦敦报道。

articles.title: Israel's president set to hand Netanyahu rival first chance to form government
articles.author: Matthew Doran

paras.en: Israel's President Isaac Herzog is poised to give Benjamin Netanyahu's main rival Gadi Eisenkot the first chance to lead coalition talks.
paras.zh: 以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格准备给予本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的主要竞争对手加迪·艾森科特领导联盟谈判的第一次机会。

paras.en: Neither Mr Netanyahu's Likud-led bloc nor the opposition secured enough seats for a parliamentary majority in last week's election.
paras.zh: 在上周的选举中，内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团和反对派都没有获得足够的议会多数席位。

paras.en: Mr Eisenkot faces an uphill struggle amid a divided political landscape, and Israel could be facing weeks of delays.
paras.zh: 艾森科特在分裂的政治格局中面临着一场艰苦的斗争，而以色列可能面临数周的延误。

paras.en: Israel's President Isaac Herzog looks set to tap Benjamin Netanyahu's main rival to begin the process of forming a new coalition government, despite ongoing accusations from the prime minister and other right-wing politicians the election was "stolen".
paras.zh: 以色列总统埃萨克·赫尔佐格（ Isaac Herzog ）似乎将利用本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（ Benjamin Netanyahu ）的主要竞争对手开始组建新联合政府的进程，尽管总理和其他右翼政客不断指责选举“被盗”。

paras.en: Last week's ballot delivered an unsurprisingly inconclusive result, with neither Mr Netanyahu and his ruling right-wing coalition or the band of challengers led by former Israeli military chief Gadi Eisenkot receiving enough support to govern in majority.
paras.zh: 上周的投票结果并不令人意外，内塔尼亚胡及其执政的右翼联盟以及以色列前军事首长加迪·艾森科特领导的挑战者团体都没有获得足够的支持来执政。

paras.en: Coalition governments are the norm in Israel, and after being presented with the official results of the election the president has had the task of meeting representatives from each party to seek advice on who they believe is best placed to begin negotiations.
paras.zh: 联合政府在以色列是常态，在收到正式选举结果后，总统的任务是会见各方代表，就他们认为最适合开始谈判的人寻求建议。

paras.en: While the meetings were underway on Thursday night, two competing groups of protesters gathered outside the president's residence in central Jerusalem — one group calling for a "unity government" comprising Mr Netanyahu and Mr Eisenkot's parties, and a larger group demanding a Jewish-Arab coalition to stabilise the country.
paras.zh: 周四晚上会议进行期间，两派相互竞争的抗议者聚集在耶路撒冷市中心的总统官邸外，其中一组呼吁建立一个由内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特的政党组成的“联合政府”，另一组则要求建立犹太-阿拉伯联盟以稳定国家。

paras.en: Mr Eisenkot's own Yashar party, along with fellow "change" camp parties Together, Yisrael Beiteinu and the Democrats all recommended the former general be given the first shot at forming government.
paras.zh: 艾森科特自己的亚沙尔党以及其他“变革”阵营政党以色列·贝泰努和民主党都建议让这位前将军在组建政府方面拥有优先权。

paras.en: Mr Netanyahu’s Likud, the far-right Otzma Yehudit and Religious Zionism parties led by internationally sanctioned ministers Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich, and the ultra-Orthodox Shas all backed the incumbent to begin the negotiations.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团、由国际认可的部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔和贝扎莱·斯莫特里奇领导的极右翼犹太复国主义政党以及极端正统的沙斯党都支持现任总统开始谈判。

paras.en: The other ultra-Orthodox party, United Torah Judaism, did not recommend either leader.
paras.zh: 另一个极端正统派政党联合托拉犹太教则没有推荐任何一位领导人。

paras.en: It defended the approach by arguing there had been "wild incitement and fierce persecution" of their community during the debate over whether Haredi men should be forced to complete compulsory military service.
paras.zh: 它为这种做法辩护，称在关于是否应该强迫正统派男子完成义务兵役的辩论中，他们的社区受到了“疯狂的煽动和猛烈的迫害”。

paras.en: The two Arab-Israeli or Palestinian-Israeli parties, the Joint List and the United Arab List, also recommended Mr Eisenkot.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯-以色列或巴勒斯坦-以色列两个政党——联合名单和阿拉伯联合名单也推荐了艾森科特先生。

paras.en: "We believe that it is possible to establish a new government that will serve all the citizens of the State of Israel, and it will certainly be infinitely better than the current government, which is defined as the government of failures," leader of the United Arab List Mansour Abbas told President Herzog during a meeting on Thursday.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联盟领导人曼苏尔·阿巴斯在周四的一次会议上对赫尔佐格总统说：“我们相信，有可能建立一个为以色列国所有公民服务的新政府，而且它肯定会比被定义为失败政府的现任政府好得多。”

paras.en: Surge in Arab-Israeli becomes flashpoint
paras.zh: 阿拉伯-以色列激增成为爆发点

paras.en: The Arab-Israeli parties have record representation in the next Knesset, with 19 seats between them. But that surge in support is fuelling ongoing allegations of the election being stolen.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯-以色列政党在下届议会中的代表人数创历史新高，共有 19 个席位。但支持率的激增加剧了有关选举被窃取的持续指控。

paras.en: David Zini, the head of Israel's intelligence agency the Shin Bet, has claimed 100 million shekels, $45.1 million AUD, was poured into Arab-majority communities in a foreign interference operation aimed at encouraging voter turnout.
paras.zh: 以色列情报机构辛贝特 (Shin Bet) 负责人戴维·齐尼 (David Zini) 声称，在一项旨在鼓励选民投票的外国干预行动中，1 亿谢克尔（4510 万澳元）被注入阿拉伯人占多数的社区。

paras.en: Israeli media has reported Mr Zini, who was handpicked by Mr Netanyahu, sought to question three senior Arab-Israeli politicians. The move was blocked by Israel's attorney-general, who said there was insufficient evidence.
paras.zh: 以色列媒体报道称，由内塔尼亚胡先生精心挑选的齐尼先生试图质问三名阿拉伯-以色列高级政客。此举遭到以色列总检察长的阻止，他称证据不足。

paras.en: "This is an earthquake, an unprecedented event that undermines the very foundations of the democratic regime in Israel," Otzma Yehudit member Yitzhak Wasserlauf told President Herzog.
paras.zh: “这是一场地震，是一场史无前例的事件，破坏了以色列民主政权的根基，”Otzma Yehudit 成员伊扎克·瓦瑟劳夫 (Yitzhak Wasserlauf) 告诉赫尔佐格总统。

paras.en: "We want an in-depth investigation so that they don't play with our Israeli democracy, so they won't play with this important country that we have prayed for over two thousand years, not to let terrorist elements to take over our system."
paras.zh: “我们希望进行深入调查，这样他们就不会玩弄我们的以色列民主，这样他们就不会玩弄这个我们祈祷了两千多年的重要国家，不要让恐怖分子接管我们的制度。”

paras.en: Likud member, and Netanyahu government transport minister, Miri Regev told President Herzog there should be no government relying on the support of the Arab-Israeli parties, labelling them as "terror supports" who were a "danger to the State of Israel".
paras.zh: 利库德集团成员、内塔尼亚胡政府交通部长米里·雷格夫告诉赫尔佐格总统，政府不应该依赖阿以政党的支持，并将他们称为“恐怖支持者”，“对以色列国构成威胁”。

paras.en: The anti-Netanyahu parties have accused the prime minister of weaponising the nation’s security agencies to undermine the democratic process.
paras.zh: 反内塔尼亚胡政党指责总理将国家安全机构武器化，以破坏民主进程。

paras.en: Israel’s elections committee, chaired by a Supreme Court justice, ratified the results of the election on Wednesday despite the ongoing allegations.
paras.zh: 尽管指控不断，但由最高法院法官担任主席的以色列选举委员会于周三批准了选举结果。

paras.en: That triggered President Herzog to begin consultations, which wrapped up Thursday night local time.
paras.zh: 这促使赫尔佐格总统开始磋商，磋商于当地时间周四晚结束。

paras.en: The recommendations from political parties to begin negotiations do not guarantee a government can be formed, but kickstart a 28-day window for wrangling to occur.
paras.zh: 各政党提出的开始谈判的建议并不保证能够组建政府，但会启动 28 天的争论窗口。

paras.en: Within the anti-Netanyahu camp, Yisrael Beiteinu’s leader Avigdor Liberman has insisted he will not work with the Arab-Israeli parties in any coalition or partnership.
paras.zh: 在反内塔尼亚胡阵营中，以色列贝泰努领导人阿维格多·利伯曼坚称，他不会与阿拉伯-以色列政党结成任何联盟或伙伴关系。

paras.en: If Mr Eisenkot was to try to form a coalition with the so-far unaligned United Torah Judaism, it may mean walking back from his commitment to force most Haredi men to complete compulsory military service.
paras.zh: 如果艾森科特先生试图与迄今为止尚未结盟的联合托拉犹太教结成联盟，这可能意味着放弃他强迫大多数正统男子完成义务兵役的承诺。

paras.en: If a government cannot be formed within the initial 28 days, the president can extend the negotiating period for another 14 days.
paras.zh: 如果在最初的28天内无法组建政府，总统可以将谈判期限再延长14天。

paras.en: After that is over, another politician can be given a shot.
paras.zh: 结束后，可以给另一位政客一个机会。

paras.en: If a deadlock remains after all of that, fresh elections can be ordered.
paras.zh: 如果在所有这些之后仍然陷入僵局，则可以下令举行新的选举。

paras.en: Even without a government being formed, power plays in the Knesset will begin as early as next week when members are sworn in.
paras.zh: 即使没有组建政府，议会的权力斗争也将最早在下周议员宣誓就职时开始。

paras.en: There is enough support for the anti-Netanyahu camp to start making changes, with the support of the Arab-Israeli parties, including installing a new speaker.
paras.zh: 在阿以政党的支持下，反内塔尼亚胡阵营有足够的支持开始做出改变，包括任命新的议长。

paras.en: That is widely tipped to be former prime minister Yair Lapid, who ran on the Together joint ticket with fellow former prime minister Naftali Bennett.
paras.zh: 人们普遍认为该人是前总理亚伊尔·拉皮德(Yair Lapid)，他与前总理纳夫塔利·贝内特(Naftali Bennett) 联合竞选。

paras.en: While Likud is going to be the largest party in the Knesset, with 27 seats compared to Yashar's 21, the "change" camp parties, along with the Arab-Israeli lists, make up a combined 67 seats in the 120-vote parliament.
paras.zh: 虽然利库德集团将成为以色列议会中最大的政党，拥有 27 个席位，而亚沙尔拥有 21 个席位，但“变革”阵营政党加上阿拉伯-以色列名单，在拥有 120 票的议会中总共占据 67 个席位。

articles.title: LIV Golf to wind down after five years of rebel league

paras.en: LIV Golf is closing down after losing the financial support it had hoped to secure from BC Partners to keep the league afloat.
paras.zh: LIV Golf 在失去了原本希望从 BC Partners 获得的维持联盟生存的财务支持后即将关闭。

paras.en: The breakaway men's golf league lasted five years but fell into financial trouble earlier this year when Saudi Arabia withdrew its financial backing.
paras.zh: 这个独立的男子高尔夫联盟持续了五年，但今年早些时候由于沙特阿拉伯撤回财政支持而陷入财务困境。

paras.en: Instead of launching a new version in 2027, LIV is entering a liquidation phase.
paras.zh: LIV 没有在 2027 年推出新版本，而是进入清算阶段。

paras.en: LIV Golf, the breakaway rebel golf league spearheaded by Australian Greg Norman, will collapse after five years, with a bankruptcy court hearing it plans to wind down operations rather than launch a new version due to a lack of support.
paras.zh: LIV Golf 是澳大利亚格雷格·诺曼 (Greg Norman) 领导的叛逆高尔夫联盟，五年后将崩溃，破产法庭听证会称，由于缺乏支持，该联盟计划停止运营，而不是推出新版本。

paras.en: LIV Golf, which launched in June 2022 by offering nine-figure signing bonuses to lure top names away from the PGA Tour, lost Saudi Arabian funding in April after spending more than $US5 billion ($7 billion).
paras.zh: LIV Golf 于 2022 年 6 月推出，通过提供九位数的签约奖金来吸引顶级球员离开 PGA 巡回赛，但在花费超过 50 亿美元（70 亿美元）后，于 4 月份失去了沙特阿拉伯的资金。

paras.en: LIV held four events in Australia, all in Adelaide, and was scheduled to host its fifth tournament in March at Kooyonga Golf Club.
paras.zh: LIV 在澳大利亚举办了四场比赛，全部在阿德莱德举行，并计划于 3 月份在 Kooyonga 高尔夫俱乐部举办第五场比赛。

paras.en: "The debtors are not currently proceeding with the LIV 2.0 plan," lawyer Matthew Williams of Gibson Dunn said during a hearing in New Jersey. "Instead, the debtors are toggling to a value-maximising wind-down in their business."
paras.zh: Gibson Dunn 的律师 Matthew Williams 在新泽西州举行的听证会上表示：“债务人目前没有继续执行 LIV 2.0 计划。” “相反，债务人正在转向价值最大化的业务缩减。”

paras.en: LIV filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on September 8 and thought it had a lifeline in BC Partners Credit, which pledged a $US300 million investment to pivot to a more financially sustainable "LIV 2.0". But players like Jon Rahm, Sergio Garcia, Tyrrell Hatton, and Louis Oosthuizen were not interested.
paras.zh: LIV 于 9 月 8 日根据美国破产法第 11 章申请破产，并认为 BC Partners Credit 为其提供了生命线，后者承诺投资 3 亿美元，以转向财务上更可持续的“LIV 2.0”。但乔恩·拉姆、塞尔吉奥·加西亚、泰瑞尔·哈顿和路易斯·乌修仁等球员并不感兴趣。

paras.en: "BC Partners Credit supported a transaction that aligned the interests of players and investors, offering a credible path toward building a sustainable future for LIV Golf," BC Partners said in a statement.
paras.zh: BC Partners 在一份声明中表示：“BC Partners Credit 支持这项交易，使球员和投资者的利益保持一致，为 LIV Golf 建设可持续的未来提供了一条可靠的道路。”

paras.en: "While there was great support for the league, we are disappointed that mutually acceptable terms could not be reached among the various stakeholders."
paras.zh: “虽然联盟得到了大力支持，但我们对各利益相关者之间未能达成双方都能接受的条款感到失望。”

paras.en: Instead of planning for a new version for 2027, LIV is entering a liquidation phase.
paras.zh: LIV 没有计划在 2027 年发布新版本，而是进入清算阶段。

paras.en: Rahm already agreed to forfeit all claims against LIV — said to be worth some $100 million — to get out of his contract. He is back on the European Tour, hoping there will be a path back to the PGA Tour. The tour currently has a one-year ban in place for players dating back to their last LIV appearance.
paras.zh: 拉姆已经同意放弃对 LIV 的所有索赔（据称价值约 1 亿美元），以解除合同。他重返欧巡赛，希望能有一条重返美巡赛的道路。目前，巡回赛对自上次参加 LIV 比赛以来的球员实行一年禁赛。

paras.en: LIV Golf paid $US15.6 million to retain seven of its executives, including $US6.375 million to chief executive Scott O'Neil, in the months between the Public Investment Fund of Saudi Arabia and LIV filing for bankruptcy. Those payments are not unusual for a company trying to emerge from bankruptcy. The question now is whether those payments can be voided given that LIV is not going forward.
paras.zh: 在沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金和 LIV 申请破产之间的几个月里，LIV Golf 支付了 1,560 万美元保留了 7 名高管，其中包括向首席执行官斯科特·奥尼尔 (Scott O'Neil) 支付了 637.5 万美元。对于一家试图摆脱破产的公司来说，这些付款并不罕见。现在的问题是，鉴于 LIV 无法继续进行，这些付款是否可以作废。

paras.en: LIV suffered two big setbacks, both before and after filing for bankruptcy.
paras.zh: LIV 在申请破产之前和之后都遭受了两次重大挫折。

paras.en: The Asian Tour, which received financial support from LIV for an International Series, decided in July to renew its alliance with the PGA Tour and the European Tour.
paras.zh: 亚巡赛获得了LIV国际系列赛的财政支持，并于7月决定与美巡赛和欧巡赛续签联盟关系。

paras.en: Then, European Tour chief executive Guy Kinnings last month said anyone signing up for LIV 2.0 need not apply for membership on the tour, which put European players at risk of having no part in the Ryder Cup.
paras.zh: 随后，欧巡赛首席执行官盖伊·金宁斯上个月表示，任何报名参加 LIV 2.0 的人都无需申请巡回赛会员资格，这使得欧洲球员面临无法参加莱德杯的风险。

paras.en: But the biggest setback was in April, two weeks after the Masters and two months after the start of the Iran war. PIF changed its investment strategy and said it would no longer pay for LIV Golf after the 2026 season.
paras.zh: 但最大的挫折是在四月份，即美国大师赛两周后、伊朗战争爆发两个月后。 PIF改变投资策略，表示2026赛季后将不再为LIV Golf付费。

paras.en: LIV was originally run by Greg Norman, who tried unsuccessfully to start a world tour in 1994 only to have it quashed by Arnold Palmer and the PGA Tour. Norman had Saudi money at his disposal and promoted LIV as "Golf, but louder" with blaring music, 54-hole shotgun starts and $US25 million in prize funds — individual and team — at each event.
paras.zh: LIV 最初由格雷格·诺曼 (Greg Norman) 经营，他于 1994 年试图开始世界巡回赛，但没有成功，结果被阿诺·帕尔默 (Arnold Palmer) 和美巡赛 (PGA Tour) 取消。诺曼拥有沙特的资金，他将 LIV 宣传为“高尔夫，但更响亮”，每场比赛都伴随着刺耳的音乐、54 洞的猎枪式比赛以及 2500 万美元的个人和团体奖金。

paras.en: But it had no broadcast deal the first year, meaning it had to cover production costs. It got the CW Network in 2023, and eventually got Fox Sports to sign on in 2025.
paras.zh: 但它第一年没有签订转播协议，这意味着它必须承担制作成本。它于 2023 年获得了 CW Network，并最终于 2025 年获得了福克斯体育频道 (Fox Sports) 的签约。

paras.en: The year began with Brooks Koepka getting out of his LIV deal with one year remaining, and the PGA Tour created a path — with financial penalties — to return. Patrick Reed chose not to extend his deal and is now poised to return to the PGA Tour next year through his performance in Europe.
paras.zh: 年初，布鲁克斯·科普卡 (Brooks Koepka) 终止了与 LIV 的合同还剩一年，美巡赛开辟了一条重返赛场的道路，但会受到经济处罚。帕特里克·里德选择不续约，现在准备通过他在欧洲的表现，明年重返美巡赛。

paras.en: Rahm had said on Tuesday he would be willing to pay the same price as Koepka, though it was unlikely that same deal would be offered.
paras.zh: 拉姆周二表示，他愿意支付与科普卡相同的价格，尽管不太可能提供相同的交易。

paras.en: LIV 2.0 was pushing player equity and prize money that was more than half the $US20 million purses for individuals when it began in 2022. LIV's final event was in August in Indianapolis, won by Michael La Sasso. He failed to get through the second stage of European Tour Q-School last week.
paras.zh: LIV 2.0 于 2022 年推出时，致力于推动玩家权益和奖金超过个人奖金 2000 万美元的一半以上。LIV 的决赛于 8 月在印第安纳波利斯举行，由 Michael La Sasso 获胜。上周他未能通过欧巡赛资格学校的第二阶段。

articles.title: Live: Canavan criticises treasurer's attempt to find ideas to boost productivity
articles.author: Joshua Boscaini

paras.en: Federal politics live: Canavan criticises treasurer's attempt to find ideas to boost productivity
paras.zh: 联邦政治直播：卡纳万批评财政部长试图寻找提高生产力的想法

paras.en: Nationals leader Matt Canavan has criticised the treasurer's attempt to find ideas to boost national productivity in his department.
paras.zh: 国家党领袖马特·卡纳万批评了财政部长试图在他的部门寻找提高国家生产力的想法。

paras.en: Follow all the updates in our live blog.
paras.zh: 关注我们实时博客中的所有更新。

paras.en: Canavan criticises treasurers attempt to find ideas to boost productivity
paras.zh: 卡纳万批评财务主管试图寻找提高生产力的想法

paras.en: Nationals senator Matt Canavan has criticised the treasurer's move to seek ideas to boost productivity from his department.
paras.zh: 国家党参议员马特·卡纳万(Matt Canavan)批评了财政部长寻求提高部门生产力的想法的举动。

paras.en: The Australian reports Treasurer Jim Chalmers has asked Treasury to develop new productivity ideas that can be included in this year's mid-year financial update.
paras.zh: 《澳大利亚人报》报道称，财政部长吉姆·查尔默斯已要求财政部制定新的生产力理念，并将其纳入今年年中的财务更新中。

paras.en: Speaking to Channel Nine, the Nationals leader says the Coalition would cut taxes and scrap net zero to boost productivity.
paras.zh: 这位国家党领导人在接受第九频道采访时表示，联盟党将减税并废除净零排放，以提高生产率。

paras.en: "We have this joke of a treasurer asking for ideas about productivity. He had a productivity roundtable 18 months ago, but it didn't tackle the real issues. That's why productivity has continued to fall," Canavan says.
paras.zh: “我们有这样一个笑话，一位财务主管询问有关生产力的想法。他 18 个月前举行了一次生产力圆桌会议，但没有解决真正的问题。这就是生产力持续下降的原因，”卡纳万说。

paras.en: "What we would do is scrap net zero and get energy prices down. That will increase productivity because energy is the economy. We'll cut taxes. This government's increased them massively."
paras.zh: “我们要做的就是废除净零排放并降低能源价格。这将提高生产率，因为能源就是经济。我们将减税。本届政府大幅提高了税收。”

paras.en: Hello and welcome to our federal politics live blog. It's great to have you join us here early this Friday morning!
paras.zh: 您好，欢迎来到我们的联邦政治实时博客。很高兴您本周五早上来到这里加入我们！

paras.en: I'm Josh Boscaini, joining you live from Parliament House in Canberra, here and ready to bring you all of today's federal politics news.
paras.zh: 我是乔什·博斯卡尼 (Josh Boscaini)，将从堪培拉议会大厦现场直播，准备为您带来今天所有的联邦政治新闻。

paras.en: I'm not quite sure what today has for us, so let's get this blog up and away and see what happens!
paras.zh: 我不太确定今天会发生什么，所以让我们打开这个博客，看看会发生什么！

articles.title: Bomb threats affect at least 27 flights, leading to emergency landings at several European airports

paras.en: Bomb threats affect at least 27 flights, leading to emergency landings at several European airports
paras.zh: 炸弹威胁影响至少 27 架航班，导致多个欧洲机场紧急迫降

paras.en: No incendiary devices found after security checks carried out in several locations
paras.zh: 多处地点进行安全检查后未发现燃烧装置

paras.en: A series of hoax bomb threats hit at least 27 European flights on Thursday morning, affecting airlines from Ireland to Bulgaria for the second time this week, with some making unplanned landings or being escorted by fighter jets.
paras.zh: 周四上午，至少 27 架欧洲航班遭遇一系列恶作剧炸弹威胁，这是本周第二次影响从爱尔兰飞往保加利亚的航空公司，其中一些航班计划外降落或由战斗机护航。

paras.en: While no country has attributed blame for the threats, they come at a time when many European officials have accused Russia of masterminding sabotage and "hybrid attacks" — often cheap, easily deniable and not expected to trigger an armed response.
paras.zh: 虽然没有国家将这些威胁归咎于这些威胁，但这些威胁发生之际，许多欧洲官员指责俄罗斯策划破坏和“混合攻击”——这些攻击通常成本低廉、容易否认，而且预计不会引发武装反应。

paras.en: Denmark, Poland and Romania — all affected by Thursday's disruptions — have previously accused Moscow directly, while Germany blamed Russia for a drone attack on Leipzig airport in August. Britain has blamed Russia in the past, but linked Iran to a suspected plot to attack a U.S. airbase. Both Russia and Iran deny any involvement.
paras.zh: 丹麦、波兰和罗马尼亚——都受到周四的干扰事件的影响——此前曾直接指责莫斯科，而德国则指责俄罗斯八月份对莱比锡机场发动无人机袭击。英国过去曾指责俄罗斯，但将伊朗与涉嫌袭击美国空军基地的阴谋联系起来。俄罗斯和伊朗均否认有任何参与。

paras.en: The Italian news agency ANSA said two planes had landed as planned in Milan, while a person familiar with the matter said Italy's air force escorted a Finnair plane coming from Helsinki to its scheduled landing in Rome.
paras.zh: 意大利安莎通讯社称，两架飞机已按计划降落在米兰，而一位知情人士称，意大利空军护送一架从赫尔辛基起飞的芬兰航空飞机按计划降落在罗马。

paras.en: The operator of Rome's Fiumicino Airport said there had been no disruption to services, and that departing passengers were philosophical.
paras.zh: 罗马菲乌米奇诺机场的运营商表示，服务没有受到干扰，离境的乘客都很理智。

paras.en: "It's more complicated with everything that's going on, but what else are we going to do?" said Spaniard Lucia Parga. "We still have to get around. So, well, we just have to deal with it as best we can."
paras.zh: “正在发生的一切都变得更加复杂，但我们还能做什么呢？”西班牙人露西娅·帕尔加说道。 “我们仍然必须四处走动。所以，好吧，我们只能尽力处理它。”

paras.en: Another traveller, Gabriele Franzese, added: "You can't worry too much about every piece of news. If the plane crashes, so be it. If it's meant to happen, it'll happen anyway."
paras.zh: 另一位旅行者加布里埃莱·弗兰泽斯(Gabriele Franzese)补充道：“你不能太担心每一条新闻。如果飞机坠毁，那就这样吧。如果它注定要发生，它无论如何都会发生。”

paras.en: Another Finnair flight from Helsinki, operated by Jettime, landed as normal in Vienna after receiving a bomb threat, Finnair said.
paras.zh: 芬兰航空表示，另一架由 Jettime 运营的从赫尔辛基起飞的芬兰航空航班在收到炸弹威胁后正常降落在维也纳。

paras.en: In France, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu's office said he had sent fighter jets to intercept an Aer Lingus flight from Dublin to Rome, escorting it to an air force base at Evreux after the pilot did not co-operate with authorities as expected.
paras.zh: 在法国，总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努的办公室表示，由于飞行员没有按预期配合当局，他已派出战斗机拦截从都柏林飞往罗马的爱尔兰航空航班，将其护送至埃夫勒的空军基地。

paras.en: No reason was given for the pilot's behaviour.
paras.zh: 没有给出飞行员行为的原因。

paras.en: A view of Fiumicino Airport in Rome is shown, after a Finnair plane from Helsinki was safely escorted by Italian military jets following bomb threats that forced airliners to make unplanned landings across Europe. (Remo Casilli/Reuters)
paras.zh: 图为罗马菲乌米奇诺机场的景色，一架从赫尔辛基起飞的芬兰航空飞机受到炸弹威胁，迫使客机在欧洲各地意外降落，并由意大利军用飞机安全护送。 （雷莫·卡西利/路透社）

paras.en: Joji Waites, director of flight safety for the British Airline Pilots’ Association, said it was industry practice that airlines did not act on threats unless they had been rated credible by assessors.
paras.zh: 英国航空公司飞行员协会飞行安全主任乔吉·韦特斯表示，行业惯例是，除非航空公司被评估人员评为可信，否则不会对威胁采取行动。

paras.en: Also Thursday, Spanish authorities received three emailed bomb threats in under 20 minutes, starting around 9 a.m. local time, involving two Air Europa departures from Madrid to Paris and four inbound Iberia flights from Rome and Milan, Spain's Guardia Civil said.
paras.zh: 西班牙国民警卫队表示，周四，西班牙当局在当地时间上午 9 点左右开始，在不到 20 分钟内收到了三封电子邮件炸弹威胁，涉及两架从马德里飞往巴黎的欧洲航空公司航班以及四架从罗马和米兰出发的伊比利亚航空公司航班。

paras.en: Several aircraft were halted or returned to their stands and passengers were disembarked while planes were inspected.
paras.zh: 多架飞机被暂停或返回停机位，乘客在飞机接受检查时下机。

paras.en: Two EasyJet flights from Britain, one flight from Ireland and one from Greece landed as scheduled in Prague after receiving bomb threats. Czech police said they had assessed the credibility of the threats as low.
paras.zh: 两架来自英国的易捷航空航班、一架来自爱尔兰的航班和一架来自希腊的航班在收到炸弹威胁后如期降落在布拉格。捷克警方表示，他们评估威胁的可信度较低。

paras.en: Bulgarian officials reported three aircraft, all under the Ryanair banner, made emergency landings because of bomb threats.
paras.zh: 保加利亚官员报告称，瑞安航空旗下的三架飞机因炸弹威胁而紧急迫降。

paras.en: Airplanes flying from Copenhagen and Madrid landed in Sofia, the country's interior minister said, according to broadcaster bTV. A third aircraft, from London, landed in Plovdiv, local media said.
paras.zh: 据广播公司 bTV 报道，该国内政部长表示，从哥本哈根和马德里起飞的飞机降落在索非亚。当地媒体称，第三架飞机从伦敦起飞，降落在普罗夫迪夫。

paras.en: Airport operations at both Sofia and Plovdiv airport operations soon returned to normal, Bulgaria's Transport Ministry told Reuters, after no issues were identified following inspections of the planes.
paras.zh: 保加利亚交通部告诉路透社，在检查飞机后没有发现任何问题后，索非亚和普罗夫迪夫机场的运营很快恢复正常。
