paras.en: Passengers check their flight at Leonardo da Vinci International Airport in Fiumicino, near Rome, Thursday, amid disruptions across multiple flights across Europe. (Gregorio Borgia/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周四，乘客们在罗马附近菲乌米奇诺的达芬奇国际机场检查航班，欧洲多趟航班均出现中断。 （格雷戈里奥·博吉亚/美联社）

paras.en: Polish airlines LOT said a flight from Warsaw to Brussels landed safely at its destination Thursday after a security warning and no threat was confirmed.
paras.zh: 波兰航空公司LOT表示，一架从华沙飞往布鲁塞尔的航班在发出安全警告后于周四安全降落在目的地，且没有确认任何威胁。

paras.en: "No suspicious items were found," a LOT spokesperson said.
paras.zh: “没有发现可疑物品，”LOT 发言人表示。

paras.en: Another flight from Cork in Ireland was delayed 90 minutes after the airport received a threat, the airport operator said. At Copenhagen airport in Denmark, two planes were searched, police said.
paras.zh: 机场运营商表示，机场收到威胁后，另一架从爱尔兰科克起飞的航班延误了 90 分钟。警方称，在丹麦哥本哈根机场，两架飞机遭到搜查。

paras.en: Airport, supermarket disruptions earlier this week
paras.zh: 本周早些时候机场、超市出现混乱

paras.en: On Tuesday, at least seven flights and a cruise ship received bomb threats, causing disruption at airports across Europe, although no devices were discovered.
paras.zh: 周二，至少七架航班和一艘游轮收到炸弹威胁，导致欧洲各地机场中断，但没有发现任何装置。

paras.en: Drone incursions have periodically forced flight delays and cancellations in Europe and, this week, unidentified hackers shut down fridges in supermarkets in several countries across the continent.
paras.zh: 无人机入侵定期导致欧洲航班延误和取消，本周，身份不明的黑客关闭了欧洲大陆多个国家超市的冰箱。

paras.en: - String of bomb threats on flights, cruise ship disrupt travel across Europe
paras.zh: - 航班和游轮上的一系列炸弹威胁扰乱了欧洲各地的旅行

paras.en: - Another cyberattack on supermarket fridges sweeps Europe, leaving food spoiled
paras.zh: - 另一场针对超市冰箱的网络攻击席卷欧洲，导致食物变质

paras.en: Eliran Almog, CEO of aviation cybersecurity firm Cyviation, said the repeated threats could serve both to disrupt operations and to observe how airlines, airports and national authorities respond.
paras.zh: 航空网络安全公司 Cyviation 首席执行官埃里兰·阿尔莫格 (Eliran Almog) 表示，反复出现的威胁可能会扰乱运营，并观察航空公司、机场和国家当局的反应。

paras.en: "These aviation threats are also occurring in the same period as cyberattacks on supermarket refrigeration systems across Europe," Almog said.
paras.zh: 阿尔莫格说：“这些航空威胁也与欧洲超市制冷系统遭受网络攻击的时期发生。”

paras.en: "Different essential services are experiencing disruption that carries economic costs and can undermine public confidence."
paras.zh: “不同的基本服务正在经历中断，这会带来经济成本，并可能削弱公众信心。”

articles.title: Largely peaceful marches across France as workers stage strike, some police clashes reported

paras.en: Largely peaceful marches across France as workers stage strike, some police clashes reported
paras.zh: 据报道，法国各地工人举行罢工，游行基本和平，部分警察发生冲突

paras.en: Protests come after weeks of demonstrations over living costs, public services and education
paras.zh: 抗议活动是在针对生活成本、公共服务和教育的示威活动进行了数周之后发生的

paras.en: Some protesters clashed with police in Paris and Lyon on Thursday during largely peaceful nationwide demonstrations and a one-day strike by some public sector workers in a renewed challenge to French President Emmanuel Macron.
paras.zh: 周四，巴黎和里昂的一些抗议者在全国范围内基本和平的示威活动中与警察发生冲突，一些公共部门工作人员举行了为期一天的罢工，以再次挑战法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙。

paras.en: The protests were attended by several high-profile politicians, including presidential candidates Jean-Luc Mélenchon and Raphael Glucksmann. The protests follow demonstrations over living costs, public services and education that have triggered the worst civil unrest France has seen in years.
paras.zh: 几位知名政界人士参加了抗议活动，其中包括总统候选人让-吕克·梅朗雄和拉斐尔·格鲁克斯曼。抗议活动发生在针对生活成本、公共服务和教育的示威活动引发了法国多年来最严重的内乱。

paras.en: The Interior Ministry said 270,000 people had participated in protests around the country so far, excluding Paris, where the main demonstration started in the afternoon.
paras.zh: 内政部表示，迄今为止，全国各地已有27万人参加了抗议活动，不包括下午开始的主要示威活动巴黎。

paras.en: "This country needs justice," Glucksmann told reporters at the start of the Paris march. "We are going to bring the French people back together. We are going to restore public services; we will do ... the opposite of what's taken place in the past 10 years."
paras.zh: “这个国家需要正义，”格鲁克斯曼在巴黎游行开始时对记者说。 “我们将让法国人民重新团结起来。我们将恢复公共服务；我们将做……与过去十年相反的事情。”

paras.en: Riot police in Lyon detain protesters during a demonstration for higher wages and in support of the high school protest movement on Thursday. (Laurent Cipriani/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周四，里昂防暴警察在要求提高工资和支持高中抗议运动的示威活动中拘留了抗议者。 （劳伦特·西普里亚尼/美联社）

paras.en: In Paris, the mood was festive at the start, featuring a diverse group of participants singing La Marseillaise and some carnival-like floats. The Eiffel Tower was shut by the one-day strike, which was joined by some energy workers and teachers, but there were no major disruptions to transport.
paras.zh: 在巴黎，一开始气氛就很欢乐，各种各样的参与者唱着《马赛曲》，还有一些嘉年华式的花车。埃菲尔铁塔因为期一天的罢工而关闭，一些能源工人和教师也参加了罢工，但交通并未受到重大干扰。

paras.en: But about two hours in, some of the people at the front of the march clashed with police, who fired tear gas.
paras.zh: 但大约两个小时后，游行队伍前面的一些人与警察发生冲突，警察发射了催泪瓦斯。

paras.en: In Lyon, riot police fired tear gas and charged a group of protesters, some of whom were seen shouting anti-police slogans and dressed all in black, with face coverings. The Interior Ministry said the police there had been confronted by several hundred hardcore protesters and that the violence had been contained, although tensions remained high.
paras.zh: 在里昂，防暴警察发射催泪瓦斯并向一群抗议者发起冲锋，其中一些人高喊着反警察口号，身穿黑衣，戴着面罩。内政部表示，那里的警察遇到了数百名铁杆抗议者，尽管紧张局势仍然严重，但暴力事件已得到遏制。

paras.en: Students attend a demonstration in Paris on Thursday demanding more education funding in Paris. (Thibault Camus/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周四，学生们在巴黎参加示威活动，要求巴黎提供更多教育经费。 （蒂博·加缪/美联社）

paras.en: The unrest comes only five months before a presidential election, which could pit far-right candidate Marine Le Pen against hard-left rival Jean-Luc Melenchon in a second-round runoff. Macron, who is serving his second term and is unpopular, cannot run again.
paras.zh: 这场骚乱发生在距离总统选举仅五个月的时候，极右翼候选人马琳·勒庞可能会在第二轮决选中与极左翼竞争对手让-吕克·梅朗雄对决。正在履行第二任期且不受欢迎的马克龙无法再次参选。

paras.en: "There is a lot of concern about the future, notably the issues of salaries, public services," said Alice Martinovic, an 18-year-old student participating in the Paris demonstration.
paras.zh: “人们对未来有很多担忧，特别是工资和公共服务问题，”参加巴黎示威活动的 18 岁学生爱丽丝·马蒂诺维奇 (Alice Martinovic) 说。

paras.en: "I hope in the upcoming elections the candidates will really think about this movement and include the opinions of young people, of students, who are now joined by a lot of other workers."
paras.zh: “我希望在即将到来的选举中，候选人能够真正考虑这场运动，并纳入年轻人、学生的意见，现在许多其他工人也加入了他们的行列。”

paras.en: School ablaze after fireworks are hurled
paras.zh: 学校因燃放烟花爆竹而起火

paras.en: The Interior Ministry said people throwing fireworks had caused a fire at a high school near the city of Toulouse in the southwest on Thursday morning, forcing pupils and staff to evacuate the building while firefighters doused the flames.
paras.zh: 内政部表示，周四早上，人们投掷烟花导致西南部图卢兹市附近的一所高中发生火灾，迫使学生和教职员工撤离大楼，消防队员正在扑灭火焰。

paras.en: "This criminal behavior is an absolute scandal," said Education Minister Edouard Geffray on X.
paras.zh: 教育部长爱德华·格弗雷 (Edouard Geffray) 在 X 上表示：“这种犯罪行为绝对是丑闻。”

paras.en: French high school students and other demonstrators had earlier faced off against riot police in Paris as they blocked a street with rubbish bins on Thursday morning.
paras.zh: 周四早上，法国高中生和其他示威者在巴黎与防暴警察发生冲突，他们用垃圾箱封锁了一条街道。

paras.en: A protester dressed as the superhero Deadpool rides a toy unicorn during the Thursday demonstration in Lyon. (Laurent Cipriani/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 星期四在里昂举行的示威活动中，一名打扮成超级英雄死侍的抗议者骑着一只玩具独角兽。 （劳伦特·西普里亚尼/美联社）

paras.en: While the demonstrations in Lyon and other cities, including Marseille and Nantes, began in the morning, the main protest in Paris was only scheduled to start at 2 p.m. local time,.
paras.zh: 虽然里昂和马赛和南特等其他城市的示威活动于早上开始，但巴黎的主要抗议活动原定于下午 2 点开始。当地时间,.

paras.en: The Eiffel Tower was shut on Thursday because of the strike.
paras.zh: 周四，埃菲尔铁塔因罢工而关闭。

paras.en: "The government tried to block the demonstrations. The demonstrations are bigger than ever," Sophie Binet, head of the CGT trade union, told reporters. She estimated that some 250,000 people were demonstrating across France.
paras.zh: “政府试图阻止示威活动。示威活动比以往任何时候都规模更大，”CGT工会主席索菲·比内告诉记者。她估计法国各地约有 25 万人正在示威。

paras.en: "High school students, pensioners, students, workers, all together. Unity wins," read one banner at the protest in Lyon.
paras.zh: “高中生、养老金领取者、学生、工人，大家在一起。团结获胜，”里昂抗议活动中的一条横幅上写着。

paras.en: "Our pay has not kept up with inflation," said Mehdi Dumontroty, a 45-year-old firefighter who was joining the protest in Paris.
paras.zh: “我们的工资跟不上通货膨胀，”参加巴黎抗议活动的 45 岁消防员迈赫迪·杜蒙特罗蒂 (Mehdi Dumontroty) 说。

paras.en: "What happened this summer proves that we were right when we said we needed more resources to deal with the crisis that we faced," he said, referring to wildfires caused earlier this year by intense heat waves.
paras.zh: 他说：“今年夏天发生的事情证明，我们说我们需要更多资源来应对我们面临的危机，这是正确的。”他指的是今年早些时候由强烈热浪引发的野火。

paras.en: Authorities had sought to lower tensions after riots and looting on Oct. 17 caught security forces off guard, leaving damaged shops and public buildings across the country and fuelling criticism of Macron's handling of the crisis.
paras.zh: 10月17日发生的骚乱和抢劫让安全部队措手不及，导致全国各地的商店和公共建筑受损，并引发了对马克龙危机处理方式的批评，当局曾试图缓解紧张局势。

paras.en: A car burns during a demonstration in Lyon. (Laurent Cipriani/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 里昂示威期间一辆汽车被烧毁。 （劳伦特·西普里亚尼/美联社）

paras.en: Around 70,000 police were on duty nationwide, a comparable figure to recent weekends. The French government has defended police tactics while saying any abuses would be investigated.
paras.zh: 全国约有 7 万名警察执勤，与最近周末的数字相当。法国政府为警方的策略进行了辩护，同时表示将对任何滥用行为进行调查。

paras.en: The Education Ministry said just over 15 per cent of French teaching staff had joined the strike.
paras.zh: 教育部表示，超过 15% 的法国教师参加了罢工。

paras.en: Protests drawn into election campaigning
paras.zh: 抗议活动被卷入竞选活动

paras.en: The movement began in September with a protest over staff shortages at a high school southeast of Paris and spread nationwide. It drew students demanding more education funding and workers seeking better pensions and help with soaring fuel prices and other costs.
paras.zh: 该运动始于九月，抗议巴黎东南部一所高中教职人员短缺，并蔓延至全国。它吸引了要求更多教育经费的学生和寻求更好养老金以及帮助应对不断飙升的燃油价格和其他成本的工人。

paras.en: The rallies come as the campaign to succeed Macron as president next May heats up, with political parties seeking to capitalize on the movement. Macron is constitutionally barred from seeking a third consecutive term. Far-right candidate Marine Le Pen is the favourite to win.
paras.zh: 这些集会正值明年五月继任马克龙总统的竞选活动升温之际，各政党都试图利用这一运动。根据宪法，马克龙不得寻求连续第三个任期。极右翼候选人马琳·勒庞是获胜的热门人选。

articles.title: Mexican judge arrested over alleged $2M bribe to release Ryan Wedding's second-in-command

paras.en: Mexican judge arrested over alleged $2M bribe to release Ryan Wedding's second-in-command
paras.zh: 墨西哥法官因涉嫌行贿 200 万美元而被捕，以释放 Ryan Wedding 的二把手

paras.en: Luis Benitez Alcantara accused of using position to secure release of Andrew Clark
paras.zh: 路易斯·贝尼特斯·阿尔坎塔拉被指控利用职务之便确保安德鲁·克拉克获释

paras.en: A Mexican judge has been arrested on allegations that he accepted a $2-million US bribe in exchange for granting bail to a man accused of acting as second-in-command to Ryan Wedding, the former Canadian Olympic snowboarder turned alleged drug kingpin, American officials said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 美国官员周四表示，一名墨西哥法官因涉嫌收受 200 万美元的美国贿赂而被捕，以换取一名被指控担任前加拿大滑雪运动员瑞安·威丁 (Ryan Wedding) 二把手的男子保释。

paras.en: The U.S. Department of Justice said Luis Benitez Alcantara is accused of using his official position to secure the release of Andrew Clark, a 36-year-old Canadian man alleged to play a key role in a violent international drug trafficking ring, thus allowing Clark to evade detention.
paras.zh: 美国司法部表示，路易斯·贝尼特斯·阿尔坎塔拉被指控利用其官方职务，确保释放 36 岁的加拿大男子安德鲁·克拉克，他被控在国际暴力贩毒团伙中发挥关键作用，从而使克拉克得以逃避拘留。

paras.en: Benitez Alcantara, 49, was arrested on Sunday in Colombia and a request will be made for his extradition, U.S. officials said. He was arrested on a nine-count federal indictment and, if convicted, could face a maximum penalty of 15 years in prison for each count, they said.
paras.zh: 美国官员称，49 岁的贝尼特斯·阿尔坎塔拉周日在哥伦比亚被捕，将提出引渡请求。他们表示，他因 9 项联邦起诉书而被捕，如果罪名成立，每项罪名最高可能面临 15 年监禁。

paras.en: "Crooked public officials, no matter where they are, who assist drug traffickers operating here at home will face justice in the United States," U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche said in a news release.
paras.zh: 美国司法部长托德·布兰奇在一份新闻稿中表示：“在国内协助毒贩的不法公职人员，无论身在何处，都将在美国面临正义。”

paras.en: Clark was first arrested in Mexico in October 2024, on U.S. charges of drug trafficking, murder and attempted murder, the release said. Wedding was also named on the charges.
paras.zh: 新闻稿称，克拉克于 2024 年 10 月首次在墨西哥被捕，罪名是美国指控贩毒、谋杀和谋杀未遂。婚礼上也被点名指控。

paras.en: - Ryan Wedding ally 'Tupac,' who allegedly offered cosmetic surgery to locate murder target, requests bail
paras.zh: - 瑞安婚礼盟友“图帕克”，据称提供整容手术来定位谋杀目标，请求保释

paras.en: - Toronto-area man sentenced to 68 months in prison for smuggling cocaine allegedly tied to Ryan Wedding
paras.zh: - 多伦多地区男子因涉嫌与瑞安婚礼有关走私可卡因被判处 68 个月监禁

paras.en: The following month, American officials formally requested that Clark be extradited to face prosecution in the U.S., it said. From then through February 2025, it's alleged that Clark transferred about $2.75 million in small increments and through intermediaries in a bid to be freed from Mexican custody.
paras.zh: 报道称，接下来的一个月，美国官员正式要求引渡克拉克，以便在美国接受起诉。据称，从那时起到 2025 年 2 月，克拉克通过中间人小额转移了约 275 万美元，以摆脱墨西哥的羁押。

paras.en: Officials allege Clark also struck a deal to pay Benitez Alcantara, the district judge overseeing his extradition proceedings, about $2 million in exchange for ordering his release. It's alleged Benitez Alcantara granted him bond and ordered his release in February of last year, on the same day he allegedly received the bribe.
paras.zh: 官员称克拉克还达成一项协议，向负责监督其引渡程序的地区法官贝尼特斯·阿尔坎塔拉支付约 200 万美元，以换取下令释放他。据称，贝尼特斯·阿尔坎塔拉于去年 2 月保释了他，并下令释放他，就在他据称收受贿赂的同一天。

paras.en: Clark was arrested again days later and taken to the United States, where his criminal case is pending.
paras.zh: 几天后克拉克再次被捕并被带到美国，他的刑事案件正在等待审理。

paras.en: Wedding, meanwhile, was arrested in Mexico in January of this year and taken to the United States to face drug trafficking, murder and attempted murder charges. He remains in federal custody awaiting two trials in March and October of next year.
paras.zh: 与此同时，维迪于今年一月在墨西哥被捕，并被带到美国面临贩毒、谋杀和谋杀未遂指控。他仍被联邦拘留，等待明年三月和十月的两次审判。

articles.title: Iran signals satisfaction, skepticism after US midterm vote

paras.en: Iran's leadership has downplayed the significance of Republican setbacks in the US midterm elections, insisting that the Democratic takeover of Congress is unlikely to alter Washington's policy toward the Islamic Republic.
paras.zh: 伊朗领导层淡化了共和党在美国中期选举中遭遇挫折的重要性，坚称民主党接管国会不太可能改变华盛顿对伊朗的政策。

paras.en: "If there are still those who believe that America can be persuaded to abandon its hostility toward the Iranian nation through concessions or partisan changes in the US political system, they are gravely mistaken," Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said in a statement after the vote.
paras.zh: 最高领袖哈梅内伊在投票后的一份声明中表示：“如果仍然有人相信美国可以通过让步或美国政治制度的党派变化来说服美国放弃对伊朗国家的敌意，那么他们就大错特错了。”

paras.en: Khamenei also warned that Tehran would respond more forcefully to any future US military action.
paras.zh: 哈梅内伊还警告称，德黑兰将对美国未来的任何军事行动作出更强有力的反应。

paras.en: The elections took place after months of military confrontation between Tehran and Washington, which disrupted global energy markets and raised fears of a broader regional conflict.
paras.zh: 这次选举是在德黑兰和华盛顿之间持续数月的军事对抗之后举行的，这场军事对抗扰乱了全球能源市场，并引发了人们对更广泛地区冲突的担忧。

paras.en: Tehran likely to stick to its course despite US political shift
paras.zh: 尽管美国政治发生转变，德黑兰可能仍会坚持自己的路线

paras.en: Mohammad Sadegh Javadi Hesar, Iran-based journalist and member of the reformist party Etemad-e Melli, said the election outcome was unlikely to affect Iran's calculations.
paras.zh: 驻伊朗记者、改革派政党人民党成员穆罕默德·萨德·贾瓦迪·赫萨尔表示，选举结果不太可能影响伊朗的计算。

paras.en: "Iran will not change its position simply because Republicans have lost their majority," he told DW.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“伊朗不会仅仅因为共和党失去多数席位而改变立场。”

paras.en: According to Javadi Hesar, decisions about ending the conflict will ultimately be made in Washington. Tehran, in turn, is expected to continue insisting on its previous demands for peace, such as the end of all hostilities, including in Lebanon, and the lifting of US naval blockade.
paras.zh: 贾瓦迪·赫萨尔表示，结束冲突的决定最终将由华盛顿做出。反过来，预计德黑兰将继续坚持其先前的和平要求，例如结束包括黎巴嫩在内的所有敌对行动，以及解除美国的海上封锁。

paras.en: Is a vote for US Democrats a vote against the Iran war?
paras.zh: 投票给美国民主党就是投票反对伊朗战争吗？

paras.en: Others in Iran interpreted the results more positively.
paras.zh: 伊朗的其他人对这一结果的解读更为积极。

paras.en: Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf argued that American voters had delivered their verdict on the Iranian conflict.
paras.zh: 议会议长穆罕默德·巴格尔·加利巴夫认为，美国选民已经对伊朗冲突做出了裁决。

paras.en: "The Americans said no to war," Ghalibaf said on X, while acknowledging that rising cost of living also contributed to Donald Trump's party losing the election.
paras.zh: “美国人对战争说不，”加利巴夫在 X 上说道，同时承认生活成本的上升也导致了唐纳德·特朗普的政党输掉了选举。

paras.en: Ghalibaf also mocked US Vice President JD Vance who had acknowledged that the Iran war was the reason the Republicans lost.
paras.zh: 加利巴夫还嘲笑美国副总统万斯承认伊朗战争是共和党失败的原因。

paras.en: "Skip the TED talk. Why not say this to your boss?" Ghalibaf wrote on X.
paras.zh: “跳过 TED 演讲。为什么不把这个告诉你的老板呢？” Ghalibaf 在 X 上写道。

paras.en: Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, said Iran not only challenged the United States on the battlefield and in the Strait of Hormuz but had also dealt it a political setback in Washington.
paras.zh: 伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书穆赫森·礼扎伊表示，伊朗不仅在战场上和霍尔木兹海峡挑战美国，而且在华盛顿方面给了美国政治挫败。

paras.en: Several Iranian media outlets echoed that assessment. The news website Etelaat Online sarcastically suggested that the long-discussed "regime change" had ultimately taken place not in Iran, but in the United States.
paras.zh: 多家伊朗媒体回应了这一评价。新闻网站Etelaat Online讽刺地表示，讨论已久的“政权更迭”最终不是在伊朗发生，而是在美国发生。

paras.en: Some commentators drew historical parallels to another period of US-Iran tension.
paras.zh: 一些评论家将历史与美伊紧张局势的另一个时期进行了比较。

paras.en: The state-affiliated Mehr News Agency compared Trump's political troubles to those of former US President Jimmy Carter, recalling the failed 1980 American military operation to rescue hostages held in Tehran.
paras.zh: 国家附属的迈赫尔通讯社将特朗普的政治麻烦与美国前总统吉米·卡特的政治麻烦进行了比较，并回顾了 1980 年美国在德黑兰营救人质的失败军事行动。

paras.en: At the time, the US deployed eight military helicopters to rendezvous with six transport planes in the Iranian desert before moving on Tehran to free the hostages. However, the aircraft encountered a sand storm and a deadly crash between a helicopter and a C-130 transport plane, killing eight Americans.
paras.zh: 当时，美国部署了八架军用直升机与六架运输机在伊朗沙漠会合，然后前往德黑兰解救人质。然而，这架飞机遭遇了沙尘暴，并导致一架直升机与一架C-130运输机相撞，造成8名美国人死亡。

paras.en: The agency argued that the 1980 episode demonstrated the limits of US military power in resolving disputes with Iran. Carter went on to lose the presidential election to Ronald Reagan later that year.
paras.zh: 该机构认为，1980 年的事件表明美国军事力量在解决与伊朗的争端方面的局限性。同年晚些时候，卡特在总统选举中输给了罗纳德·里根。

paras.en: Iran released the hostages in January 1981, just minutes after Reagan was sworn in for his first presidential term.
paras.zh: 1981 年 1 月，就在里根宣誓就职并开始其第一个总统任期几分钟后，伊朗释放了人质。

paras.en: Hardline media, however, dismissed the election's broader significance.
paras.zh: 然而，强硬派媒体否认了这次选举的更广泛意义。

paras.en: Tasnim News Agency, which is close to Iran's Revolutionary Guards, argued that there is little meaningful difference between Republicans and Democrats when it comes to Iran policy. According to the agency, both parties pursue similar goals toward the Islamic Republic despite differences in rhetoric.
paras.zh: 与伊朗革命卫队关系密切的塔斯尼姆通讯社认为，在伊朗政策方面，共和党和民主党之间几乎没有什么实质性区别。据该机构称，尽管言辞不同，双方都对伊斯兰共和国追求相似的目标。

paras.en: Using a Persian proverb, Tasnim summed up its view bluntly: "The yellow dog is the brother of the jackal," suggesting that neither side should be expected to act differently toward Iran.
paras.zh: 塔斯尼姆用一句波斯谚语直言不讳地总结了自己的观点：“黄狗是豺狼的兄弟”，这表明双方都不应期望对伊朗采取不同的行动。

paras.en: Veteran Iranian diplomat Hossein Alizadeh says the actual midterm fallout is difficult to predict, but notes US politics sends ripples out across the entire world.
paras.zh: 伊朗资深外交官侯赛因·阿利扎德表示，中期选举的实际影响很难预测，但他指出，美国政治会在全世界范围内产生连锁反应。

paras.en: "The USA is a superpower and a hegemonic power. Consequently, developments in that country are of significance to the entire world — from Mexico and Canada, through the European Union, to China, and, of course, the Middle East," he told DW.
paras.zh: “美国是一个超级大国和霸权国家。因此，该国的发展对整个世界都具有重要意义——从墨西哥和加拿大，到欧盟，再到中国，当然还有中东，”他告诉德国之声。

paras.en: Alizadeh is an expert in international relations who served in the diplomatic corps of the Islamic Republic for 22 years, before resigning in 2010 in protest of the 2009 Iranian post-election crackdown.
paras.zh: 阿利扎德是一位国际关系专家，曾在伊斯兰共和国外交使团工作了 22 年，后于 2010 年因抗议 2009 年伊朗大选后的镇压而辞职。

paras.en: The Finland-based analyst considers another large-scale military escalation by the USA to be unlikely. While the Democrats are also opponents of the Islamic Republic, "unlike the Trump administration, they opted for a diplomatic agreement with Tehran. The 2015 nuclear deal placed Iranian nuclear activities under the oversight of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)," says Alizadeh.
paras.zh: 这位驻芬兰的分析人士认为，美国不太可能再次进行大规模军事升级。虽然民主党也是伊斯兰共和国的反对者，但“与特朗普政府不同，他们选择与德黑兰达成外交协议。2015 年的核协议将伊朗核活动置于国际原子能机构 (IAEA) 的监督之下，”阿利扎德说。

paras.en: He points out that the Democrats and the US allies were not in favor or attacking Iran.
paras.zh: 他指出，民主党和美国盟友并不支持或攻击伊朗。

paras.en: "The negative repercussions of such a war have already become clear," he told DW.
paras.zh: “这样一场战争的负面影响已经很明显，”他告诉德国之声。

paras.en: This piece was originally published in German
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表

articles.title: Arrests and investigations as Serbia begins post-election clean-up

paras.en: Air Serbia flight JU134 from Belgrade to Moscow on November 3 was already deep in Lithuanian airspace when the crew received instructions to return to the Serbian capital.
paras.zh: 11月3日，塞尔维亚航空JU134航班从贝尔格莱德飞往莫斯科，当时机组人员收到返回塞尔维亚首都的指示，该航班已经深入立陶宛领空。

paras.en: Among the passengers were three senior figures from the regime of former President Aleksandar Vucic: Aleksandar Vulin, former defense and interior minister and former head of Serbia's Security Intelligence Agency (BIA), Dusan Bajatovic, long-serving director of state-owned gas company Srbijagas, and Nenad Popovic, a minister without portfolio.
paras.zh: 乘客中包括前总统亚历山大·武契奇(Aleksandar Vucic)政权的三名高级人物：前国防部长和内政部长、塞尔维亚安全情报局(BIA)前局长亚历山大·武林(Aleksandar Vulin)、国有天然气公司Srbijagas长期任职董事杜桑·巴贾托维奇(Dusan Bajatovic)以及无职务的部长内纳德·波波维奇(Nenad Popovic)。

paras.en: All three are well known in Serbia for their close ties to Moscow and for controversies, including allegations of corruption and abuse of public office.
paras.zh: 这三人在塞尔维亚都因其与莫斯科的密切关系和争议而闻名，其中包括腐败和滥用公职的指控。

paras.en: According to unofficial reports published by several media outlets, the plane was ordered back because of a security breach: Vulin had allegedly boarded without undergoing the mandatory security screening.
paras.zh: 据多家媒体发布的非官方报道，这架飞机因安全漏洞而被勒令返航：据称，瓦林未经强制安全检查就登机了。

paras.en: Since 2023, Vulin has been under US sanctions over what Washington described as "engaging in corrupt and destabilizing activities that undermine the rule of law in the Western Balkans."
paras.zh: 自 2023 年以来，Vulin 一直受到美国制裁，华盛顿称其“从事腐败和破坏稳定的活动，破坏西巴尔干地区的法治”。

paras.en: Vulin told the media that he was travelling to Moscow to discuss extending a gas agreement with Russia.
paras.zh: 武林告诉媒体，他正在前往莫斯科讨论延长与俄罗斯的天然气协议。

paras.en: Bajatovic, however, said he did not know why Vulin and Popovic were travelling to Moscow and denied that the two would attend the scheduled meetings on gas supplies.
paras.zh: 然而，巴贾托维奇表示，他不知道瓦林和波波维奇为何前往莫斯科，并否认两人将参加预定的天然气供应会议。

paras.en: The incident might have remained nothing more than an unusual news item had it not occurred at a time when Serbia is undergoing a major political transformation.
paras.zh: 如果不是发生在塞尔维亚正在经历重大政治变革的时期，这一事件可能只是一个不寻常的新闻事件。

paras.en: Judicial developments unfold at remarkable speed
paras.zh: 司法发展速度惊人

paras.en: Just nine days earlier, on October 25, the student-backed list won a landslide victory over the Serbian Progressive Party (SNS) in the parliamentary election, ending 14 years of political dominance by Aleksandar Vucic and the SNS, who maintained close relations with Moscow.
paras.zh: 就在九天前的10月25日，学生支持的名单在议会选举中以压倒性优势击败塞尔维亚进步党（SNS），结束了亚历山大·武契奇和与莫斯科保持密切关系的SNS长达14年的政治统治地位。

paras.en: Although the new majority has yet to take control of any levers of power, the days after the election brought a series of developments that would have seemed unimaginable just a few weeks ago.
paras.zh: 尽管新的多数派尚未控制任何权力杠杆，但选举后的几天里出现了一系列在几周前似乎难以想象的事态发展。

paras.en: Arrests, new criminal proceedings and the reopening of previously unresolved cases began to unfold at remarkable speed. Some of these cases strike at the very foundations of the system built during the SNS years in power.
paras.zh: 逮捕、新的刑事诉讼以及重新审理先前未解决的案件开始以惊人的速度展开。其中一些案例触及了 SNS 统治时期建立的系统的根本基础。

paras.en: "This paints a sad picture of the Serbian prosecution service," prosecutor Bojana Savovic told DW.
paras.zh: 检察官博亚娜·萨沃维奇 (Bojana Savovic) 告诉德国之声：“这为塞尔维亚检察部门描绘了一幅悲伤的画面。”

paras.en: Savovic sees the sudden action on the part of prosecutors as an attempt to ingratiate themselves with the new authorities.
paras.zh: 萨沃维奇认为检察官的突然行动是为了讨好新当局。

paras.en: "With these actions, they are showing what they could have done but were unwilling to do until just ten days ago," she told DW. "I hope this speed of action will not come at the expense of the quality of indictments and that these are not personal vendettas within the old regime."
paras.zh: 她告诉德国之声：“通过这些行动，他们展示了他们本可以做但直到十天前才愿意做的事情。” “我希望这种行动速度不会以牺牲起诉书的质量为代价，而且这些不是旧政权内部的个人恩怨。”

paras.en: Allegations of vote-buying and high-level corruption
paras.zh: 收买选票和高层腐败的指控

paras.en: Prosecutors have also launched a series of investigations into suspected electoral manipulation, corruption and abuse of public office.
paras.zh: 检察官还对涉嫌操纵选举、腐败和滥用公职的行为展开了一系列调查。

paras.en: Four people were arrested on suspicion of vote-buying in Novi Sad. Six others were detained in Mali Zvornik on suspicion of helping citizens from Bosnia and Herzegovina register their residence in Serbia so they could vote.
paras.zh: 四人因涉嫌在诺维萨德贿选而被捕。另外六人因涉嫌帮助波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那公民在塞尔维亚登记居住地以便投票而在马里兹沃尔尼克被拘留。

paras.en: One of the most high-profile cases is the arrest of Davor Macura, the owner of Alta Bank, who is suspected of illegally accessing the bank's vault and removing the equivalent of about €383 million ($430 million).
paras.zh: 最引人注目的案件之一是阿尔塔银行老板达沃·马库拉（Davor Macura）被捕，他涉嫌非法进入该银行的金库并挪走约 3.83 亿欧元（4.3 亿美元）的等值资金。

paras.en: His arrest came just days after the National Bank of Serbia revoked Alta Bank's license and initiated bankruptcy proceedings. Macura has been publicly associated with the SNS, while his bank had significant business dealings with the state and a large number of Russian clients.
paras.zh: 就在他被捕的几天前，塞尔维亚国家银行吊销了阿尔塔银行的执照并启动了破产程序。马库拉一直与 SNS 公开联系，而他的银行与国家和大量俄罗斯客户有重要的业务往来。

paras.en: Senior police officials, the head of the Republic Hydrometeorological Institute and several managers of public companies have also been arrested over suspected abuses of office and rigged public procurement procedures.
paras.zh: 高级警官、共和国水文气象研究所所长和几名上市公司经理也因涉嫌滥用职权和操纵公共采购程序而被捕。

paras.en: Students and representatives of the new political majority are demanding investigations into corruption cases that have remained unresolved for years.
paras.zh: 学生和新政治多数派的代表要求对多年来悬而未决的腐败案件进行调查。

paras.en: Their message is that no one should be above the law and that prosecutors and courts must do their jobs — or be held accountable for failing to act.
paras.zh: 他们传达的信息是，任何人都不应凌驾于法律之上，检察官和法院必须履行职责，否则将因不采取行动而承担责任。

paras.en: "When you want the rule of law and when you want something to be done, it is possible. Our regulations allow for it. But it was obvious that there were people obstructing the entire system, putting cases in drawers and leaving them unresolved," Tanja Arsic, an incoming MP from the Students' List, told DW.
paras.zh: “当你想要法治，当你想要做某事时，这是可能的。我们的法规允许这样做。但很明显，有人阻碍整个系统，将案件放在抽屉里，让它们悬而未决，”即将上任的学生名单议员塔尼娅·阿尔西克(Tanja Arsic)告诉德国之声。

paras.en: In the days after the election, however, reports and video footage emerged that suggested official documents may have been removed or destroyed in state institutions and public companies.
paras.zh: 然而，在选举后的几天里，有报道和视频片段显示，国家机构和上市公司的官方文件可能已被删除或销毁。

paras.en: On October 29, Prosecutor General Zagorka Dolovac responded by issuing a binding instruction to all chief public prosecutors to prevent the destruction of official and other records.
paras.zh: 10 月 29 日，总检察长扎戈尔卡·多洛瓦茨做出回应​​，向所有首席检察官发出具有约束力的指示，以防止官方和其他记录被销毁。

paras.en: The Students' List also called on employees in state institutions and the media to report any destruction of documents to prevent what they called abuse by the outgoing authorities during the transition of power.
paras.zh: 学生名单还呼吁国家机构和媒体的雇员报告任何文件被销毁的情况，以防止即将卸任的当局在权力过渡期间滥用权力。

paras.en: Savovic points out that even an attempt to destroy official records is punishable by law.
paras.zh: 萨沃维奇指出，即使是试图销毁官方记录也会受到法律惩罚。

paras.en: But will the institutions really investigate those who were once at the very top of Serbia's political power structures?
paras.zh: 但这些机构真的会调查那些曾经处于塞尔维亚政治权力结构最高层的人吗？

paras.en: Former President Aleksandar Vucic said he is not afraid of being arrested and that no evidence of financial wrongdoing will be found against him.
paras.zh: 前总统亚历山大·武契奇表示，他并不害怕被捕，也不会发现任何针对他的财务不当行为的证据。

paras.en: "I don't sign or do anything when it comes to money, and nothing can be found in that regard," he said.
paras.zh: “当涉及到金钱时，我不会签署或做任何事情，在这方面也找不到任何东西，”他说。

paras.en: But accountability is not just about who signed a document. It is also about establishing who made the decisions, who gave the orders and who wielded the real power to influence the deals now under investigation.
paras.zh: 但责任不仅仅在于谁签署了文件。它还涉及确定谁做出决定、谁下达命令以及谁掌握影响目前正在调查的交易的实际权力。

paras.en: "It would be tragic if the biggest players, whose arrests are expected, were prosecuted without sufficient evidence. Or if they were charged with something far less serious than what they actually did," said Tanja Arsic.
paras.zh: 塔尼娅·阿尔西克说：“如果最大的参与者（预计将被逮捕）在没有足够证据的情况下受到起诉，或者如果他们被指控的罪名远没有他们实际所做的那么严重，那将是一场悲剧。”

paras.en: Bojana Savovic makes a point of saying that ultimately, the success of the prosecution service won't be measured by the number of politically popular or populist arrests that are made, but by final convictions and the permanent confiscation of assets acquired through crime.
paras.zh: 博亚娜·萨沃维奇 (Bojana Savovic) 强调，最终，检察机关的成功不会以政治上受欢迎或民粹主义逮捕的数量来衡量，而是以最终定罪和永久没收通过犯罪获得的资产来衡量。

paras.en: Arsic agrees and warns that conducting high-quality investigations and gathering robust evidence must take precedence over speed.
paras.zh: Arsic 同意并警告说，进行高质量的调查和收集强有力的证据必须优先于速度。

paras.en: "The prosecution must not bring indictments if there is not enough evidence. That would be disastrous," she said. "If things are rushed just to achieve a result, only for the cases to end in acquittals because the prosecution failed to prove the charges against people who were at the top of the government — that would be even more disastrous."
paras.zh: “如果没有足够的证据，检方不得提出起诉。那将是灾难性的，”她说。 “如果只是为了取得结果而仓促行事，结果却因为检方未能证明对政府高层的指控而导致案件以无罪释放——那将是更加灾难性的。”

paras.en: But will that be possible within the existing structures? Savovic is not convinced that it will.
paras.zh: 但这在现有结构内可能吗？萨沃维奇并不相信它会。

paras.en: "For decades, people whose only qualification was blind obedience, reading the political climate and self-censorship were promoted in the prosecution service and the courts. Without fundamental changes in the judiciary, the police and the security structures, I see no possibility of a substantial and lasting transformation of society," she said.
paras.zh: “几十年来，那些唯一资格就是盲目服从、了解政治气候和自我审查的人在检察机关和法院得到提拔。如果司法、警察和安全结构没有根本性的改变，我认为社会不可能发生实质性和持久的转变，”她说。

paras.en: The real test will come in the courtroom. The verdicts in these cases will show whether Serbia is finally breaking with its old system of power or merely replacing one set of power brokers with another.
paras.zh: 真正的考验将在法庭上进行。这些案件的判决将表明塞尔维亚是否最终打破了其旧的权力体系，或者只是用另一组权力掮客取代了一组权力掮客。

articles.title: Will US midterm election results spare Gulf states from further war?

paras.en: After his party's resounding defeat in the US midterm elections this week, President Donald Trump conceded that the war with Iran had likely played a part.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统在其政党本周在美国中期选举中惨败后承认，与伊朗的战争可能是其中的一个原因。

paras.en: "I think a part of it was Iran, but, at the same time, people understood the importance of what I've done with Iran," Trump told Fox News, conceding that US voters were unwilling to accept the impact of the war on gas prices.
paras.zh: 特朗普对福克斯新闻表示：“我认为其中一部分原因是伊朗，但与此同时，人们理解我对伊朗所做的事情的重要性。”他承认美国选民不愿意接受战争对天然气价格的影响。

paras.en: Observers say the United States and Israel had been holding off on major attacks on Iran until after both had held elections.
paras.zh: 观察人士称，美国和以色列一直推迟对伊朗发动重大袭击，直到两国举行选举之后。

paras.en: At the end of October, the Wall Street Journal reported that the Trump administration was already warning Gulf state governments to brace for a short, intense military campaign after the midterms.
paras.zh: 10月底，《华尔街日报》报道称，特朗普政府已警告海湾国家政府做好中期选举后短暂而激烈的军事行动的准备。

paras.en: While foreign policy is a US president's purview, analysts have pointed out that a Congress controlled by the Democratic party could ostensibly withhold funding for Trump's military expeditions. However newly-elected Democratic politicians won't take their seats until early next year.
paras.zh: 虽然外交政策是美国总统的职权范围，但分析人士指出，民主党控制的国会表面上可能会扣留特朗普军事远征的资金。然而，新当选的民主党政客要到明年初才会就任。

paras.en: As two US professors of political science wrote for Foreign Affairs magazine this week, past American presidents, like Trump, who become "lame ducks" — that is, a president who loses control of Congress and can't run for another term — have often ramped up international interventions.
paras.zh: 正如两位美国政治学教授本周在《外交事务》杂志上撰文，过去的美国总统，比如特朗普，成为“跛脚鸭”——即失去国会控制权、无法连任的总统——往往会加大国际干预力度。

paras.en: "As they think about their legacy, lame ducks often turn to foreign policy, where the power of the presidency allows them to act unfettered by pesky domestic politics," they explained. And one of the places where Trump is most likely to act is Iran, the professors argued.
paras.zh: 他们解释说：“当他们思考自己的遗产时，跛脚鸭经常转向外交政策，总统职位的权力使他们能够不受讨厌的国内政治的束缚。”教授们认为，特朗普最有可能采取行动的地方之一是伊朗。

paras.en: On the other hand, Trump also told several media outlets that he was in "no rush" to start bombing Iran again.
paras.zh: 另一方面，特朗普还对多家媒体表示，他“并不急于”再次开始轰炸伊朗。

paras.en: Opinions on Iran's next moves are also divided.
paras.zh: 对于伊朗下一步行动的看法也存在分歧。

paras.en: The Iranians have said they're ready for any attack and rhetoric from senior leaders indicates they may be willing to strike a wider range of targets than previously. That could include regional energy and economic infrastructure and even undersea telecommunications cabling or data centers.
paras.zh: 伊朗人表示，他们已做好应对任何袭击的准备，高级领导人的言论表明，他们可能愿意打击比以前更广泛的目标。这可能包括区域能源和经济基础设施，甚至海底电信电缆或数据中心。

paras.en: If Iran thinks there is an existential threat to its leadership, then "all bets are off," Ross Harrison, a senior fellow at the Washington-based Middle East Institute, or MEI, and an expert on Iran, said during a virtual briefing hosted by MEI this week. "I think they will target differently in the Gulf states [this time] … so it really depends on how all this unfolds."
paras.zh: 总部位于华盛顿的中东研究所 (MEI) 高级研究员、伊朗问题专家罗斯·哈里森 (Ross Harrison) 在本周由 MEI 主办的虚拟简报会上表示，如果伊朗认为其领导层面临生存威胁，那么“所有赌注都将落空”。 “我认为（这次）他们在海湾国家的目标会有所不同……所以这实际上取决于这一切如何展开。”

paras.en: But other experts believe Iran was deliberately holding out to pressure Trump before the midterms. Now the election is over, the Iranians may be more willing to negotiate a peace deal.
paras.zh: 但其他专家认为，伊朗故意在中期选举前向特朗普施压。现在选举已经结束，伊朗人可能更愿意谈判达成和平协议。

paras.en: All this leaves the Gulf states, who have been the main targets of Iranian attacks since the conflict began, in a difficult position.
paras.zh: 所有这些都让海湾国家陷入了困境，这些国家自冲突开始以来一直是伊朗袭击的主要目标。

paras.en: "We find ourselves drawn within a crisis that we worked diplomatically very hard to try to avert," Anwar Gargash, a foreign policy adviser to United Arab Emirates leadership, said at a security conference in Bahrain last weekend, the Manama Dialogue hosted by the International Institute for Strategic Studies, or IISS. "We are clearly seeking a political off-ramp."
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国领导人的外交政策顾问安瓦尔·加尔加什上周末在巴林举行的由国际战略研究所（IISS）主办的麦纳麦对话安全会议上表示：“我们发现自己陷入了一场危机，我们在外交上非常努力地试图避免这场危机。” “我们显然正在寻求政治出口。”

paras.en: Qatar has been trying to negotiate between the US and Iran but has also been conducting emergency drills at its airport. The Emiratis have been doing similar drills. And Saudi Arabia is looking at a war on two fronts: The oil-rich state is already under attack from the Houthi militia in neighboring Yemen. Even Egypt has reacted, reportedly strengthening air defenses around the Suez Canal.
paras.zh: 卡塔尔一直试图在美国和伊朗之间进行谈判，但也一直在其机场进行紧急演习。阿联酋人一直在进行类似的演习。沙特阿拉伯正在考虑两线战争：这个石油资源丰富的国家已经受到邻国也门胡塞民兵的攻击。甚至埃及也做出了反应，据报道加强了苏伊士运河周围的防空。

paras.en: Still, no matter what happens next, the US-Israel-Iran war has already made Gulf states evaluate defense partnerships with the US. Rather than making them safe, US bases have made them a target.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，无论接下来发生什么，美以伊战争已经让海湾国家评估与美国的防务伙伴关系。美国基地非但没有保证他们的安全，反而让他们成为攻击目标。

paras.en: "There is widespread disappointment across the region with the US over the folly of the war, the erratic nature of Washington's military and diplomatic conduct, and its decision to prioritize Israel's defense over that of its Gulf partners," Hasan Alhasan, a senior fellow at the IISS, told news agency Bloomberg this week. "If the US liberation of Kuwait in 1991 was the moment that established America's role in the region, the 2026 war may be remembered as the moment that undid it."
paras.zh: 国际战略研究所高级研究员哈桑·阿尔哈桑本周对彭博社表示：“整个地区对美国普遍感到失望，因为这场战争是愚蠢的，华盛顿的军事和外交行为反复无常，而且美国决定优先考虑以色列的防务而不是海湾伙伴的防务。” “如果说 1991 年美国解放科威特是确立美国在该地区角色的时刻，那么 2026 年的战争可能会被人们铭记为摧毁美国角色的时刻。”

paras.en: Gulf states are widening their outreach with, for example, the UAE getting closer to Israel and the Saudis entering the Mecca defense pact with Pakistan and Turkey.
paras.zh: 海湾国家正在扩大其影响力，例如，阿联酋与以色列走得更近，沙特与巴基斯坦和土耳其签署了麦加防御协议。

paras.en: "The Gulf states have already moved toward strategic autonomy and self-reliance," Andreas Krieg, a senior lecturer at the School of Security Studies at King's College London, wrote for online outlet Middle East Eye this week. "A lame-duck Trump will speed that process."
paras.zh: “海湾国家已经走向战略自治和自力更生，”伦敦国王学院安全研究学院高级讲师安德烈亚斯·克里格本周在在线媒体《中东之眼》上写道。 “跛脚鸭特朗普将加速这一进程。”

paras.en: That's even though a Democrat-led Congress might make the US a slightly more reliable partner again.
paras.zh: 尽管民主党领导的国会可能会让美国再次成为稍微更可靠的合作伙伴。

paras.en: Krieg argues that Gulf states should come together to pressure the US not to attack Iran and then negotiate a non-aggression pact with Iran — without US involvement.
paras.zh: 克里格认为，海湾国家应该联合起来向美国施压，要求其不要攻击伊朗，然后在美国不参与的情况下与伊朗谈判一项互不侵犯条约。

paras.en: Whether that kind of unity is possible in the Gulf is dubious, Ryan Crocker, a former US ambassador to the region and distinguished fellow with MEI, replied to a question from DW during the MEI's online briefing.
paras.zh: 美国前驻该地区大使、MEI 杰出研究员瑞安·克罗克 (Ryan Crocker) 在 MEI 的在线吹风会上回答了德国之声的提问，这种团结在海湾地区是否可能实现尚存疑问。

paras.en: "I'm afraid that meaningful Gulf unity is not coming to a theater near us anytime soon," Crocker said. The Qataris remain untrusting because of how other Gulf states acted against them in 2017. And, he added, "there are well known differences between Saudi Arabia and the UAE we see in Sudan [and] in Yemen, and, of course, the profound differences … on relations with Israel. So I would not expect any meaningful moves toward [Gulf] security cooperation."
paras.zh: 克罗克说：“我担心，有意义的海湾团结不会很快出现在我们附近的剧院。”由于其他海湾国家在 2017 年对他们采取的行动，卡塔尔人仍然不信任他们。他补充说，“我们在苏丹和也门看到沙特阿拉伯和阿联酋之间存在众所周知的分歧，当然，在与以色列的关系上也存在深刻的分歧。因此，我不期望在[海湾]安全合作方面采取任何有意义的举措。”

paras.en: What's more likely in the long term is Gulf states eventually coming to some kind of understanding with Iran.
paras.zh: 从长远来看，更有可能的是海湾国家最终与伊朗达成某种谅解。

paras.en: "The Gulf states understand that they probably can't buy their security only from Washington, and that they're going to have to buy it, to some degree, by some kind of a relationship with Tehran," the MEI's Harrison added. "It's inevitable. Geography reigns."
paras.zh: “海湾国家明白，他们可能无法仅从华盛顿那里购买安全，他们必须在某种程度上通过与德黑兰的某种关系来购买安全，”MEI 的哈里森补充道。 “这是不可避免的。地理占主导地位。”

paras.en: What that sort of non-aggression pact looks like remains to be seen, he added. That's why one of the big concerns for Gulf leaders now, is the conflict escalating again to a point where the path back to some sort of diplomacy is lost, Harrison concluded.
paras.zh: 他补充说，这种互不侵犯条约是什么样子还有待观察。哈里森总结道，这就是为什么海湾领导人现在最关心的问题之一是冲突再次升级，以至于失去了某种外交途径。

articles.title: Division among US Democrats over Schumer’s leadership role

paras.en: After Democrats delivered a once-in-a-generation midterm thumping of Republicans in the United States midterms, their current leader, Chuck Schumer, has expressed confidence he will helm his party’s larger-than-expected majority in the US Senate.
paras.zh: 民主党在美国中期选举中对共和党进行了一代人一次的重击，现任领导人查克·舒默表示有信心他将领导该党在美国参议院获得超出预期的多数席位。

paras.en: “I’ll be re-elected as majority leader,” the New York Democrat told reporters in Washington on Wednesday.
paras.zh: “我将再次当选为多数党领袖，”这位纽约民主党人周三在华盛顿对记者说。

paras.en: But as calls for change reached a fever pitch among voters in this week’s pivotal elections, not every newly elected Senate Democrat is open to the idea of having Schumer, a 75-year-old stalwart of the chamber, reprise his role as the head of their agenda.
paras.zh: 但随着本周关键选举中选民对变革的呼声越来越高涨，并不是所有新当选的参议院民主党人都愿意让 75 岁的参议院坚定支持者舒默重新担任议程负责人。

paras.en: At least seven incoming Democratic freshmen have publicly suggested – or said outright – they will not commit to supporting Schumer in next month’s leadership vote:
paras.zh: 至少七名即将上任的民主党新人公开暗示（或直言不讳），他们不会承诺在下个月的领导投票中支持舒默：

paras.en: - Illinois Senator-elect Juliana Stratton, through a spokesperson, said she will not support Schumer.
paras.zh: - 伊利诺伊州当选参议员朱莉安娜·斯特拉顿通过发言人表示，她不会支持舒默。

paras.en: - Kansas Senator-elect Adam Hamilton told CNN in September: “I’m not supporting Schumer”.
paras.zh: - 堪萨斯州当选参议员亚当·汉密尔顿 (Adam Hamilton) 9 月份告诉 CNN：“我不支持舒默”。

paras.en: - Maine Senator-elect Troy Jackson said on Monday he told Schumer he will “support somebody else”.
paras.zh: - 缅因州当选参议员特洛伊·杰克逊周一表示，他告诉舒默他将“支持其他人”。

paras.en: - Michigan Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed reiterated in an interview with CNN on Thursday that he will support his soon-to-be Democratic colleague, Senator Chris Van Hollen of Maryland, as leader.
paras.zh: - 密歇根州当选参议员阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德周四在接受美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 采访时重申，他将支持即将成为民主党同事、马里兰州参议员克里斯·范·霍伦 (Chris Van Hollen) 担任领导人。

paras.en: - Minnesota Senator-elect Peggy Flanagan told reporters on Wednesday, “It is time for new leadership”.
paras.zh: - 明尼苏达州当选参议员佩吉·弗拉纳根周三告诉记者，“现在是新领导层的时候了”。

paras.en: - New Hampshire Senator-elect Chris Pappas said in an interview last week that “voters are hungry for … a new generation of leadership in the Senate”.
paras.zh: - 新罕布什尔州当选参议员克里斯·帕帕斯上周在接受采访时表示，“选民渴望……参议院新一代领导层”。

paras.en: - Texas Senator-elect James Talarico has called for “new blood” in Washington, and since being elected, has indicated he wanted to “hear about [Schumer’s] vision” for the Senate before committing to back him.
paras.zh: - 德克萨斯州当选参议员詹姆斯·塔拉里科呼吁华盛顿注入“新鲜血液”，自当选以来，他表示希望在承诺支持他之前“听取[舒默]对参议院的愿景”。

paras.en: Jackson has openly questioned Schumer’s ability to connect with working-class voters, while Flanagan’s staff has said the senator-elect wants “a progressive champion” who will shepherd Democrats through the final two years of Donald Trump’s presidency and into 2028.
paras.zh: 杰克逊公开质疑舒默与工薪阶层选民建立联系的能力，而弗拉纳根的工作人员则表示，这位当选参议员想要一位“进步的拥护者”，他将带领民主党度过唐纳德·特朗普总统任期的最后两年直至 2028 年。

paras.en: New members, like El-Sayed, may not be won over after Schumer backed the former public health official’s opponent, Haley Stevens, in Michigan’s Democratic primary.
paras.zh: 在舒默在密歇根州民主党初选中支持前公共卫生官员的对手海莉·史蒂文斯后，像埃尔·赛义德这样的新成员可能不会被赢得。

paras.en: Schumer, the first Jewish Senate leader, has often found himself at the centre of brewing cultural and foreign-policy debates within his party.
paras.zh: 舒默是第一位犹太参议院领袖，他经常发现自己处于党内酝酿文化和外交政策辩论的中心。

paras.en: In remarks that were posted online in February, Schumer told Jewish leaders in New York City one of his core duties was “to fight for aid to Israel”.
paras.zh: 在二月份发布在网上的言论中，舒默告诉纽约市的犹太领导人，他的核心职责之一是“为对以色列的援助而奋斗”。

paras.en: “We delivered more security assistance to Israel, our ally, under my leadership than ever, ever before”, he said. “We will keep doing that.”
paras.zh: 他说：“在我的领导下，我们向我们的盟友以色列提供了比以往更多的安全援助。” “我们将继续这样做。”

paras.en: Schumer has also faced fierce criticism for not doing enough to block Trump’s cabinet members from being confirmed. Some have even chastised the leader for retreating during last year’s government shutdown after he backed a Republican bill to reopen federal agencies without getting anything in return.
paras.zh: 舒默还因没有采取足够措施阻止特朗普内阁成员得到确认而面临激烈批评。一些人甚至批评这位领导人在去年政府关门期间撤退，此前他支持共和党重新开放联邦机构的法案，但没有得到任何回报。

paras.en: Critics in his party, including California Governor Gavin Newsom, called that a “capitulation” that abandoned key Democratic priorities, like healthcare subsidies. Michigan Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib said Schumer should have stepped down as leader over the matter.
paras.zh: 包括加州州长加文·纽瑟姆在内的党内批评人士称，这是放弃了医疗补贴等民主党关键优先事项的“投降”。密歇根州国会女议员拉什达·特莱布表示，舒默应该辞去此事的领导人职务。

paras.en: The Democratic leader said on Wednesday the party’s new Senate plan would include launching investigations into the Trump administration, challenging the president’s agenda and ending his war in Iran.
paras.zh: 这位民主党领袖周三表示，该党的新参议院计划将包括对特朗普政府展开调查、挑战总统的议程以及结束他在伊朗的战争。

paras.en: However, that’s not good enough for some current members, like Van Hollen, who recently told Bloomberg that Democrats should not commit to Schumer without promises of a “bold agenda”.
paras.zh: 然而，这对一些现任成员来说还不够好，比如范霍伦，他最近告诉彭博社，如果没有“大胆议程”的承诺，民主党不应该向舒默做出承诺。

paras.en: Before Tuesday’s election, a senior campaign staff member for Senator Jon Ossoff, who was easily re-elected to his seat, would not say whether the Georgia Democrat would back Schumer.
paras.zh: 在周二的选举之前，轻松连任的参议员乔恩·奥索夫的一名高级竞选工作人员没有透露这位佐治亚州民主党人是否会支持舒默。

paras.en: “I do not have an answer,” the Ossoff source told Al Jazeera. “We can do all the fantasy football stuff later.”
paras.zh: “我没有答案，”奥索夫消息人士告诉半岛电视台。 “我们可以稍后再做所有梦幻足球的事情。”

paras.en: When Democratic lawmakers return to Washington next week, voters and Democratic-aligned groups will likely pressure them to support an alternative candidate.
paras.zh: 当民主党议员下周返回华盛顿时，选民和民主党阵营可能会向他们施压，要求他们支持另一位候选人。

paras.en: After calling for new leadership after the election, Indivisible, a progressive US-based organisation that bills itself as a movement “to stop the rise of authoritarianism”, released a memo on Thursday detailing their opposition to Schumer.
paras.zh: 总部位于美国的进步组织 Indivisible 在呼吁选举后建立新的领导层后，将自己标榜为“阻止威权主义崛起”的运动，周四发布了一份备忘录，详细说明了他们对舒默的反对。

paras.en: “Everyone with a Democratic senator – including those with newly-elected senators on their way to DC – should be demanding a contested leadership election, not a cleared field for Schumer”, the memo read.
paras.zh: 备忘录中写道：“每个拥有民主党参议员的人——包括那些正在前往华盛顿的新当选参议员的人——都应该要求进行有争议的领导选举，而不是为舒默腾出空间。”

paras.en: “Any Democrat who is considering business as usual, or unwilling to fight at a level that matches the public’s demand for action – is not qualified to lead the party at this moment. Who leads the party in this era must be an open question, not a coronation. It’s time to define what the next era of the Democratic Party will be.”
paras.zh: “任何考虑一切如常，或不愿意在符合公众行动要求的水平上进行斗争的民主党人，都没有资格在此时领导该党。谁在这个时代领导该党必须是一个悬而未决的问题，而不是加冕。是时候定义民主党的下一个时代将是什么了。”

paras.en: Al Jazeera asked Schumer’s office how he plans to address those concerns and whether he is speaking with frustrated Democrats, but it has not yet responded.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台询问舒默办公室，他计划如何解决这些担忧，以及他是否正在与沮丧的民主党人交谈，但尚未做出回应。

paras.en: To be re-elected, Schumer needs a simple majority of the Democratic Senate caucus, projected to comprise 54-56 members, and Schumer, who previously served as majority leader during the duration of former President Biden’s term in office, still has allies he can count on.
paras.zh: 要连任，舒默需要获得民主党参议院核心小组的简单多数席位，预计将由 54-56 名成员组成，而此前在前总统拜登任职期间担任多数党领袖的舒默仍然拥有可以依靠的盟友。

paras.en: One of those is Democratic Senator Cory Booker of New Jersey, who told ABC on Wednesday that he commended Schumer’s handling of the midterms, saying he delivered “one of the most historic sweeps” for the party.
paras.zh: 其中之一是新泽西州的民主党参议员科里·布克，他周三对美国广播公司表示，他赞扬舒默对中期选举的处理方式，称他为该党带来了“最具历史意义的横扫之一”。

paras.en: “We’re gonna have a family discussion,” Booker said. “But I think America should give … Chuck Schumer his due for what we were able to achieve.”
paras.zh: “我们要进行一次家庭讨论，”布克说。 “但我认为美国应该为我们所取得的成就给予……查克·舒默应有的回报。”

paras.en: When asked Wednesday about building criticism of his leadership, Schumer demurred, saying Tuesday’s elections were “not about” him.
paras.zh: 当周三被问及是否会批评他的领导力时，舒默表示反对，称周二的选举“与他无关”。

paras.en: “This is about the American people and what they want and what they need and what we can do to help them. Plain and simple”.
paras.zh: “这关系到美国人民以及他们想要什么、需要什么以及我们可以做些什么来帮助他们。简单明了”。

articles.title: Melania Trump calls for peace at meeting with Russia, Ukraine officials

paras.en: United States First Lady Melania Trump has urged Russia and Ukraine to build on a recent localised ceasefire and seek a more “enduring” peace, as she hosted officials from both countries at the White House.
paras.zh: 美国第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普在白宫接待两国官员时敦促俄罗斯和乌克兰在最近达成的局部停火基础上寻求更“持久”的和平。

paras.en: Melania Trump spoke on Thursday at an event that the White House said is believed to be “the first time in American history that a First Lady has personally brought representatives of two nations at war to the White House for diplomacy”.
paras.zh: 梅拉尼娅·特朗普周四在一次活动上发表讲话，白宫称该活动被认为是“美国历史上第一次第一夫人亲自将两个交战国家的代表带到白宫进行外交”。

paras.en: Those attending included Kirill Dmitriev, a special envoy of Russian President Vladimir Putin; Yana Lantratova, Russia’s human rights commissioner; David Arakhamia, leader of the Servant of the People party in Ukraine’s parliament; and Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine’s parliamentary human rights commissioner.
paras.zh: 出席者包括俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的特使基里尔·德米特里耶夫；亚娜·兰特拉托娃 (Yana Lantratova)，俄罗斯人权专员；乌克兰议会人民公仆党领袖戴维·阿拉卡米亚（David Arakhamia）；以及乌克兰议会人权专员德米特罗·鲁宾涅茨(Dmytro Lubinets)。

paras.en: “Together, we can create something more enduring than a temporary ceasefire,” Mrs. Trump said, urging both sides to see the humanitarian truce in Oleshky “as a spark in a world of darkness”.
paras.zh: 特朗普夫人说：“我们可以共同创造比暂时停火更持久的东西。”她敦促双方将奥列什基的人道主义休战视为“黑暗世界中的火花”。

paras.en: She said her role as “exclusive intermediary” was set out in written agreements signed by both countries, and that she was involved in every stage of the planning, including reviewing de-mining plans and evacuation routes.
paras.zh: 她说，两国签署的书面协议规定了她作为“独家中间人”的角色，她参与了规划的每个阶段，包括审查排雷计划和疏散路线。

paras.en: Ukrainian representatives presented the US first lady with the Order of Princess Olga, first class, which President Volodymyr Zelenskyy awarded her earlier this week. She also gave the most senior officials present letters she had written to Putin and Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 乌克兰代表向美国第一夫人颁发了一级奥尔加公主勋章，该勋章是总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基本周早些时候授予她的。她还将她写给普京和泽伦斯基的信交给了最高级别的官员。

paras.en: The six-day truce covered the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky in Ukraine’s Kherson region and the surrounding area, and allowed aid deliveries and the evacuation of nearly 800 people.
paras.zh: 为期六天的休战覆盖了乌克兰赫尔松地区俄罗斯占领的奥列什基市及周边地区，并允许运送援助物资并疏散近 800 人。

paras.en: An estimated 2,000 civilians had been left in the city. It was the longest multi-day truce between Russia and Ukraine since Russia launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022, and the first joint relief operation in four years and eight months.
paras.zh: 估计有 2,000 名平民留在该市。这是自2022年2月俄罗斯发动全面入侵以来，俄罗斯和乌克兰之间最长的多日休战，也是四年零八个月以来的首次联合救援行动。

paras.en: The White House said Melania Trump mediated the truce, though Pope Leo XIV also pressed both sides to allow aid and evacuations, and that the two accounts of who brokered it have diverged.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，梅拉尼娅·特朗普调解了停火协议，尽管教皇利奥十四世也向双方施压，允许援助和撤离，而且对于谁促成停火协议的两个说法存在分歧。

paras.en: The truce expired last Sunday with no extension, a day before a Russian bombing of an aid distribution point in Komyshuvakha, in the Zaporizhia region, killed at least 40 people, according to Ukrainian President Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，停战协议于上周日到期，且没有延期，就在前一天，俄罗斯对扎波罗热地区科梅舒瓦哈的一个援助分发点进行了轰炸，造成至少 40 人死亡。

paras.en: New US-brokered talks between Russia and Ukraine are expected to take place in Abu Dhabi on November 10 and 11.
paras.zh: 在美国的斡旋下，俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的新会谈预计将于 11 月 10 日至 11 日在阿布扎比举行。

articles.title: Top US civil rights official resigns

paras.en: As President Donald Trump’s administration prepares for a flurry of congressional investigations into shootings by immigration agents and the Jeffrey Epstein files, the top official in charge of the United States Department of Justice’s civil rights division has resigned.
paras.zh: 当唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府准备对移民特工枪击事件和杰弗里·爱泼斯坦档案进行一系列国会调查时，负责美国司法部民权部门的高级官员已经辞职。

paras.en: US Attorney General Todd Blanche on Thursday confirmed Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon’s departure in a post on social media.
paras.zh: 美国司法部长托德·布兰奇周四在社交媒体上发帖证实了助理司法部长哈米特·迪隆的离职。

paras.en: “Today, I accepted the resignation of Assistant Attorney General Harmeet Dhillon,” Blanche wrote on X. “She has defended the civil liberties of every American and enforced the law without fear or favor.”
paras.zh: 布兰奇在 X 上写道：“今天，我接受了助理司法部长哈米特·迪隆的辞职。她捍卫了每个美国人的公民自由，并毫无恐惧或偏袒地执行法律。”

paras.en: A top Trump ally, Dhillon was confirmed to her role in April 2025 and has overseen a dramatic overhaul of the Justice Department’s civil rights division, which is tasked with enforcing anti-discrimination laws. Hundreds of former Justice Department officials penned a letter last December decrying the “destruction” of the agency division under Trump.
paras.zh: 作为特朗普的高级盟友，迪隆于 2025 年 4 月被确认就职，并监督了司法部民权部门的重大改革，该部门的任务是执行反歧视法。去年12月，数百名前司法部官员写了一封信，谴责特朗普领导下的司法部部门的“破坏”。

paras.en: Dhillon is the first high-ranking official to resign from the Trump administration since US Democrats swept both chambers of the US Congress in the country’s pivotal midterm elections on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 迪隆是自周二美国民主党在美国关键的中期选举中横扫美国国会参众两院以来第一位从特朗普政府辞职的高级官员。

paras.en: Democratic congressman Robert Garcia, who will likely become the new chair of the powerful House of Representatives Committee on Oversight and Accountability, pledged on Wednesday to take on four major investigations, including abuses of power by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents and the Epstein files.
paras.zh: 民主党国会议员罗伯特·加西亚（ Robert Garcia ）可能成为强大的众议院监督和问责委员会的新任主席，他周三承诺将进行四项重大调查，包括移民和海关执法局（ ICE ）特工滥用权力和爱泼斯坦档案。

paras.en: Dhillon reportedly told her staff earlier this year that her office, which has typically been charged with investigating law enforcement killings by police officers, would not be looking into the fatal shootings of two US citizens – Renee Good and Alex Pretti – who were gunned down by ICE agents in Minneapolis.
paras.zh: 据报道，迪隆今年早些时候告诉她的工作人员，她的办公室通常负责调查警察的执法杀戮行为，不会调查两名美国公民蕾妮·古德和亚历克斯·普雷蒂在明尼阿波利斯被 ICE 特工枪杀的致命枪击事件。

paras.en: In May, Garcia accused the administration of continuing to shield Trump from scrutiny related to unreleased documents tied to the Epstein investigation
paras.zh: 五月，加西亚指责政府继续保护特朗普免受与爱泼斯坦调查有关的未公开文件的审查

paras.en: During a closed-door hearing in which Blanche’s predecessor, Pam Bondi, was asked by lawmakers about the case, the California Democrat Garcia alleged Dhillon repeatedly intervened to block questions about the president’s connection to the release of the files.
paras.zh: 在一次闭门听证会上，立法者向布兰奇的前任帕姆·邦迪询问了此案，加利福尼亚州民主党人加西亚声称，迪隆多次介入，以阻止有关总统与文件发布之间关系的问题。

paras.en: The Justice Department referred Al Jazeera to Blanche’s social media post when asked when Dhillon submitted her resignation. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 当被问及迪隆何时提交辞呈时，司法部向半岛电视台推荐了布兰奇的社交媒体帖子。白宫没有立即回应置评请求。

articles.title: What's next for Democrats after the midterms. And, a look at the outstanding races
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: What's next for Democrats after the midterms. And, a look at the outstanding races
paras.zh: 中期选举后，民主党接下来会做什么。并且，看看精彩的比赛

paras.en: Democrats won this week in districts and states that President Trump carried by double digits just two years ago. The party now has its largest Senate majority since the passing of the Affordable Care Act during Obama's early presidency. Senate results from Alaska and Mississippi are still pending. If those races favor Democrats, their majority could grow to 54, plus the two independents who caucus with them.
paras.zh: 民主党本周在特朗普总统两年前以两位数领先的地区和州获胜。该党现在拥有自奥巴马执政初期通过《平价医疗法案》以来最大的参议院多数席位。阿拉斯加州和密西西比州的参议院结果仍在等待中。如果这些竞选对民主党有利，加上与他们一起组成党团会议的两名独立人士，民主党的多数席位可能会增加到 54 个。

paras.en: - 🎧 A few tight House races remain uncalled, but the swing toward Democrats already rivals the post-Nixon Watergate backlash, NPR's Tamara Keith tells Up First. She highlights two notable race surprises that happened this week. One was in Nevada's 2nd District, which has been Republican since the 1980s. Democrat Teresa Benitez-Thompson claimed victory overnight. The other was in Alabama's 2nd District, where Shomari Figures overcame redistricting that favored Trump by 14 points. Figures won by more than seven points.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的塔玛拉·基思 (Tamara Keith) 告诉《Up First》，一些激烈的众议院竞选仍未结束，但民主党的倾向已经可以与尼克松水门事件后的强烈反对相媲美。她强调了本周发生的两件值得注意的比赛惊喜。其中之一位于内华达州第二选区，该选区自 20 世纪 80 年代以来一直属于共和党。民主党人特雷莎·贝尼特斯·汤普森一夜之间宣布获胜。另一个是阿拉巴马州第二选区，那里的 Shomari 数字以 14 个百分点的优势克服了对特朗普有利的选区重新划分。数字获胜超过七分。

paras.en: - ➡️ Mike Johnson plans to step down as top House Republican in the new Congress after a tough defeat for his party, according to a source familiar with his plans who was not authorized to discuss them publicly.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 据一位熟悉迈克·约翰逊计划的消息人士透露，迈克·约翰逊计划在新一届国会惨败后辞去众议院共和党领袖的职务，但该消息人士未获授权公开讨论这些计划。

paras.en: - ➡️ Voters in 39 states, Washington, D.C., and the Northern Mariana Islands decided on 146 ballot measures covering issues like taxes, transgender rights, traffic cameras and data centers. Here's a summary of the results.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 39 个州、华盛顿特区和北马里亚纳群岛的选民决定了 146 项投票措施，涵盖税收、跨性别权利、交通摄像头和数据中心等问题。以下是结果摘要。

paras.en: For more than a year, Democrats urged voters to elect them to lower costs and eliminate corruption. Now, the party must act to fulfill its campaign promise. The new Congress is unlikely to see much major legislation signed into law, but Democrats plan to launch ambitious investigations in the House and Senate. Democratic Party leaders and political analysts shared their insights with Morning Edition on the midterm election results, discussed the impacts of mid-decade redistricting efforts and outlined the party's next steps.
paras.zh: 一年多来，民主党一直敦促选民选举他们，以降低成本并消除腐败。现在，该党必须采取行动履行其竞选承诺。新国会不太可能看到太多重大立法签署成为法律，但民主党计划在众议院和参议院展开雄心勃勃的调查。民主党领导人和政治分析家在《晨报》上分享了他们对中期选举结果的见解，讨论了十年中期重新划分选区的努力的影响，并概述了该党的下一步行动。

paras.en: - 🎧 Most legislation still requires 60 votes to pass the Senate, and Trump has fluctuated between saying he will be Mr. Veto and expressing willingness to work with Democrats, NPR's Sam Gringlas says. Democrats are interested in restoring enhanced ACA health subsidies, reversing Medicaid cuts, asserting control over tariffs and pushing to end the war with Iran. Gringlas says this election has intensified pressure on Democrats. He points to a voter he met this summer, who said that if Democrats gained control, they would have to enact real changes, otherwise it wouldn't matter who they nominated for president in 2028.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的萨姆·格林格拉斯 (Sam Gringlas) 表示，大多数立法仍需要 60 票才能在参议院获得通过，而特朗普在表示自己将成为否决先生和表示愿意与民主党合作之间摇摆不定。民主党有兴趣恢复增强的《平价医疗法案》医疗补贴、扭转医疗补助削减、主张对关税的控制以及推动结束与伊朗的战争。格林格拉斯表示，这次选举加大了民主党的压力。他指出，今年夏天他遇到的一位选民表示，如果民主党获得控制权，他们就必须实施真正的变革，否则他们提名谁为 2028 年总统候选人并不重要。

paras.en: Trump focused on his East Wing ballroom construction project during his first public appearance after the Republicans lost the House and Senate. When asked about the election, he said he wasn't to blame for his party's losses.
paras.zh: 共和党失去众议院和参议院后，特朗普在首次公开露面时重点关注了他的东翼宴会厅建设项目。当被问及选举时，他说他不应该为党派的失利负责。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump quickly pointed out that he wasn't actually on the ballot, NPR's Emily Feng says. But he did urge voters to imagine he was. Voters associated his signature policies, like tariffs and the war in Iran, with rising inflation and gas prices. After Vice President JD Vance posted on social media yesterday suggesting that the war in Iran contributed to GOP losses, Trump somewhat agreed. The president cited its impact on pump prices, but doubled down on the war, saying he would act the same way again if he had to. With a Democratic Congress, Trump will encounter greater legislative gridlock, and Democrats could wield stricter funding controls on issues like immigration enforcement and the ongoing conflict in Iran, Feng says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的艾米丽·冯 (Emily Feng) 表示，特朗普很快指出，他实际上并未参加投票。但他确实敦促选民想象他是这样的。选民将关税和伊朗战争等标志性政策与通胀和天然气价格上涨联系在一起。副总统万斯昨天在社交媒体上发帖暗示伊朗战争导致了共和党的损失，特朗普对此表示同意。总统提到了它对汽油价格的影响，但对战争加倍强调，称如果有必要，他会再次采取同样的行动。冯说，在民主党控制的国会中，特朗普将遇到更大的立法僵局，民主党可能会在移民执法和伊朗持续冲突等问题上实施更严格的资金控制。

paras.en: - ➡️ A new Democratic majority could pressure Trump to end the war in Iran. But directly influencing fuel prices, which are tied to the complex international oil market, will be challenging.
paras.zh: - ➡️新的民主党多数派可能会迫使特朗普结束伊朗战争。但直接影响与复杂的国际石油市场相关的燃料价格将具有挑战性。

paras.en: Have you ever found yourself drowning in a sea of your own mail or other documents? Well, it is time to tackle that paper chaos. Don't panic. Kacy Paide, a professional organizer with more than 20 years of experience, has shared tips with Life Kit to make the task less overwhelming.
paras.zh: 您是否曾经发现自己淹没在自己的邮件或其他文件的海洋中？好吧，是时候解决纸张混乱的问题了。不要恐慌。 Kacy Paide 是一位拥有 20 多年经验的专业组织者，她与 Life Kit 分享了一些技巧，可以帮助您减轻这项任务的负担。

paras.en: - ✉️ Focus on your closest pile and separate it into active and inactive ones. Active items require follow-up, like calls or bill payments, while inactive items do not.
paras.zh: - ✉️ 专注于您最近的一堆，并将其分为活动和非活动的。活动项目需要跟进，例如通话或账单支付，而非活动项目则不需要。

paras.en: - ✉️ Clearly mark the due date on active documents with a bold, permanent marker on a sticky note.
paras.zh: - ✉️ 在便利贴上用粗体永久记号笔清楚地标记活动文档的截止日期。

paras.en: - ✉️ Save important documents like birth certificates, passports, product manuals, tax papers and medical records. Choose a method that suits your habits: alphabetize, color-code or simply label. For easy access, place vital documents in a brightly colored folder.
paras.zh: - ✉️ 保存重要文件，如出生证明、护照、产品手册、税务文件和医疗记录。选择适合您习惯的方法：按字母顺序、颜色代码或简单的标签。为了方便访问，请将重要文档放在颜色鲜艳的文件夹中。

paras.en: - ✉️ You don't need to shred everything that has your name and address on it. The Federal Trade Commission advises destroying documents containing sensitive information, such as account numbers, birth dates, passwords, signatures and Social Security numbers, to protect against identity theft.
paras.zh: - ✉️ 您无需撕碎所有有您姓名和地址的东西。联邦贸易委员会建议销毁包含帐号、出生日期、密码、签名和社会安全号码等敏感信息的文件，以防止身份盗窃。

paras.en: - ✉️ Start small by dedicating just 25 minutes to decluttering. Remember, organizing is an ongoing process that needs regular maintenance and adjustments.
paras.zh: - ✉️ 从小事做​​起，只用 25 分钟来整理。请记住，组织是一个持续的过程，需要定期维护和调整。

paras.en: In Ukraine's Kherson region, a brief ceasefire brought a momentary return to normalcy. Brokered by first lady Melania Trump and Pope Leo last week, the truce allowed hundreds of residents to evacuate from a Russian-occupied town and provided a rare few days of peace in a frontline city. Russia and Ukraine agreed to the deal to help Oleshky, a town near Kherson that was occupied by Russian troops in 2022. The troops had mined the land around it, and food and medicine were rarely able to reach the people. This short pause in hostilities was a welcome relief, allowing families to fill the sidewalks, shoppers to hurry to stock up and cafe-goers to enjoy art-filled spaces. These photos capture a brief glimpse of everyday life for these people.
paras.zh: 乌克兰赫尔松地区短暂停火，暂时恢复正常。上周，在第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普和教皇利奥的斡旋下，停火协议允许数百名居民从俄罗斯占领的城镇撤离，并为前线城市带来了罕见的几天和平。俄罗斯和乌克兰同意达成协议，帮助赫尔松附近的奥列什基镇，该镇于 2022 年被俄罗斯军队占领。军队在其周围的土地上布下了地雷，人们几乎无法获得食物和药品。敌对行动的短暂停顿是一种令人欣喜的缓解，人们可以在人行道上挤满家人，购物者可以赶紧进货，咖啡馆里的人们可以享受充满艺术的空间。这些照片记录了这些人的日常生活。

paras.en: - At Connecticut's Old State House, the annual Election Cake Bake-Off has been celebrating the sweet civic tradition of election cake for more than 250 years. This dessert has evolved from what it once was: a tough fruitcake, often soaked in alcohol.
paras.zh: - 在康涅狄格州的旧州议会大厦，一年一度的选举蛋糕烘焙会一直在庆祝选举蛋糕这一甜蜜的公民传统，已有 250 多年的历史。这种甜点是从以前的甜点演变而来的：一种坚硬的水果蛋糕，通常浸泡在酒精中。

paras.en: - Chemical manufacturer 3M has reached a $7.35 billion settlement to resolve thousands of personal injury claims related to toxic chemicals found in firefighting foam. (via PRE News & Ideas)
paras.zh: - 化学品制造商 3M 已达成 73.5 亿美元和解协议，以解决与消防泡沫中有毒化学物质相关的数千起人身伤害索赔。 （来自 PRE 新闻与想法）

paras.en: - A new study shows that loon populations are declining across the birds' southern breeding range, but Maine stands out with a slight increase in loon productivity, according to Birds Canada. (via Maine Public)
paras.zh: - 加拿大鸟类协会称，一项新的研究表明，在鸟类南部繁殖范围内，潜鸟的数量正在下降，但缅因州的潜鸟生产力略有增加，表现突出。 （通过缅因州公共）

articles.title: Russell Brand is convicted of rape, and judge says he'll get a prison term
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Russell Brand is convicted of rape, and judge says he'll get a prison term
paras.zh: 拉塞尔·布兰德被判强奸罪，法官称他将被判入狱

paras.en: London — Russell Brand was convicted Thursday of rape and sexual assault charges involving four women on allegations dating back more than 20 years.
paras.zh: 伦敦——周四，拉塞尔·布兰德 (Russell Brand) 被判犯有强奸和性侵犯罪，涉及四名女性，这些指控可以追溯到 20 多年前。

paras.en: Judge Joel Bennathan said the British actor-comedian faces a "significant" prison term when he is sentenced Monday. Brand had been free, but the judge rejected a bail request because of the possibility he might flee and he was taken into custody.
paras.zh: 乔尔·本纳森法官表示，这位英国喜剧演员周一被判刑时将面临“重大”监禁。布兰德已获释，但法官因他可能逃跑而拒绝了保释请求，因此被拘留。

paras.en: "I regret the hardship caused to the children, of course," the judge said. "But the hardship has been caused by serious criminal offending by their father."
paras.zh: “当然，我对给孩子们造成的困难感到遗憾，”法官说。 “但困难是由他们父亲的严重刑事犯罪造成的。”

paras.en: Brand was a ruthless, calculating, manipulative "sexual predator," prosecutor Riel Karmy-Jones said at trial.
paras.zh: 检察官里尔·卡米-琼斯在审判中表示，布兰德是一个冷酷无情、精于算计、善于操纵的“性掠夺者”。

paras.en: Brand, 51, denied the charges and testified that he was obsessed with sex as a young man and once led a promiscuous life but had never forced anyone to do something against their will.
paras.zh: 51 岁的布兰德否认了这些指控，并作证说，他年轻时沉迷于性，曾经过着放荡的生活，但从未强迫任何人做违背他们意愿的事情。

paras.en: He was convicted of one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault. He was acquitted of two rape counts and one count of attempted indecent assault.
paras.zh: 他被判犯有一项强奸罪和三项性侵犯罪。他的两项强奸罪名和一项企图猥亵罪名被判无罪。

paras.en: Brand closed his eyes as the guilty verdict on the rape count was read but showed no emotion otherwise. When bail was denied, he gestured to his lawyers that he was OK and repeatedly said, "I'm good, I'm good, I'm good," before being taken away.
paras.zh: 当强奸罪的有罪判决被宣读时，布兰德闭上了眼睛，但没有表现出任何其他情绪。当保释被拒绝时，他向律师示意自己没事，并反复说：“我很好，我很好，我很好”，然后被带走。

paras.en: Detective Superintendent Andy Furphy of London's Metropolitan Police said the conviction was "a testament to the extraordinary courage, resilience and determination of the women who came forward and reported what happened to them."
paras.zh: 伦敦大都会警察局侦探警司安迪·弗菲表示，这一定罪“证明了那些站出来报告自己遭遇的女性所具有的非凡勇气、韧性和决心。”

paras.en: "Brand used his influence, status and fame to exploit and sexually offend against women," he said. "As his profile grew, so too did his sense of entitlement."
paras.zh: “布兰德利用他的影响力、地位和名气来剥削和性侵犯女性，”他说。 “随着他的知名度不断提高，他的权利意识也随之增强。”

paras.en: The jury of eight men and four women in Southwark Crown Court deliberated more than eight hours over two days.
paras.zh: 南华克皇家法院的陪审团由八名男性和四名女性组成，在两天内审议了八个多小时。

paras.en: Known for risqué stand-up routines and battles with drugs and alcohol, Brand rose to prominence in the early 2000s, hosting television programs and his own BBC radio show. He appeared in Hollywood films including Forgetting Sarah Marshall and Get Him to the Greek and was briefly married to pop star Katy Perry.
paras.zh: 布兰德以有伤风化的单口喜剧表演以及与毒品和酒精的斗争而闻名，他在 2000 年代初期声名鹊起，主持电视节目和自己的 BBC 广播节目。他出现在好莱坞电影中，包括《忘记莎拉·马歇尔》和《带他去希腊》，并与流行歌星凯蒂·佩里短暂结婚。

paras.en: In recent years he has moved away from mainstream media, relocated to Florida and built a large online following with videos mixing wellness, conspiracy theories and discussions of his religious devotion.
paras.zh: 近年来，他离开了主流媒体，搬到了佛罗里达州，并通过混合健康、阴谋论和讨论他的宗教信仰的视频在网上建立了大批追随者。

paras.en: Brand was convicted of sexually assaulting a woman during a birthday party at a London bar in 2004, but cleared of orally raping her in a restroom.
paras.zh: 布兰德因 2004 年在伦敦一家酒吧的生日派对上对一名女性进行性侵犯而被定罪，但在洗手间里对她进行口奸的罪名被免除。

paras.en: He was also found guilty of kissing and groping another woman at a London radio station in 2004 or 2005 and of anally raping a fan he met backstage at one of his comedy shows in 2009.
paras.zh: 他还被判犯有 2004 年或 2005 年在伦敦一家广播电台亲吻和猥亵另一名女子的罪名，以及 2009 年在一场喜剧节目后台强奸一名他在后台遇到的粉丝的罪名。

paras.en: Brand was acquitted of raping another woman in a hotel room during the Labour Party's annual conference in the seaside town of Bournemouth in 1999, and of attempting to indecently assault a woman by dragging her into the men's bathroom at the London office of music channel MTV.
paras.zh: 1999 年，布兰德在海边小镇伯恩茅斯举行的工党年度会议期间，在酒店房间内强奸了另一名妇女，并试图将一名妇女拖进音乐频道 MTV 伦敦办公室的男卫生间，对一名妇女进行猥亵，因此布兰德被判无罪。

paras.en: The Associated Press doesn't name victims of alleged sexual violence, and British law protects their identities from the media for life.
paras.zh: 美联社没有透露性暴力受害者的名字，英国法律终身保护他们的身份不被媒体曝光。

paras.en: Brand said in the witness box that the criminal case had a devastating impact on his life and family.
paras.zh: 布兰德在证人席上表示，这起刑事案件对他的生活和家庭造成了毁灭性影响。

paras.en: "My entire life has been consumed by these events, these allegations, these accusations," he said.
paras.zh: “我的一生都被这些事件、这些指控、这些指控所占据，”他说。

paras.en: Brand's lawyers argued that the alleged victims were undermined by the fact that they only went to police years after the alleged assaults and following the broadcast of a 2023 documentary that contained anonymous allegations against Brand.
paras.zh: 布兰德的律师辩称，所谓的受害者受到了损害，因为他们是在涉嫌袭击事件发生数年之后，以及一部包含针对布兰德的匿名指控的 2023 年纪录片播出后才向警方报案的。

paras.en: Brand testified that friends and colleagues had abandoned him.
paras.zh: 布兰德作证说，朋友和同事已经抛弃了他。

paras.en: His wife, Laura, who accompanied him to court, testified as a character witness in his defense, but no one with relevant evidence was willing to give evidence on his behalf, Brand said.
paras.zh: 布兰德说，陪同他出庭的妻子劳拉作为品格证人为他的辩护作证，但没有人愿意为他提供相关证据。

articles.title: Paraguay's president is impeached minutes after resigning following a bank collapse
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Paraguay's president is impeached minutes after resigning following a bank collapse
paras.zh: 巴拉圭总统因银行倒闭辞职几分钟后被弹劾

paras.en: ASUNCIÓN, Paraguay — Paraguay's lower house voted unanimously Thursday to impeach President Santiago Peña just minutes after he announced his resignation, as the collapse of a major digital bank tied to his government froze millions of people's savings, sent protesters surging into the streets and turned his own party against him.
paras.zh: 巴拉圭亚松森——巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳宣布辞职几分钟后，巴拉圭下议院周四一致投票弹劾他，原因是与政府相关的一家大型数字银行倒闭，冻结了数百万人的储蓄，导致抗议者涌上街头，并让自己的政党反对他。

paras.en: The 78-0 vote marked a stunning repudiation of Peña by lawmakers from his long-ruling Colorado Party, who joined the opposition in backing his impeachment after three days of demonstrations rocked the capital, Asunción. The vote sends the charges to the Senate, where a two-thirds majority is required to convict the president and formally remove him from office.
paras.zh: 78比0的投票结果标志着长期执政的科罗拉多党议员对佩纳的惊人否决，在首都亚松森发生了三天的示威活动后，佩纳与反对派一起支持弹劾佩纳。投票将指控送交参议院，参议院需要三分之二多数才能对总统定罪并正式罢免他。

paras.en: The impeachment came as thousands protested for a third day, as they attempt to recoup lost savings, wages and pensions from Ueno Bank, a major digital lender.
paras.zh: 弹劾发生之际，数千人连续第三天抗议，他们试图从主要数字贷款机构上野银行收回损失的储蓄、工资和养老金。

paras.en: Peña, a close ally of U.S. President Donald Trump, announced his decision in a video posted to X as lawmakers debated his impeachment, saying he was stepping down in the interest of "the stability of our country, social peace and the need to preserve our democratic institutions."
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的亲密盟友佩纳在议员们就弹劾进行辩论时在发布到 X 的视频中宣布了他的决定，称他辞职是为了“我们国家的稳定、社会和平以及维护我们民主制度的需要”。

paras.en: The president, who until last year held a stake in a company related to Ueno Bank, expressed contrition but stopped short of accepting responsibility for the banking crisis that has plunged a South American nation long prized by foreign investors for its stability into financial and political turmoil.
paras.zh: 总统直到去年还持有与上野银行相关的一家公司的股份，他表达了悔意，但没有承担银行业危机的责任，这场银行业危机使这个长期以来因其稳定而受到外国投资者青睐的南美国家陷入了金融和政治动荡。

paras.en: "I also want to apologize to the people if I have failed them at any point," he said. "It was never my intention to betray the trust they placed in me."
paras.zh: 他说：“如果我在任何时候让人们失望了，我也想向他们道歉。” “我从来没有打算背叛他们对我的信任。”

paras.en: The extraordinary turn of events set the stage for a transfer of power later Thursday. Congress was expected to formally accept Peña's resignation at 5 p.m., clearing the way for Vice President Pedro Alliana to be sworn in as president an hour later. Alliana would serve out Peña's term through August 2028, with lawmakers expected to choose a new vice president.
paras.zh: 这一非同寻常的事态转变为周四晚些时候的权力交接奠定了基础。预计国会将在下午 5 点正式接受佩纳的辞职，为副总统佩德罗·阿利亚纳一小时后宣誓就职扫清道路。阿利亚纳的佩纳任期将持续到 2028 年 8 月，预计立法者将选出一位新的副总统。

paras.en: Ueno Bank, which exploded from an obscure finance company to a household name in less than five years, claimed more than 60% of Paraguay's adults as customers. They are now left scrambling to recoup their savings, government pensions, and, for 7,000 employees impacted by the bank's closure, unpaid wages.
paras.zh: 上野银行在不到五年的时间里从一家名不见经传的金融公司发展成为家喻户晓的名字，拥有超过 60% 的巴拉圭成年人客户。他们现在正忙着收回自己的储蓄、政府养老金，以及因银行倒闭而受到影响的 7,000 名员工的拖欠工资。

paras.en: Many Paraguayans are left asking how a bank linked to the president, who until last year had a stake in Ueno's holding company, could grow so rapidly in size and importance despite repeated warnings about its dubious lending practices.
paras.zh: 许多巴拉圭人不禁要问，一家与总统有联系的银行（直到去年才持有上野控股公司的股份）为何能够在规模和重要性上增长得如此之快，尽管其可疑的贷款行为一再受到警告。

paras.en: The answer lies in the uncomfortable proximity of Peña's long-ruling Colorado Party to the country's regulators and business elite, a weakness that has endured even as steady economic management and rapid growth made Paraguay a darling of international investors in recent years.
paras.zh: 答案在于，佩尼亚长期执政的科罗拉多党与该国监管机构和商界精英的关系令人不安，尽管稳定的经济管理和快速增长使巴拉圭近年来成为国际投资者的宠儿，但这一弱点却一直存在。

paras.en: "Santiago Peña and the Colorado Party have stolen all our savings," said Luis Pineda, one of the protesters marching to Congress on Wednesday. "We are fed up with 70 years of plunder."
paras.zh: “圣地亚哥·佩纳和科罗拉多党偷走了我们所有的积蓄，”周三游行到国会的抗议者之一路易斯·皮内达说。 “我们厌倦了70年的掠夺。”

paras.en: Soon after winning its banking license in 2023, Ueno seemed to be everywhere in Paraguay. The digital lender, a rebranded version of a decades-old finance company, lured customers with generous cash-back offers on groceries, grew to more than 70 locations, sponsored Paraguay's national soccer team and plastered its name on the country's main stadium.
paras.zh: 2023 年获得银行牌照后不久，上野似乎就遍布巴拉圭的各个角落。这家数字贷款机构是一家拥有数十年历史的金融公司的更名版，通过慷慨的食品杂货现金返还优惠吸引客户，业务扩展到 70 多个地点，赞助巴拉圭国家足球队，并将自己的名字印在该国的主体育场上。

paras.en: Government money poured into Ueno's coffers under Peña. He also appointed Carlos Carvallo, president of Financiera Ueno, the predecessor to Ueno Bank, to run the central bank, the agency charged with supervising the digital lender.
paras.zh: 政府资金涌入佩纳领导下的上野的金库。他还任命上野银行前身 Financiera Ueno 行长卡洛斯·卡瓦洛 (Carlos Carvallo) 负责运营中央银行，该机构负责监管这家数字贷款机构。

paras.en: As of last month, Ueno reported holding roughly $800 million in public deposits, about a quarter of its total, including money from the state pension and health fund and the operators of Paraguay's giant hydroelectric dams.
paras.zh: 截至上个月，上野报告称持有约 8 亿美元的公共存款，约占其总存款的四分之一，其中包括来自国家养老金和医疗基金以及巴拉圭巨型水力发电大坝运营商的资金。

paras.en: Even as retirees' savings and other public money piled up at Ueno, worries were escalating inside the central bank. In June, its inspectors found a pattern of risky lending to insiders, reported ABC Color, a leading Paraguayan newspaper. Ueno had extended large sums to companies tied to its owners, beyond what the law allows and without enough collateral to cover the debts if they went bad. On a single day in September 2025, nearly $39 million had gone to three such companies.
paras.zh: 尽管退休人员的储蓄和其他公共资金堆积在上野，央行内部的担忧仍在升级。据巴拉圭主要报纸 ABC Color 报道，今年 6 月，该公司的检查人员发现了向内部人士提供高风险贷款的模式。上野向与其所有者相关的公司提供了大量资金，超出了法律允许的范围，而且如果这些公司出现坏账，也没有足够的抵押品来偿还债务。 2025 年 9 月的一天，就有近 3900 万美元流向了三家这样的公司。

paras.en: Peña repeatedly brushed off the warnings. As recently as last month, he defended Ueno and the central bank's oversight, dismissing the concerns as a smear campaign that was spooking the public.
paras.zh: 佩纳一再无视这些警告。就在上个月，他还为上野和央行的监督进行了辩护，称这些担忧是一场吓唬公众的诽谤活动。

paras.en: Long lines outside branches but customers are locked out
paras.zh: 分行外排起长队，但顾客却被拒之门外

paras.en: But on Monday, it all came crashing down. Regulators investigating Ueno's loans to companies linked to its owners found poorly documented lending, the central bank said, as well as expenses the bank had wrongly counted as assets.
paras.zh: 但周一，这一切都崩溃了。央行表示，监管机构在调查上野向与其所有者有关联的公司提供的贷款时发现，贷款记录不实，而且该行还错误地计入了资产。

paras.en: Once the books were corrected, Ueno's capital, the cushion banks must keep to absorb losses, fell to less than half the legal minimum. The central bank seized the lender Tuesday and announced plans to move customers' accounts, along with whatever assets still hold value, to other banks before liquidating what's left.
paras.zh: 一旦账目得到更正，上野的资本（银行必须保留以吸收损失的缓冲资金）就降至法定最低限额的一半以下。央行周二查封了这家银行，并宣布计划将客户的账户以及仍然有价值的资产转移到其他银行，然后再清算剩余资产。

paras.en: Ueno's app, cards and transfers went dark and its branches locked their doors, leaving desperate depositors lined up outside with no way to cash out their savings. On Wednesday, a rush to open new accounts elsewhere crashed other banks' mobile apps, fueling public panic.
paras.zh: 上野的应用程序、银行卡和转账都陷入了瘫痪，其分行也锁上了门，绝望的储户在外面排队，无法兑现他们的积蓄。周三，在其他地方开设新账户的热潮导致其他银行的移动应用程序崩溃，加剧了公众的恐慌。

paras.en: Officials appealed for calm and said they had begun repaying depositors, opening new accounts elsewhere for about 280,000 who had banked only with Ueno.
paras.zh: 官员们呼吁民众保持冷静，并表示他们已开始偿还储户，并为约 28 万名仅在上野银行开设银行账户的储户在其他地方开设了新账户。

paras.en: "The banking system is sound," insisted Pedro Acosta Bernal, appointed interim central bank president Wednesday after Carvallo resigned at Peña's request.
paras.zh: 在卡瓦洛应佩尼亚的要求辞职后，周三被任命为临时央行行长的佩德罗·阿科斯塔·贝纳尔坚称，“银行体系是健全的”。

paras.en: Authorities have detained eight senior Ueno executives, including founder Miguel Vázquez and bank President Juan Manuel Gustale. Prosecutors also charged 27 bank officials and business associates with offenses including breach of trust and attempted fraud. Lawyers for several of the detained said they needed time to review the allegations before they could comment.
